sdug bsngal mi bzad cis kyang rgyal sras gnod byed min/ /zhi ①srid yon tan skyon gyis theg pa dman zhugs pa'i/ /rnam rtog dge ba sna tshogs blo ldan gnod byed yin/ /blo dang ldan pa dmyal bar gnas pa dus kun du/ /byang chub dri med yangs pa'i bar du gcod byed min/ /theg pa gzhan la rab bsil rnam rtog ②bdag phan pa/ /rab tu bde bar gnas kyang bar du gcod par byed/ /chos med pa dang dmigs pa dang / /kun nas nyon mongs med rnam dag /sgyu ma la sogs 'dra ba dang / /de bzhin nam mkha' 'drar shes bya/ /ji ltar tshul bzhin bris pa'i ri mo la/ /mtho ②dman med kyang snang ba de bzhin du/ /yang dag ma yin rtog la rnam kun du/ /gnyis po rtag tu med kyang snang bar 'gyur//ji ltar chu rnyog ④pa las dang ba ni④/ /dang ba nyid de de las skyes min gyi①/ /de ni de la dri ma bral bar zad/ /de bzhin rang sems dag la tshul de nyid/ /sems ni rtag tu rang bzhin 'od gsal 'dod/ /de ni glo ④bur nyes pas ma rungs byas/ /chos nyid sems las gzhan pa'i ⑧sems gzhan ni/ /'od gsal ma yin rang bzhin la brjod do/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems can la//bu gcig pa la bya ba bzhin/ /rkang gi khong nas byams pa che/ /de ltas rtag phan byed par 'dod/ /sems can rnams la phan byed phyir/ /de la ⑨chags skyes ltung mi 'gyur/ /'di yi zhe sdang rnam kun du/ /sems can kun dang 'gal bar 'gyur/ /ji ltar phug ron rang gi bu ⑩mchog byams/ /rang gi bu de nye bar 'khyud nas 'dug /de 'dra ba la khong khro 'gal ba ltar/ /brtser bcas lus can bu la'ang de dang 'dra/ /gang phyir byams pa de phyir khong khro 'gal / /gang phyir zhi ba de phyir gnod sems 'gal/ /gang phyir don byed 70—843

de phyir sgyu sems 'gal/ /gang phyir sim byed de phyir 'jigs byed 'gal/ /sman bzang po la nad pa bzhin/ /'khor ba la ni 'jug par byed/ /nad pa la ni sman pa bzhin/ /sems can rnams la sgrub par byed/ /bran ma grub pa ji bzhin du/ /bdag nyid la ni sgrub par byed/ /zong la tshong ba ji bzhin du//'dod pa dag la sgrub par byed/ /gos la btso blag ①mkhan bzhin du/ /las la rab tu sgrub par byed/ /bu gzhon pa la pha bzhin du/ /sems can mi 'tsho sgrub par byed/ /me don gnyer la gtsub ④shing ltar/ /rtag par rab tu sgrub par byed/ /yid brtan bzhin du lhag pa'i sems/ /ma rdzogs pa la sgrub par byed / /sgyu ma mkhan ltar shes bya la/ /shes rab kyis ni sgrub par byed/ /de ni byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /ji ltar gong ①du sgrub par 'dod/ /de ltar rtag tu brtson 'grus rgya chen ldan/ /gnyis yongs smin par bya la rab brtson de//rim gyis dri med mi rtog blo mchog gis/ /sgrub ④pa bla na med par rab tu 'gro/ / theg pa chen po mdo sde'i rgyan las⑤/ sgrub pa'i le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o④// //bskal pa grangs med nges 'byung zhing / /mos pa rnam par 'phel byed pa//ji ltar chu yis rgya mtsho bzhin/ /dge chos rnams kyis yang dag rdzogs/ /de bzhin du ni tshogs bsags pa'i/ /rgyal sras gzod ④nas dag pa po/ /legs par shes shing sems dge ba/ /bsgom ④pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /de tshe chos kyi rgyun la ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams las zhi gnas dang / /ye shes yangs pa thob bya'i phyir/ /gdams ngag rgya chen rnyed ⑨par 'gyur/ /de nas dang por sdom brtson de/ /mdo yi sde la sogs pa'i chos/ /mi gnyis don ni rnam 'byed pa/ /70—844

mdo sogs ming la sems 'jog go/ /de nas de ni rim bzhin du/ /tshig rab dbye la dpyod ①byed cing / /so so'i nang la tshul bzhin du/ /de yi don yang rnam par dpyod/ /don de dag ni nges bzung nas/ /chos la kun nas sdom par byed/ /de yi don ni thob bya'i phyir/ /de nas de ni smon par byed/ /yid kyi brjod pas rgyun chags su/ /btsal ⑤bya so sor brtag par bya/ /yid la byed pa brjod med par④/ /ro gcig ④pas kyang dpyad par bya/ /chos kyi ming ni bsdoms pa'ang 'di/ /zhi gnas lam du shes par bya/ /lhag mthong lam ni de'i ①don rnams/ /rnam par dpyod par shes par bya/ /zung du 'brel ba'i lam ni de/ /bsdoms pa yin par shes par bya/ /zhum pa'i sems ni rab gzung ste/ /rgod pa yang ni zhi bar bya/ /de nas dmigs pa de la ni/ /mnyam par gyur na btang snyoms gzhag /de la rtag tu bya ba dang / /gus par bya ste 0sbyar bar bya/ /dmigs pa la ni sems gtad nas/ /de'i ④rgyun rnam par g.yeng mi bya/ /rnam g.yeng myur du rtogs ④byas nas/ /de la slar ni blan par bya/ /blo ldan gong nas gong du yang / /sems ni nang du bsdu ④bar bya / /de nas yon tan mthong ba'i phyir/ /ting nge 'dzin la sems gdul lo⑫//rnam g.yeng nyes pa mthong ba'i phyir/ /de la mi dga' zhi bar bya/ /brnab ⑫ sems yid mi bde la sogs/ /langs pa de bzhin zhi bar bya/ /de nas sdom ⑫ brtson can gyis ni/ /sems la mngon par 'du byed bcas/ /rang gi rlungang gis 'byung ba 'thob/ /de goms pa las 'du mi byed/ /de nas de yis lus dang sems/ /shin tu sbyangs pa che thob nas/ /yid la byed dang bcas shes bya//de yis de ni 'phel byas nas⑫/ /'phel ba ring du 'gro ba yis/ /dngos gzhi'i 70—845

gnas pa des 'thob ①po/ /mngon shes don du gnyer bas de/ /sbyangs nas ④las su rung ba'i mchog /bsam gtan las 'thob ②mngon par shes/ /mngon par bsgrubs ④pa'i sgo nas de/ /sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa la/ /mchod pa'i phyir dang mnyan ④pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten khams ni rnams su 'gro/ /'dis ni sangs rgyas dpag med la/ /bskal dpag med par ④bsnyen bkur byas / /de la bsnyen bkur byas pa'i phyir/ /sems ni las rung mchog tu 'gyur / / des na ④de dag sngon rol du/ /phan yon lnga ni 'thob 'gyur te/ /des ni rnam par dag pa'i snod/ /bla na med pa nyid 'gyur 'di'i⑤/ /lus la gnas ngan len pa kun/ /skad cig re re la zad 'gyur/ /lus dang sems ni kun du yang / /shin tu sbyangs pas gang bar gyur/ /chos rnams snang ba thams cad du/ /yongs su chad pa med rtogs ⑨'gyur/ /yang dag pa yi rgyu mtshan ni/ /ma brtags pa dag rab tu mthong / /de bzhin chos sku rab rdzogs dang / /rnam par dag par bya ba'i phyir/ /blo dang ldan pa ⑫rnam kun du/ /rtag tu rgyu yongs 'dzin par byed/ /de nas de 'drar gyur pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' mnyam gzhag pas/ /yid kyi brjod pa ma gtogs par/ /don kun rab tu mi mthong ngo / /chos kyi snang ba 'phel bya'i phyir/ /brtson 'grus brtan pa kun du brtsam⑪/ /chos kyi snang ba 'phel nas ni/ /sems tsam la ni gnas par 'gyur/ /de nas don du ⑫snang ba kun0/ /sems su rab tu snang ⑫ bar 'gyur/ /de tshe de yi gzung ba yi/ /rnam par g.yeng ba de spangs ⑫'gyur//de nas de la 'dzin pa yi/ /rnam par g.yeng ba 'ba' zhig lus/ /de tshe bar chad med pa yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la myur du reg /'di ltar de yi mjug ⑫ 70—846

thogs su/ /'dzin pa'i rnam par ①g.yeng ba spong / /'di dag go rims bzhin du ni/ /dro bar 'gyur ②sogs yin shes bya/ /de nas des ⑤ni 'jig rten las/ /'das pa'i ye shes bla med pa/ /rnam par mi rtog dri ma med/ /'dzin pa gnyis dang bral ba 'thob④/ /de 'di'i gnas yongs gyur pa ste/ /sa ni dang po yin par 'dod/ / de 'di ⑤bskal pa dpag med kyis/ /shin tu rnam par dag par 'gyur/ /chos kyi dbyings ni mnyam pa nyid/ /rab tu rtogs nas de yi tshe/ /rtag tu sems can thams cad la/ /bdag dang mtshungs pa'i sems 'thob ④ste/ /sems can rnams la bdag med dang / /sdug bsngal dang ni don bya dang / /lan la mi re ④'di sems snyoms/ /rgyal sras gzhan dang 'dra ba yin/ /des ni khams gsum 'dus byas rnams/ /yang dag ma yin kun rtog ⑤par/ /ye shes shin tu rnam dag pa⑨/ /gnyis su med pa'i don gyis mthong / /de dag med pa'i ngo bo nyid⑫/ /mthong bas spang bya rnams las grol/ /des na de tshe mthong ba'i lam/ /thob pa zhes ni nges par brjod/ /⑫med pa'i stong pa nyid shes shing / /de bzhin yod pa'i stong nyid dang / /⑫rang bzhin stong ⑩pa nyid shes pas④/ /stong pa shes pa zhes brjod do/ /mtshan med bzhi ni rnam rtog rnams/ /yang dag zad pa yin zhes bya / /smon pa med par gyur pa'i ⑫de/ /yang dag ma yin kun rtog go/ /rgyal sras byang chub phyogs mthun pa/ /rnam pa sna tshogs thams cad ni/ /rtag tu mthong ba'i lam de dang / /lhan cig tu ni thob par 'dod/ /gang zhig blo yis 'gro ba 'dus byas tsam/ /bdag med sdug bsngal rgyas pa tsam shes te/ /don med rang bzhin bdag lta rnam spangs nas/ /bdag nyid che lta don chen 70—847

rnyed ①pa gang / /'di ni bdag lta med par bdag tu lta/ /sdug bsngal med par shin tu sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /rang la phan byas bdag la ji lta bar/ /don kun byed la lan kyang re ba med/ /gang zhig grol ba mchog gis sems grol la / /'ching ba mi zad ⑤yun yang ring por bcings/ /sdug bsngal mthar thug pa ni ma mthong yang / /rab tu sbyor ba nyid dang ②byed pa nyid/ /④'jig rten tshe gcig rang sdug bkur mi nus/ /'jig rten gnas pa srid du gzhan sdug bsngal/ /bsdoms pa smos ci dgos te bsam du med/ /byang chub sems dpa' de las bzlog pa yin/ /rgyal sras sems can rnams la dga' ba dang / /byams pa gang yin sbyor dang mi skyo gang / /de ni srid pa dag na ngo mtshar che/ /sems can bdag dang mtshungs phyir de lta'ang min/ /de nas de ⑤ni lhag ma yi//sa rnams bsgom ④pa'i lam 'di la/ /ye shes rnam pa gnyis po dag /bsgom ⑦phyir rab tu sbyong ⑤bar byed/ /rnam par mi rtog ye shes de/ /sangs rgyas chos ni sbyong bar byed/ /gzhan ni ji bzhin rnam 'jog pa/ /sems can rnams ni yongs smin byed/ /grangs med gnyis ni rdzogs pa yis/ /bsgom ⑨pa yi ni tshar ④phyin te/ /bsgom ⑩pa tha ma thob nas ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' dbang bskur ba/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin/ /rtog pas mi shigs thob nas ni/ /gnas gzhan gyur pas khyamathar thug pa/ /sgrib pa kun gyi dri med pazha/gang la gnas nas ⑫sems can kun/ /phan phyir rab tu sgrub byed pa/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa yi⑫/ /go 'phang bla na med pa 'thob/ /de ltar mthong dka'i thub pa rtag mthong ba/ /thos pa mnyam med las byung rab dang ba'i/ /shugs kyis ⑫rtag par shin tu sems tshim la/ /ji lta bur na don chen 'gyur ma 70—848

yin / /chos kyi sgo la rnam par gnas pa la/ /de bzhin gshegs rtag mngon sum 'doms mdzad cing / /co nas 'dren bzhin ①nyes pa'i tshang tshing nas/ / mtshan gyis ②drangs te byang chub la dgod ①do/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni rtag tu rang don yang dag sbyor la legs par bsngags pa dang / /log par sbyor ④la smod mdzad gnas dang rnam 'byed lhur len mchog gi sems can la/ /gang zhig spangs dang bsten pas bde gshegs bstan pa 'di la rnal 'byor yangs 'gyur ba/ /bar chad mthun pa'i chos ni rnam pa thams cad rgyal rnams tshul bzhin 'di na ston/ /de ni mthong ba rab dag mi rtog byang chub kyis④/ /'jig rten thams cad zil mnan mun pa chen po yang / /rnam pa kun tu bsal nas nyi ma chen po dag /shar ba bzhin du 'gro ba rnams la lam ④me'o/ /de ltar rtag tu dge ba bsags pas rab gang zhing ⑦/ /thub pa las ni rtag tu gdams ngag che thob pa'i/ /sems dpa' mchog ni sems kyi ting 'dzin rab yangs pa thob nas yon tan rgya mtsho'i pha rol 'gro bar 'gyur/ / theg pa chen po mdo sde'i rgyan las / ⑤ gdams ngag ⑨rjes su bstan pa'i le'u ste bco lnga pa'o⑩// //sdom ni/ mos pa mang ba nyid dang ni/ /chos tshol ba dang bshad pa dang / /de bzhin sgrub dang yang dag pa'i/ /gdams ngag rjes su bstan pa yin / /ji ltar nags tshal dang ni lus can ri bo dang / /chu bo rnams kyi rten ni kun nas sa yin pa/ /de bzhin mkhas pa rnams kyi las rnam ⑪gsum po yang / /kun nas sbyin pa la sogs dge ba'i ⑫yin par brjod/ /shin tu dka' ba'i las ni ngo bo sna tshogs pa/ /bskal pa mang pos tshar phyin mngon 70—849

brtson bdag nyid can/ /rgyal sras rnams ni ①lus dang ngag sems rang bzhin gyi / /las rnams dag gis 'di na yid 'byung 'gyur ba med/ /ji ltar bdag la phan 'dod dug dang mtshon dang ni/ /gnam lcags lce dang dgra las rang gi lus zlog ②pa/ /de bzhin rgyal sras theg pa dman pa rnam gnyis las/ /las rnam ①gsum gyi bdag nyid zlog par byed pa yin/ /rtag tu rnam par mi rtog las can las min zhing / /las kyi bya ba dang rnam gsum la mi lta ste/ /des na 'di ni de'i ④thabs yang dag gzung ba'i phyir/ /las rnams dag pa mtha' yas de yi ④pha rol 'gro/ / theg pa chen po mdo sde'i rgyan las/④thabs dang ldan pa'i las kyi le'u ste bcu drug pa'o⑦// //grangs dang de yi mtshan nyid go rims dang / /nges pa'i tshig dang yon tan goms bya ⑤dang / /de dag rab dbye bsdu ⑨dang mi mthun phyogs/ /yon tan phan tshun rnam nges yin zhes bya/ /longs spyod dang lus phun sum tshogs pa dang / /'khor rtsom phun sum tshogs pa mngon mtho dang / /rtag tu nyon mongs dbang nyid mi 'gro dang / /bya ba rnams la phyin ci ma log pa'o/ /sems can don la rab brtson pa/ /gtong dang mi gnod bzod pas byed/ /gnas dang grol ba bzhir bcas pa༅/ /rang don rnam pa thams cad spyod/ /mi 'phongs ⑪pa dang rnam par mi 'tshe dang / /rnam 'tshe bzod dang bya bas mi skyo dang / /dga' byed legs par brjod pa ⑫de yi phyir/ /gzhan gyi don ni rang gi don yin no/ /longs spyod mngon par mi dga' dang / /rab gus gnyis la mi skya spyodang / /rnal 'byor rnam par mi rtog pa/ /theg chen mtha' 70—850

dag 'dir zad do/ /yul rnams la ni ma chags lam/ /de thob rnam g.yeng sdom ①pa'i gzhan/ /sems can mi gtong 'phel ba dang / /sgrib pa rnam par sbyong ba'i gzhan/ /bslab gsum dbang du mdzad nas ni/ /rgyal bas pha rol phyin pa drug /yang dag bshad de dang po gsum/ /tha ma gnyis kyis rnam pa gnyis / /gcig ni gsum char la yang gtogs/ /sbyin pa mi mthun phyogs nyams dang / /rnam par mi rtog ④ye shes ldan/ /'dod pa thams cad yongs rdzogs byed/ /sems can rnam smin ⑤byed rnam gsum/ /tshul khrims mi mthun phyogs nyams dang / /rnam par mi rtog ye shes ldan/ /'dod pa thams cad yongs rdzogs byed/ /sems can rnam smin byed rnam gsum/ /bzod pa mi mthun phyogs nyams dang / /rnam par mi rtog ye shes ldan/ /'dod pa thams cad yongs rdzogs byed/ /sems can rnam smin byed rnam gsum/ /brtson 'grus mi mthun phyogs nyams dang / /rnam par mi rtog ye shes ldan/ /'dod pa thams cad yongs rdzogs byed/ /sems can rnam smin byed rnam gsum/ /bsam gtan mi mthun phyogs nyams dang / /rnam par mi rtog ye shes ldan/ /'dod pa thams cad yongs rdzogs byed/ /sems can rnam smin byed rnam gsum//shes rab mi mthun phyogs nyams dang / /rnam par mi rtog ye shes ldan/ /'dod pa thams cad yongs rdzogs byed/ /sems can rnam smin byed rnam gsum//snga ma la brten ①phyi ma skye/ /dman dang mchog tu gnas phyir dang / /rags pa dang ni phra ba'i phyir/ /de dag rim par bstan pa yin/ /dbul ba 'dor bar byed pa dang / /bsil ba 'thob dang khro bzod dang / /mchog sbyor ba dang yid 'dzin dang / /don dam shes pa'i phyir bshad do/ /thams cad 70—851

bsgom ①pa dngos po dang / /de bzhin yid la byed pa dang / /bsam pa dang ni thabs dag dang / /dbang sbyor ⑤nyid la rten par ①brjod/ /don rnams gtong ④bar byed pa dang / /rtsa ba sems pa la brten dang / /lus dang longs spyod phun tshogs dang / /gnyis rjes 'dzin dang rdzogs byed dang / /de yang ser sna med ldan par༅/ /chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs gtong / /sbyin pa de 'drar ④yongs shes nas/ /mkhas pa yang dag sgrub par byed/ /yan lag drug zhi bsam pas zin/ /bde 'gro gnas pa sbyin byed dang / /rten dang zhi dang 'jigs pa med/ /bsod nams tshogs dang ldan pa dang / /brdar brtags chos nyid thob pa ste/ /sdom la gnas pa rnams la yod/ /tshul khrims de 'drar yongs shes nas/ /mkhas pa yang dag sgrub par byed/ /mi mjed ji mi snyam shes ④dang / /snying rjes ④chos la rten ⑨pa'i phyir/ /phan yon lngar ni yang dag bshad/ /de ni gnyis ⑩kyi don byed de/ /dka' thub gtso dang kun tu ldan/ /de la de ni rnam gsum 'dod/ /bzod pa de 'drar yongs shes nas/ /mkhas pa yang dag sgrub par byed/ /dge la yang dag spro ba dang / /dad dang 'dun la rten ༅pa dang / /dran sogs yon tan 'phel byed dang / /kun nas nyon mongs gnyen po dang / /ma chags la sogs yon tan ldan/ /de dag la ni de rnam bdun/ /brtson 'grus de 'drar yongs shes nas / /mkhas pa yang dag sgrub par byed/ /sems ni nang du gnas pa dang //dran dang brtson 'grus la brten pa/ /bde ba skyed par byed pa dang / /mngon shes gnas la dbang bsgyur ba/ /chos rnams kyi ni gtso bo ste/ /de dag la yod de rnam gsum/ /bsam gtan de 'drar yongs shes nas/ /70—852

mkhas pa yang dag sgrub par byed/ /shes bya yang dag rab rnam 'byed/ /ting nge 'dzin la rten ①pa dang / /kun nas nyon mongs shin tu grol/ /shes rab 'tshe ba legs bshad dang / /chos rnams kyi ni mchog yin te/ /de dag la yod de rnam gsum/ /shes rab de 'drar yongs shes nas/ /mkhas pa yang dag sgrub par byed/ /dkar po'i chos kun rnam par g.yengs ⑤pa dang / /mnyam par gzhag dang gnyis shar shes par bya/ /pha rol phyin pa gnyis dang ni//gnyis dang ②gnyis kyis yongs su bsdus④/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pa ni//ma chags mi chags chags pa med/ /chags pa nyid kyang ma yin te/ /ma chags mi chags chags pa med/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims ni/ /ma chags mi chags ⑤chags pa med/ /chags pa nyid kyang ma yin te/ /ma chags mi chags chags pa med/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bzod pa ni/ /ma chags mi chags chags pa med/ /chags pa nyid kyang ma yin te/ /ma chags mi chags chags pa med/ /byang chub sems dpa'i brtson 'grus ni/ /ma chags mi chags chags pa med/ /chags pa nyid kyang ma yin te/ /ma chags mi chags chags pa med/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bsam gtan ni/ /ma chags mi chags chags pa med/ /chags pa nyid kyang ma yin te/ /ma chags mi chags chags pa med/ /byang chub sems dpa'i shes rab ni/ /ma chags mi chags chags pa med/ /chags pa nyid kyang ma yin te/ /ma chags mi chags chags pa med/ /sangs rgyas sras rnams slong dang phrad na rang gi srog kyang rtag tu gtong ④/ /snying rjes gzhan las ④lan kyang mi re 'dod pa'i 'bras bu don mi gnyer/ /sbyin pa de nyid kyis kyang skye bo thams cad byang chub gsum la bkod/ /sbyin pa ye shes kyis 70—853

yongs zin pas 'jig rten dag na mi zad bzhag /sangs rgyas sras rnams sdom dang brtson pa'i rang bzhin tshul khrims gsum rtag 7blangs/ /mtho ris mngon par ⑤mi 'dod yang dag thob kyang de la chags mi skyed/ /tshul khrims de nyid kyis kyang skye bo thams cad byang chub gsum la bkod/ /tshul khrims ye shes kyis yongs zin pas 'jig rten dag na mi zad bzhag /sangs rgyas sras rnams shin tu bya dka' de bzhin mi yi gnod kun bzod/ /mtho ris gnyer dang mi nus pas min 'jigs pas ma yin phan ltas ①min/ /bzod pa bla na med pas skye bo ④thams cad byang chub gsum la bkod/ /bzod pa ye shes kyis yongs zin pas 'jig rten dag na mi zad bzhag /rgyal ba'i ①sras rnams go cha sbyor ba'i bdag nyid brtson 'grus dpe med byas/ /rang dang gzhan gyi nyon mongs tshogs gzhom byang chub dam pa 'thob par byed/ /brtson 'grus de nyid kyis kyang skye bo thams cad byang chub gsum la bkod/ /brtson 'grus ye shes kyis yongs zin pas 'jig rten dag na mi zad bzhag /rgyal ba'i ④sras rnams ting 'dzin mang ldan bsam gtan rnam pa thams cad bsgrubs/ /bsam gtan bde ba phul gyis gnas shing snying rjes skye ba dman la rten④/ /bsam gtan de nyid kyis kyang ⑧skye bo thams cad byang chub gsum la bkod/ /bsam gtan ye shes kyis yongs zin pas 'jig rten dag na mi zad bzhag /rgyal ba'i ⑨sras rnams de nyid shes bya gang yin mtha' dag rnam kun shes/ /mya ngan 'das la'ang blo yis chags rab mi skyed ⑫'khor bar smos ci dgos/ /ye shes de nyid kyis kyang skye bo thams cad byang chub gsum la bkod/ /ye shes sems can yongs su gsung skyebs 'jig rten dag na mi zad ⑫bzhag /rgya che ba dang zang zing med/ /don 70—854

che ba dang mi zad pa/ /sbyin ①la sogs pa ②thams cad kyi/ /yon tan bzhir ni shes par bya/ /slong ba mthong rdzogs dga' ba dang / /mi dga' ba dang rton pa dang ①/ /sbyin pa po ni brtser ldan pas/ /lhag par ldan pas rtag zil gnon/ /brtse bas sems can rnams la ni/ /srog dang longs spyod chung ma dag /rtag gtong shin tu dga' byed pa/ /de spong ji ltar srung mi 'gyur/ /'phags pa mi lta sems snyoms shing / /mi 'jigs brtse phyir kun ster ba/ /gzhan la gnod par ④byed pa yis/ /log ④pa'i tshig ni ji ltar smra/ /snyoms par phan par 'dod pas ④brtse ba can/ /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal skye bas shin tu 'jigs / /sems can 'dul ba la ni sems ④brtson pa/ /ngag gi nyes rnam ④gsum las shin tu ring / /thams cad gtong ⑨ba snying rje can/ /rten 'byung chos la rab mkhas pa/ /de ni yid kyi nyon mongs kun/ /ji lta bur na dang du len / /brtser ldan gang tshe gnod pa ⑫byed pa dang / /gzhan la phan pa'i sdug bsngal la rteg 7tu/ /phan pa'i 'du shes dga' ba rnyed gyur pa⑫/ /de yis gang la ci zhig bzod par bya/ /gzhan la gzhan gyi 'du shes bral ba dang //bdag pas ches lhag gzhan la rtag ⑩byams dang / /dka' ⑫ba spyod phyir brtse ba dang bcas la/ /brtson 'grus dka' khyab min la shin tu dka'⑫/ /gsum gyi bsam gtan bde ba chung / /bdag bde gzhan pa yongs nyams ⑫'gyur/ /zad 'gyur rmongs dang bcas par 'dod/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bzlog pa 'o//ji ltar mtshan mo lag nom dang / /khebs sgron de bzhin shes pa ⑫gsum/ /snying rje can gyi shes pa ni/ /nyi ma'i zer bzhin mtshungs pa med/ /sbyin pa rten ⑫dang gzhi dang ni/ /rgyu mtshan dang ni yongs bsngo dang / /rgyu dang ye 70—855

shes zhing dag dang / /gnas kyi sgo nas mchog tu 'dod/ /tshul khrims rten dang gzhi ①dang ni/ /rgyu mtshan dang ni yongs bsngo dang / /rgyu dang ye shes zhing dag dang / /gnas kyi sgo nas mchog tu 'dod/ /bzod pa rten dang gzhi ②dang ni/ /rgyu mtshan dang ni yongs bsngo dang / /rgyu dang ye shes zhing dag dang / /gnas kyi sgo nas mchog tu 'dod/ /brtson 'grus rten ①dang gzhi dang ni/ /rgyu mtshan dang ni yongs bsngo ①dang / /rgyu dang ye shes zhing dag dang / /gnas kyi sgo nas mchog tu 'dod/ /bsam gtan rten dang gzhi dang ni/ /rgyu mtshan dang ni yongs bsngo dang / /rgyu dang ye shes zhing dag dang / /gnas kyi sgo nas mchog tu 'dod/ /shes rab rten dang gzhi dang ni/ /rgyu mtshan dang ni yongs bsngo dang / /rgyu dang ye shes zhing dag dang / /gnas kyi sgo nas mchog tu 'dod/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pa ni/ /sems can gcig bde bskal mang ①du/ /gnod pa byed kyang dga' ④'gyur na/ /de las bzlog pa smos ༅ci dgos/ /lus can rnams ni gang phyir nor 'dod pa/ /brtan rnams de nyid lus can rnams la gtong / /skye bo rnams ni lus phyir nor 'dod de/ /de nyid brtan rnams brgya phrag rnams su gtong / /gang tshe lus nyid gtong ༅yang yid sdug mi bsngal ba/ /de tshe rdzas ngan lta la smos kyang ci zhig dgos/ /de 'di'i 'jig rten 'das pa de des ④dga' 'gyur ba/ /gang yin de ni de yi yang ni 7bla ma yin/ /ji ltar blo ldan 'di ni kun gtong ⑪ bas / /don gnyer skye bo dga' bas dga' ba ltar/ /de ltar slong ⑫mo ba dag blang bya ba/ /'dod dgu thob pa dag gis dgar ⑫mi 'gyur/ /blo can ⑫ bdog dgu btang bas nor med pa / /bdag nyid nor ldan sems pa ji lta bar//70—856

slong ①ba longs spyod kun rdzogs bdag nyid ni/ /de ltar nor dang ldan par mi sems so/ /ji ltar blo ldan 'di ni sbyin pa bzang pos ②tshul bzhin du/ /don gnyer tshim byas de la phan chen ①'dogs par sems pa ltar/ /de bzhin slong mo ④ba dag shin tu nor mang thob nas ni/ /sbyin pa po la rnyed pa'i rgyu yis drin du mi brtsi'o⑤/ /lam sha'i 'bras mchog ldan pa'i shing las longs spyod ④ji lta bar / /lus can rnams kyis gang gi nor rdzas rgya cher ④blangs nas ni/ /bdag nyid dogs dang bral bar rang nyams spyod par byed pa la/ /btang dga' longs spyod can de byang chub sems dpa' las gzhan min/ /gtso dang de'i ④rgyu las kyi ⑨dbye ba dang / /rnam pa'i dbye ba rten gyi ⑫dbye ba dang / /bar chad rnam bzhi'i ⑫gnyen po'i dbye ba yis/ /brtson 'grus yongs shes bya zhes rab tu bstan/ /dge ba'i tshogs kyi nang na brtson 'grus mchog /'di ltar de la brten nas de rjes 'thob⑫/ /brtson 'grus kyis ni mod la bde gnas mchog /⑫'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten gtogs pa 'grub༅/ /brtson 'grus kyis ni srid spyod 'dod pa 'thob⑫/ /brtson 'grus kyis ni dag pa ༅rab 'gyur ldan/ /brtson 'grus kyis ni 'jig tshogs 0'das nas grol/ /brtson 'grus kyis ni byang chub mchog sangs rgyas/ /gzhan yang nyams ༅dang 'phel ba'i brtson 'grus dang / /thar pa'i dbang dang mi mthun phyogs spangs gzhan / /de nyid rab zhugs yongs su sgyur byed dang / /brtson 'grus don chen nges tshig gzhan du 'dod/ /thog mar dge ba'i ༅brtson 'grus de nas ni//tshul ④bzhin rab zhugs sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus te/ /ma zhum mi 'gong 0chog mi shes brtson 'grus/ /rnam pa thams cad sangs rgyas rnams rab gsungasakhya/ /70—857

theg pa gsum brtson skye bo la brten nas/ /bsam blo zhan dang rgya rab che ldan phyir / /brtson 'grus tha ma 'bring dang mchog gzhan te/ /de ni don chung ba dang don chen 'dod/ /brtson 'grus ldan pa longs spyod kyis pham med/ /brtson 'grus ldan pa nyon mongs kyis pham med/ /brtson 'grus ldan pa skyo bas pham pa med/ /brtson 'grus ldan pa thob pas pham pa med/ /phan tshun bsdus ①phyir rab dbye'i phyir/ /chos nyid phyir dang rgyu mtshan phyir/ /pha rol phyin drug rnam kun du/ /rnam par nges par shes par bya/ /sbyin mtshungs de ston len 'jug dang / /bdag nyid rjes su ⑤'jug rnams kyis/ /snyan par smra dang don spyod dang / /don mthun nyid du 'dod pa yin/ /phan par byed pa'i thabs dang ni/ /'dzin par ༅byed dang 'jug byed dang / /de bzhin rjes su 'jug byed pas④/ /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhir shes bya/ /dang pos snod 'gyur dngos po ste/ /gnyis pa yis ni mos pa yin/ /gsum pa yis ni sgrub pa ste/ /bzhi pas rnam par sbyong ba 'o/ /zang zing dang ni chos kyi ste④/ /dmigs pa'i /༅chos la sogs pa yis/ /bsdu ba gnyis kyi gasgo nas ni/ /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhir 'dod do/ /rnam pa'i dbye ba'i sgo nas ni/ /bsdu ba dman dang 'bring dang mchog /phal cher don med don yod dang / /rnam kun don yod shes par bya/ /'khor sdud pa dang ldan pa rnams/ /tshul 'di la ni yang dag rtenakhya / /kun gyi don kun sgrub byed cing / /thabs bzang yin par rab tu bsngags/ /bsdus ⑨dang sdud par 'gyur ba dang / /gang dag da ltar sdud byed pa/ /de kun de 'drar ⑫de lta bas/ /'di ni sems can smin byed lam/ /de ltar rtag tu longs spyod ma chags blo/ /zhi sdom brtson pa'i pha 70—858

rol phyin gnas bdag /srid yul mtshan ma rnam par mi rtog pa/ /de ni sems can tshogs sdud byed pa yin/ / theg pa chen po mdo sde'i rgyan las/lapha rol tu phyin pa dang bsdu ba'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o②// //rab dang sems dang ldan pa yis/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir//sangs rgyas rnams la gos sogs kyis/ /mngon sum mngon sum min par mchod//sangs rgyas 'byung ba don yod par/ /smon lam dang ni ldan pa yi②/ /gsum po dmigs par mi byed pa/ /sangs rgyas mchod pa rdzogs pa yin/ /sems can dag ni tshad med pa/ /yongs su smin par byed pa gzhan/ /rdzas dang sems kyi sgo nas gzhan/ /mos pa dang ni smon pa dang / /brtse dang bzod pa dag dang ni/ /yang dag spyod pa'i sgo dang ni/ /gzhi la gtod dang rtogs pa dang / /grol dang de bzhin nyid kyis gzhan/ /rgyu mtshan dang ni yongs bsngo dang / /rten dang dngos dang rgyu dang ni/ /ye shes dang ni zhing dag dang / /gnas kyi mchod pa rab bstan pa④/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu nyid dang ni/ /bdag nyid dang ni gzhan dag dang / /rnyed dang bkur sti nyid dang ni/ /sgrub pa'i sgo nas de rnam gnyis/ /mchod pa chung dang chen po deX/ /nga rgyal bcas dang nga rgyal med/ /sbyor dang 'gro ba nyid dang ni/ /smon pa'i sgo nas der 'dod do / /rang gi sems kyis sangs rgyas rnams ④mchod pa/ /chos la mos dang bsam dang dbang 'byor dang / /rnam par mi rtog thabs yongs bzung ba dang //kun dang ⑦don gcig nyid la 'jug pas mchog /bsten ⑤pa rten dang gzhi dang ni/ /rgyu mtshan dang ni yongs bsngo dang / /rgyu dang ye shes zhing dag dang /70—859

gnas kyi sgo nas rab tu bstan/ /bshes gnyen dul ba zhi zhing nyer zhi ①ba/ /yon tan lhag pa brtson bcas lung gis phyug /de nyid rab tu rtogs pa smra mkhas ldan/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyo ba spangs la sten②/ /bkur ste rnyed ⑤pa dag dang rim gro dang / /sgrub pa'i sgo nas bshes gnyen bsten ④par bya/ /bsten gzhi de bzhin blo ldan chos la ni/ /shes bsam dus su 'dud pas bshes gnyen bgrod/ /de ni bsnyen bkur rnyed la 'dod pa med/ /bsgrub par bya phyir de yongs sngo ༅bar byed/ /brtan ༅ pa ji skad bstan pa sgrub ④pa des/ /de yi sems ni yang dag mgu bar byed/ /theg pa gsum la mkhas pa blos ⑧rtogs nas/ /rang gi theg pa bsgrub ④par bya phyir 'bad/ /sems can tshad med yongs smin bya phyir dang / /zhing dag pa yang sbyang bar bya ba'i phyir/ /de chos bgo skal ༅ la spyod yon tan ldan/ /bshes gnyen rab tu bsten bya ⑫zang zing min/ /blo dang ldan pa rgyu dang 'bras bu dang / /chos sgo rjes 'gro phyi spyodang thos mnyan dang / /sems kyi rnal 'byor nga rgyal bcas pa dang / /nga rgyal med yid ldan pas bshes gnyen bsten/ /blo ldan 'gro dang sbyor ba dang / /smon pa'i sgo nas bshes gnyen bsten6 / /rang gi sems kyis bshes gnyen mchog bsten 0pa/ /chos la mos dang bsam dang dbang 'byor dang / /rnam par mi rtog thabs yongs bzung ba dang / /kun dang don gcig nyid la 'jug pas mchog /brtan pa'i tshangs pa mi mthun spangs/ /rnam par mi rtog ye shes ldan/ /dmigs pa rnam pa gsum la 'jug /sems can rnams ni yongs smin byed/ /brtan pa rnams kyi de dag bde 'dod dang / /sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag dang bde ba dang / /nyon mongs can dang de dag bstan bcos 70—860

dang / /de yi de bzhin nyid la rab tu 'jug /de don de bzhin nyid phyir dang / /zhi ba thob pas dag phyir dang / /las gnyis nyon mongs zad pa'i phyir / /byams pa dmigs pa med pa yin/ /de dag g.yo dang mi g.yo dang / /chags pas ro myang ①min 'is bya/ /byang chub sems dpa' mi g.yo ba/ /chags dang bral bar ⑤rab tu gnas/ /mnyam gzhag ngo bo nyid min chung / /'bring dang dman pa'i sa pa dang / /bsam pa dman dang nga rgyal bcas/ /gang yin de dman gzhan nyid lhag /tshangs pa'i gnas pas gnas pa yi/ /blo ldan rtag tu 'dod par skye/ /des ni tshogs rnams rdzogs byed cing / /sems can dag kyang rnam smin byed/ /kun du tshangs dang mi 'bral bakhya/ /de yi mi mthun phyogs dang bral/ /bag med gyur kyang de yi rkyen/ /mi bzad pas kyang mi 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' gnod sems dang / /rnam 'tshe mi dga' gnod sems dang / /'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang ldan pa/ /nyes dmigs rnam pa mang la reg /nyon mongs kyis ni bdag 'joms sems can 'joms shing tshul khrims 'joms/ /nyams bcas snyed ④pas dman zhing srung dang de bzhin ston pas smad/ /rtsod ⑤bcas mi snyan de ni gzhan du mi khom rnams su skye/ /thob dang ma thob nyams pas yid la sdug bsngal chen po 'thob/ /nyes pa 'di kun byams sogs la/ /legs par gnas la mi 'byung ste/ /nyon mongs can min sems can gyi⑥/ /don du 'khor ba ༅yongs mi gtong ⑤ / /ji ltar rgyal ba'i sras rnams sems can la/ /byams pa la sogs sems pa 'di 'byung ba⑨/ /sems can thams cad yon tan ldan pa yi/ /bu gcig pa la'ang de lta ma yin no/ /rab 'bar dgra yi dbang du song / /sdug bsngal 70—861

gyis non mun pas bsgribs①/ /bgrod dka'i lam la kun du zhugs/ /'ching ba che dang yang dag ldan/ /zas chen dug dang 'dres la zhen/ /lam ni rab tu stor gyur pa/ /lam gol rab zhugs stobs chung ba'i/ /sems can rnams la snying rje 'o/ /'tshe spangs byang chub mchog gi sa bon dang / /bde ba bskyed dang gdung byed 'dod pa'i rgyu/ /ngo bo nyid sbyin chos la rten ②pa yi/ /rgyal ba'i sras la byang chub thag mi ring / /snying rje blo mchog 'khor bar gtogs pa yi//sdug bsngal bdag nyid kun dang bdag med par①/ /rnam par shes nas skyo bar mi 'gyur zhing / /nyes pas rab gnod par yang mi 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten sdug bsngal bdag nyid lta ba yi/ /brtse dang ldan pas sdug bsngal de dang ni//de yongs spong ④ba'i thabs kyang ji bzhin rig /nyam nga bar byed skyo bar yang mi 'gyur/ /snying rje'i bdag nyid can gyi brtse ba 'di/ /rang bzhin dang ni so sor brtags ⑤pa dang / /de sngon goms par byas dang ldan pa dang / /mi mthun phyogs nyams rnam dag thob pa bzhi/ /mnyam dang rtag min lhag pa'i bsam pas min/ /sgrub pa'i sgo dang ⑥'dod chags bral ba dang / /mi dmigs pas min gang de brtse min te/ /de bzhin brtse med gang de byang chub min / /snying rje dang ni bzod dang sems pa dang / /smon lam skye ba sems can yongs smin byed/ /dang po rtsa ba tha ma 'bras mchog ldan/ /'di ni snying rje'i ljon shing chen po yin/ /rtsa ba snying rje med gyur na/ /dka' spyod bzod pa nyid mi 'gyur/ /blo ldan sdug bsngal mi bzod na/ /sems can don sems nyid mi 'gyur/ /sems pa dang ni bral ba'i blo/ /skye ba dkar po rnam dag tu//smon lam 'debs par mi 'gyur ro/ /skye ba bzang po ma thob na/ /sems 70—862

can yongs smin byed mi 'gyur/ /snying rje'i 'chu ①ba byams pa ste/ /de sdug bsngal na bde ba yis/ /sangs ②rgyas tshul bzhin yid byed pas/ /yal ①ga rgya chen 'phel ba dang / /smon lam rgyun ni ma bcad pas/ /lo ma 'dor len rkyen rnam ④gnyis/ /grub pa de phyir me tog dang / /'bras bu don yod shes par bya/ /snying rje chen po yon tan 'byung gnas kyi/ /sems can rnams la snying rje su mi byed/ /'di ltar 'di dag la ni sdug bsngal yang / /brtses bskyed bde ba gzhal du med pa 'byung / /snying rjes zin pa'i brtser ⑤ldan rnams / /zhi la'ang yid ni mi gnas na/ /'jig rten bde dang rang srog la//chags par 'gyur ba smos ci dgos/ / byams pa gang de kha na ma tho ba/ /med dang 'jig rten 'das pa yod ma ④yin/ /blo ldan rnams kyi brtse bas byams pa ni / /kha na ma tho med cing 'jig rten 'das/ /sdug bsngal rba rgal ༅che dang mi shes pa'i/ /mun pa che la rten ⑧par gyur pa yi/ /'jig rten 'dren pa'i thabs gang yin pa de/ /ji ltar kha na ma tho med mi 'gyur/ /'jig rten byang chub rang sangs rgyas pa yi⑨/ /dgra bcom rnams la byams pa de med na/ /de las gzhan la smos kyang ci dgos pa/ /ji ltar 'jig rten 'das pa ma yin 'gyur / /byang chub sems dpa' sdug bsngal med/ /brtse bas sdug bsngal gyur pa ⑩gang / /de la dang por kun tu skrag /reg nas shin tu mngon par dga' / /brtse bas bskyed pa'i sdug bsngal 'jig rten gyi/ /bde ba thams cad zil gyis gnon 'gyur zhing / /don byas rnams kyang de dang mi ldan gang / /de las ngo mtshar che ba ci zhig yod/ /brtan ⑪pa'i brtse dang ldan pa'i sbyin pa yis / /sbyin pa'i bde ba byed pa gang yin pa/ /de la khams gsum nye bar spyad 70—863

rnams kyi/ /bde ba de yis char yang mi phod ①do/ /sems can don phyir brtse bas sdug bsngal gyi/ /rang bzhin 'khor ba gang yin mi gtong ⑤na/ /snying rje can rnams gzhan la phan pa'i phyir/ /sdug bsngal ci ste khas len byed mi 'gyur//brtse dang ldan pa'i snying rje'i sbyin pa gang ①/ /longs spyod dang ni de las byams pa dang / /rjes su gzung bas bskyed dang de yi mthus/ /byas pa'i bde ba ④rtag tu 'phel bar 'gyur/ /snying rjes ⑤rgyas par bya zhing 'phel bar bya/ /sbyin pas ⑥yongs smin bya zhing bde bar bya/ /kun du drang bar bya zhing bkri bya zhes / /zhen pa rnams la rab tu smra dang 'dra/ /snying rjes sdug bsngal dag gis sdug bsngal ba/ /bde ma bskyed par gang gis bde bar 'gyur/ /de phyir brtse dang ldan pas gzhan bde ba/ /bskyed nas bdag nyid bde bar byed pa yin / /snying rje can ni rtag tu rang sbyin la/ /ston dang 'dra ste rang bde mi 'dod pa/ /longs spyod rnams kyis gzhan dag bde bar gyis/ /yang na tha dad min bde bdag la'ang min/ /de bdes bde ba bdag gis sbyin pa ni/ /'bras dang bcas te sems can rnams la byin/ /gal te khyod kyis bdag la bya ba yod/ /de dag nyid la shin tu 'bras bur khyabyos/ /sbyin pa po ni longs spyod mi 'dod kyang / /longs spyod shin tu mang la bzang dang phrad⑤/ /bdag ni bde ba de 'dod ma yin te/ /'di ltar bdag ni sbyin la brgyud dang ldan/ /bdag ni rtag tu brtse bas bdog pa kun/ /yongs su gtong ④ba gang yin de ltos la/ / des na ༅khyod kyis bdag ni de'i ⑫'bras la/ /don gnyer med pa nyid du shes par bya/ /gal te khyod 'bras thob pa mi gtong ⑫na/ /sbyin la mngon dga' yin par mi 'gyur te/ /'di ltar skad cig tsam yang sbyin med na//70—864

sbyin la mngon par dga' ba nyid ma yin/ /ma byas pa la 'bras bu mi 'byin te//'di ltar lan bltas bdag gi cha ma yin/ /khyod kyi lan la lta dang bral bas na//'bras bu shin tu gzhan la gtong ①ba yin/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi brtse bas sbyin pa ni/ /kha na ma tho med cing dag pa'i gzhi/ /bde ba ⑤'dren par byed pa nyid dang ni/ /rjes su srung ①bcas tshol med gos ④pa med/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi brtse bas sbyin pa ni/ /mtha' dag rgya che ④gtso dang rtag pa dang / /dga' dang zang zing med dang dag pa dang / /byang chub la gzhol dge la gzhol ba yin//ji ltar bde ba gsum gyis tshim pa'i yid/ /brtse ldan yongs su gtong ④bas dga' 'gyur ba/ /longs spyod can dag nye bar spyad pa yis/ /de ltar dga' bar 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /bkren la brtse dang ma rungs pa la brtse/ /kun 'khrugs ④la brtse bag med rnams la brtse/ /yul gyi gzhan dbang can la snying rje ⑧dang / /log par mngon par zhen la snying rje 'o/ /bde dang sdug bsngal bde rgyu las/ /byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje ste/ /rgyu dang bshes gnyen rang bzhin las/ /byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje 'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje ni/ /mnyam par shes bya de bsam phyir/ /sgrub phyir 'dod chags bral phyir dang / /mi dmigs phyir dang dag phyir ro/ /rang gi sems kyis byams la sogs/ /sgom pa chos la mos pa dang / /bsam dang dbang 'byor nyid dang ni/ /rnam par mi rtog gcig phyir mchog /de ltar bcom ldan 'das la dang ba rab skyes shing / /rdzas dang bkur sti chen pos shin tu rgyun mchod ldan//yon tan mang ldan phan byed shes khyal rtag sten ༅pa/ /'gro la rjes su brtse ba grub pa kun thob 'gyur/ / theg pa chen po mdo sde'i rgyan las⑫/ mchod pa dang bsten ⑫70—865

pa dang tshad med pa'i le'u ste bco brgyad pa'o①// //ngo tsha mi mthun phyogs spangs dang / /rnam par ②mi rtog ye shes ldan/ /kha na ma tho med dman yul/ /sems can smin byed brtan ⑤pa'i yin/ /pha rol phyin pa drug po yi④/ /mi mthun phyogs ni 'phel ba dang / /gnyen po 'grib pas byang chub sems/ /mi zad ④ngo tsha skye bar 'gyur/ /brtan rnams pha rol phyin pa drug /brtan ⑥pa la ni le lo dang / /nyon mongs rjes su mthun chos la/ /sbyor ba las kyang ngo mtshar 'gyur/ /mnyam gzhag ngo bo nyid min chung / /'bring dang dman pa'i sa pa dang / /bsam pa dman dang ngar bcas pa'i/ /ngo tsha dman de las gzhan lhag /blo ldan khrel med tshul min las / /nyon mongs dang len khro ba ④dang / /yal bar 'dor dang nga rgyal gyis / /sems can rnams dang tshul khrims 'joms/ /'gyod pas nyams dang bcas 'gyur zhing / /bkur sti dman pa thob ⑤'gyur des/ /dad ldan mi min tshogs dang ni/ /ston pas kyang ni btang snyoms mdzad/ /rgyal sras chos dang mthun rnams kyis/ /rnam par smod cing 'jig rten las/ /mthong ba'i chos la mi snyan 'thob/ /gzhan du phyir zhing mi khom skye/ /des ⑨na chos dkar thob pa dang / /ma thob pa las rnam ⑫nyams 'gyur/ /de phyir sdug bsngal gnas pa dang / /yid kyang rnal du mi gnas 'gyur/ /rgyal sras ngo tsha ldan rnams la/ /nyes pa 'di dag kun mi 'byung / /mkhas pa rtag tu lha dag dang / /mi rnams su ni yang dag skye/ /blo ldan ngo tshas myur du ni/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub tshogs rdzogs byed/ /rgyal ba'i sras ni sems can rnams/ /70—866

smin byed skyo bar mi 'gyur nyid/ /de rtag ①mi mthun phyogs dang ni/ /gnyen po bral ②dang mi 'bral 'gyur/ /de ltar rgyal sras ngo tsha ldan/ /phan yon de dag 'thob ①par 'gyur/ /byis pa shin tu gos bzang gyon yang ni/ /khrel dang bral phyir nyes pas ④dri ma can/ /rgyal sras ngo tsha shes pa'i gos can ni/ /dgab pa med kyang nyes pa'i dri ma bral/ /rgyal ba'i sras ni khrel dang ldan gyur pa//nam mkha' bzhin du chos kyis gos mi ①'gyur/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi nang du 'dus gyur pa/ /ngo tsha shes pas brgyan pa mdzes pa yin/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni ngo tsha bas/ /gdul bya rnams la ma bzhin byams pa nyid/ /ngo tsha ba ni nyes pa thams cad las/ /'khor ba kun tu srung ④bar byed pa'ang yin / /kun la dang du len pa dang / /kun la dang du mi len cing ④/ /kun la mi 'jug 'jug pa ni/ /khrel ldan khrel bas byas pa'i rtags/ /rang gi ⑤sems kyis khrel sgom pa/ /chos la mos dang bsam pa dang / /dbang 'byor pa dang mi rtog dang / /gcig pa nyid kyis gtso bo yin/ /byang chub sems dpa'i brtan ④pa ni/ /de las gzhan pa thams cad las/ /mtshan nyid dang ni rab dbye dang / /mi 'gyur bas ni khyad par 'phags/ /brtson 'grus ting 'dzin shes rab ni/ /snying stobs sran thub brtan par 'dod/ /gang phyir gsum gyis byang chub sems/ /'jigs pa ༅med par rab tu 'jug /zhum dang g.yo dang rmongs pa yis/ /bya ba rnams la 'jigs pa skye/ /de phyir gnyug ma gsum la ni/ /brtan ⑪pa'i ming du shes par bya/ /rang bzhin dang ni smon lam dang / /lta ba med pa nyid dang ni/ /sems can log par sgrub pa dang / /zab cing rgya che thos pa dang / /gdul bya gdul kyibar dka' ba dang //70—867

rgyal sku bsam gyis mi khyab dang / /dka' ①ba dag ni sna tshogs dang / /'khor ba gtong ba med nyid dang ⑤/ /de nyid nyon mongs ①med pa la/ /brtan pa'i brtan ④pa skye ba ni/ /de las gzhan dang mi mtshungs te/ /brtan ldan ⑤rnams kyi ①mchog tu 'dod/ /phye ma leb dang 'dab chags dang / /rgya mtsho dag gis ri rab ltar/ /brtan pa grogs ngan sdug bsngal dang / /zab mo thos pas mi g.yos so/ /byang chub mi skyo mnyam med pa/ /gzhi spyogasum thos pas mi ngoms dang / /brtson 'grus che dang sdug bsngal la'o/ /ngo tsha brtan la brten ⑧pa ste/ /byang chub che la 'dun pa dag④ /blo ldan rnams ⑫kyi mi skyo ba / /sa rnams la ni ma rdzogs dang / /rdzogs dang shin tu rdzogs par 'dod/ /brtan pa'i bstan bcos shes pa nyid/ /gzhi ⑫dang ched du bya ba dang / /las dang mtshan nyid dag dang ni/ /mi zad ⑫nyid dang 'bras bu ni/ /yang dag 'grub pas khyad par 'phags/ /ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs ⑫sgos bsdus/ /sems can smin par byed pa dang / /dam chos 'dzin par byed pa'ang yin/ /brtan ⑫rnams 'jig rten shes pa nyid/ /lus dang ngag dang ⑫yid dag gis⑫/ /bden pa shes pas mnyam pa med/ /de las gzhan pa dag las 'phags/ /brtan rnams rtag tu 'dzum par byed/ /gsong po dag tu smra ba yin/ /sems can snod du bya ba'i phyir/ /dam chos bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir/ /gang phyir bden pa gnyis kyis ni/ /'jig rten rnams rtag ⑫'byung bar 'dod/ /gnyis kyis khya nub 'gyur de yi phyir/ /de shes 'jig rten shes zhes bya/ /de dag zhi ba ⑫thob bya'i phyir/ /blo ldan bden pa rnams la ④sbyor/ /gang gis 0 blo ldan bden shes phyir/ /'jig rten shes zhes nges par brjod/ /gtsug 70—868

lag brtan ①pa'i chos dang ni/ /de don dgongs pa can dang ni/ /nges don tshad mar ldan pa dang / /de yi brjod med thob pa 'o/ /spong dang ji skad bshad pa dang / /'gog ⑤par yang dag shes pa dang / /brjod dang bcas par 'thob ①pa dag /'dir ni dgag par bstan pa yin/ /mos dang rnam par dpyod pa dang / /gzhan las sdeji bzhin thos pa dang / /rjod khyapa med pa'i ye shes las/ /brtan ④rnams nyams par mi 'gyur ro/ /rnam grangs dang ni mtshan nyid dang / /tshig dang ye shes shes pa'i phyir/ /byang chub sems dpa'i yang dag rig /bzhi po mtshungs pa med par 'dod/ /bstan pa la ni rab brtson pa'i/ /gang zhig ④gang gis ston pa ni/ /chos dang don ni gnyis po dag /tshig dang shes pa kho nas ston/ /chos ni bstan dang bshad phyir dang / /rnam pa kun du gnyis thob phyir/ /rgol ba rnams kyi lan 'debs phyir/ /so so yang dag rig ④pa bzhi/ /mnyam nyid so so rang rig nas④ / /phyis ni rab tu shes pa yin/ /the tshom thams cad gcod byed pa/ /so so yang dag rig par ⑩brjod/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshogs/ /bsod nams ye shes mtshungs pa med/ /gcig gis 'khor bar mngon mtho byed//gzhan gyis nyon mongs med par 'khor/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bsod nams kyi//tshogs yin shes rab ye shes kyi/ /gsum po gzhan ni gnyis ga'i ⑪ste/ /lnga car ⑫yang ni ye shes tshogs/ /rgyun du sgom pa thob nas ni/ /dge la yang dang ⑫yang du sgrub/ /brtan ⑫pa'i tshogs gang yin pa de/ /don kun sgrub par byed pa yin/ /'jug dang mtshan ma ⑫med pa dang / /lhun gyis grub par bya ba dang / /dbang bskur mthar thug ⑫bya ba'i phyir/ /brtan 8rnams tshogs 70—869

ni sgrub par byed/ /blo ldan dran pa nyer gzhag pa/ /bsgom ①pa rnam pa bcu bzhi yis/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i phyir na de/ /de las gzhan las khyad par 'phags / /rten dang gnyen po dag dang ni/ /de bzhin rjes su ⑤'jug pa dang / /dmigs pa dang ni yid byed dang / /thob pas bsgom ①pa khyad par 'phags / /mthun dang rjes su 'jug pa dang / /yongs su shes dang skye ba dang / /chen po dang ni mchog nyid dang / /bsgom ④dang yang dag 'grub ⑤pas gzhan/ /brtan ④pa rnams kyi yang dag spong / /lus can rnams dang mtshungs pa med/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa yi/ /nyes pa rnams kyi ④gnyen por bsgom / /'khor ba ⑤nye bar spyad pa dang / /sgrib pa dag ni dor ba dang / /yid la byed pa dor ba dang / /sa rnams la ni 'jug pa dang / /mtshan ma med par gnas pa dang / /lung bstan pa ni thob pa dang / /sems can rnams yongs ⑨smin bya dang / /dbang ni bskur bar bya ba dang / /zhing rnams dag par bya phyir dang / /mthar thug nyid du bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan rnams/ /mi mthun phyogs kyi gnyen por bsgom⑩/ /'dun pa la ni brten nas su/ /rnal 'byor rgyu mtshan bcas bsgom ⑫pa/ /yang dag spong ba thams cad la/ /gnyen po zhes ni nges par brjod/ /brtan pa rnams kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi/ /rkang pa mtshan nyid mchog ldan bzhi/ /bdag nyid dang ni gzhan dag gi/ /don kun 'grub ⑫pa'i phyir skye 'o/ /rten dang rab tu dbye ba dang / /thabs dang mngon par sgrub pa yis/ /blo ldan rdzu 'phrul rkang pa rnams/ /rnam pa kun tu rnam gzhag 'dod/ /bsam gtan pha rol phyin brten nas/ /rab tu dbye ba dag dang thabs/ /rnam bzhi tsamangon par sgrub 70—870

pa ni/ /rnam pa drug tu brjod pa yin/ /gcig ni 'bad par byed pa ste/ /gnyis pa phan ①'dogs bdag nyid yin/ /gsum pa gtod par byed pa ste/ /bzhi pa gnyen po pa yin no/ /mthong ba dang ni gdams ngag dang / /gnas pas ④rnam par rtse ①ba dang / /smon lam dang ni dbang dag dang / /chos thob pa ni sgrub pa'i phyir/ /byang chub spyod dang thos mchog dang / /zhi gnas lhag mthong dad sogs kyi/ /gzhi yin par ni shes bya ste/ /don sgrub ④byed pa'i skabs kyis so/ /dad sogs sa la 'jug ⑤pa ste/ /kun nas nyon mongs can du 'dod/ /mi mthun phyogs nyam ④chung bas yang / /de dag nyid la stobs zhes bya/ /sar zhugs ④rnams la byang chub kyi/ /yan lag rnam par gzhag par 'dod④/ /chos rnams dang ni sems can kun/ /mnyam pa nyid du rtogs phyir ro/ /shes byas ⑨rgyal rgyal bya yi ⑫phyir/ /dran pa dag ni kun tu spyod / /'di yi rnam 'byed rtog pa yi/ /mtshan ma thams cad 'joms par byed / /'di yi brtson 'grus ma lus pa/ /myur du rtogs par bya phyir 'jug⑩/chos kyi snang ba rnam 'phel ba'i⑫/ /dga' bas rtag tu rgyas par 'gyur/ /sgrib pa kun las thar ba'i phyir/ /shin tu sbyangs pas bde ba 'thob/ /ting nge 'dzin las bsams pa'i don/ /'byor ba nye bar skye bar 'gyur/ /btang snyoms kyis ni thams cad du/ /'di ni ji ltar 'dod bzhin gnas/ /rjes la rte thob dang mi rtog pa'i/ /gnas pas ༅mchog ni rtag tu gnas/ /yon tan de lta'i sems dpa' ni/ /'khor los ⑫sgyur ba 'dra bar 'jog⑩ /rtag tu rin chen bdun lta bu'i/ /byang chub yan lag rnams kyis bskor/ /rang bzhin yan lag gnas yan lag /gsum pa nges 'byung yan lag ste/ /bzhi pa phan 70—871

yon yan lag yin/ /rnam gsum nyon mongs med yan lag /de yi 'og tu ji lta ba① / /rtogs pa'i rjes su 'jug pa ste②/ /rnam gzhag ji bzhin rtogs pa dang / /rnam par gzhag la 'jug pa dang / /las gsum rnam par dag pa dang / /shes bya dag dang lam dang ni/ /yon tan khyad par can gyi ni/ /sgrib pa'i gnyen por sgom ⑤pa 'o/ /yang dag gnas pa la brten nas/ /sems la sems ni 'jog phyir dang / /chos rab rnam par 'byed pa'i phyir/ /zhi gnas dang ni lhag mthong yin/ /de ni kun 'gro cha gcig dang / /cha gcig ma yin rgyur 'dod do/ /rtogs dang nges par 'byung ba dang / /mtshan med 'du mi byed pa dang / /yongs dag rnam par dag pa la/ /brten pa'i zhi gnas lhag mthong gi/ /rnal 'byor de sa ①kun 'gro ①ste/ /thams cad sgrub par byed pa yin/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams rdzogs bya dang / /sems can rnams yongs smin bya dang / /myur thob bya ba 'grub pa dang / /lam ④rgyun mi gcod la mkhas pa/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa kun la/ /thabs ni mtshungs pa med pa ste//thabs mkhas de la brten nas ni/ /de dag don kun sgrub par byed/ /rnam smin thos la goms pa dang / /ting nge 'dzin gyi gzungs dag ni/ /chung ngu dang rgo chen po ste/ /chen po de yang rnam pa gsum/ /blo ldan ma zhugs zhugs pa yang / /ma dag sa pa rnams kyi ni/ /chung ngu dang ni 'bring po ste/ /dag pa'i sa pa'i gzungs chen yin/ /byang chub sems dpa' yang dang yang / /de la yang dag brten nas ni/ /rtag tu dam pa'i chos dag kyang / /rab tu ston cing 'dzin par byed༅/ /brtan pa rnams kyi smon lam ni/ /sems pa 'dun dang bcas pa ste/ /de ni ye shes kyis bskul ba/ /sa rnams kun la mnyam pa 70—872

med / /de ni rgyu gyur ①shes bya ste/ /sems tsam las ni 'grub pa'i phyir/ /sems las mod la 'bras bu can/ /de ni ma 'ongs don 'grub ②byed/ /sna tshogs che dang byang chub par/ /sa rnams gong nas gong du ni/ /rnam dag byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /rang bzhin ②don rab sgrub byed yin/ /ting 'dzin gsum gyi ④spyod yul ni/ /bdag med rnam pa gnyis po dang / /bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rten dang ni/ /de rtag nyer zhi yin zhes bya/ /de ni gzung 'dzin ngo bo'i phyir/ / rnam pa ⑤gsum du shes par bya/ /rnam par mi rtog rgyab kyis phyogs/ /rab ④tu dga' dang ldan pa 'o/ /yongs su shes dang spang ba dang / /mngon sum du ni ④bya ba'i phyir/ /stong nyid la sogs ting 'dzin rnams / /don rnam ⑤gsum du yongs su ⑨bsgrags/ /sems can rnams la phan bzhed pas/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyu nyid du/ /chos kyi sdom ni rnam pa bzhi//byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bshad/ /brtan ⑫pa rnams kyi bzhi po de⑫/ /med pa'i don dang rnam rtog don/ /kun du rtog don kho na dang / /rnam rtog nye bar zhi ba'i don/ /mi rung rgyu las skye phyir dang / /'gal phyir rang nyid mi gnas phyir/ /med phyir mtshan nyid nges phyir dang / /rjes su 'jug phyir 'gag pa'i phyir/ /yongs su 'gyur ba dmigs phyir dang / /de ༅rgyu nyid dang 'bras bu'i phyir/ /zin pa'i phyir dang bdag po'i phyir/ /dge yidang sems can rjes 'jug phyir/ /dang po chaje bas je yiche dang / /rgyas dang rten gyi ⑩ dngos po dang / /'gyur dang yongs su smin pa dang / /de bzhin dman dang khyad par 'phags/ /'od gsal ba dang 'od mi gsal/ /yul gzhan 'gro dang sa bon bcas/ /sa bon med pa'i ngo bo dang / /gzugs brnyan du ni skye 70—873

ba ste༅ / /skye ba rnam pa bcu bzhi la/ /rgyu dang tshad kyi khyad par dang / /rgyas pa don med mi rung dang / /rten nyid du ni mi srid dang / /gnas pa la ni mi srid dang / /dang po mi 'jig mthar mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin dman dang ②khyad par 'phags/ /'od gsal ba dang 'od mi gsal/ /'gro med gnas pa mi rung dang / /tha ma nyid ni mi srid phyir①/ /sems kyi rjes su 'jug pa'i phyir/ /'dus byas thams cad skad cig ma/ /'byung ba rnams dang don rnam drug /skad cig nyid du brjod pa ni/ /skam dang 'phel dang rang bzhin gyis/ /g.yo dang 'phel dang 'grib pa'i phyir/ /'byung ba de dang 'phel ④phyir dang / /yongs su 'gyur ba bzhi yi 3phyir/ /kha dog dri dang ro dang reg /'dra phyir de ni de dang 'dra/ /bud shing rag las 'jug pa'i phyir/ /je bas je cher dmigs pa'i phyir/ /sems rjes 'jug phyir dri ba'i ④phyir/ /des na ④phyi yang skad cig ma/ /gang zag btags par yod nyid du/ /brjod bya rdzas su ma yin no/ /mi dmigs phyin ci log pa dang / /kun nas nyon mongs nyon mongs rgyu⑤/ /nyes pa gnyis phyir de las 'di/ /gcig dang gzhan du brjod bya min/ /phung po bdag 1tu thal ba dang / /de rdzas nyid du thal 'gyur phyir/ /gal te rdzas yod brjod min pa'i/ /dgos ⑩pa yang ni brjod dgos so/ /gcig dang gzhan du brjod min pa/ /dgos pa med par mi rigs so/ /mtshan nyid dang ni 'jig rten na/ /mthong phyir bstan bcos sgo nas kyang / /bud shing me bzhin gnyis su ni/ /brjod min mi rung gnyis ⑪phyir ro/ /gnyis yod rnam shes skye ba'i phyir/ /de rkyen ma yin don med phyir/ /de phyir lta ba po nas ni/ /grol po'i ⑫bar du mi 'gyur ro/ /bdag po nyid cig yin 70—874

na ni/ /mi rtag mi 'dod 'byung mi byed/ /de yis ①mtshan nyid bsgrub ⑤dgos te/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub gsum la gnod/ /nyes pa gsum phyir lta sogs la/ /de yi byed pa rang 'byung ④min/ /byed pa de yi rkyen can yang / /lta sogs byed pa med pa yin/ /byed pa ①min phyir mi rtag phyir/ /cig car rtag tu 'jug pa'i phyir/ /lta la sogs pa'i byed pa ni/ /rang byung ④nyid du mi rung ngo / /de bzhin gnas dang zhig pa ni/ /snga na med dang mi rtag dang / /phyogs gsum po yang med pa'i phyir/ /rkyen nyid du ni ④mi rung ngo / /'di ltar chos rnams thams cad ni/ /bdag med dam pa'i don du na/ /stong nyid bdag tu dmigs pa ni/ /nyes par bshad pa kho na yin/ /kun nas nyon mongs rnam byang ba'i/ /gnas skabs gcod pa'i bye brag dang / /'jug dang rgyun gyi bye brag kyang / /gang zag gis ni nye bar bstan/ /bdag tu lta ba bskyed mi dgos/ /goms pa thog ma med dus can/ /gang zag yod na thams cad ni/ /'bad med thar pa'am thar pa med/ /de ltar yon tan de dag dang / /rtag ldan byang chub sems dpa' ni/ / rang gi ④don yang mi 'dor zhing / /gzhan gyi don yang sgrub par byed/ / theg pa chen po mdo sde'i rgyan las / kye byang chub kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i le'u ste bcu dgu pa'o⑨// //rang gi lus dang sdom pa'i phyir/ /phun sum tshogs pa yongs gtong dang //nyam chung rnams la bzod pa dang ⑫/ /lus dang srog la mi lta bar/ /brtson 'grus rtsom dang bsam gtan kyi⑩/ /bde la ro ⑫myang med nyid dang / /shes rab la ni mi rtog pa/ /blo ldan rnams kyi ngo mtshar 'dod/ /de bzhin 70—875

gshegs rigs skye ba dang / /lung bstan pa dang dbang bskur dang / /byang chub rab tu thob pa yang / /ngo mtshar che ba yin par 'dod/ /'dod chags bral dang snying brtse ༅dang / /de bzhin bsgom ⑤mchog thob pa dang / /sems mnyam phyir na de dag la/ /sbyor ba ngo mtshar che ma yin/ /ji ltar blo ldan sems can la/ /rab tu byams par gyur pa ltar/ /sems can bdag dang chung ma dang / /bu bshes ①gnyen la de lta ④min/ /don gnyer ba la phyogs med dang / /tshul khrims rtag tu ma nyams dang / /kun du bzod cing thams cad phyir/ /brtson 'grus chen po rtsom ⑤pa dang / /rtag tu bsam gtan dge ba dang / /shes rab rnam par mi rtog nyid/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag la / /de ltar sems mnyam shes par bya/ /snod nyid du ni byed pa dang / /tshul khrims dag la 'god pa dang / /gnod pa la ni bzod pa dang / /don byed par ni 'gro ba dang / /bstan pa 'di la ⑥'dzud pa dang / /the tshom gcod par byed pa 'di/ /blo ldan rnams kyi sems can la/ /phan 'dogs nyid du 'dod pa yin/ /gang dag rtag tu sems can rnams/ /bsam pa mnyam pas 'dzin byed cing / /'phags pa'i sa la skyed ④pa dang / /dge ba 'phel bar byed pa dang / /nyes byas las ni yongs srung dang / /thos ⑤pa byang bar byed pa ni/ /las lnga dag gis rgyal sras rnams/ /sems can ma dang 'dra ba yin/ /sems can kun la rtag ⑨par ni/ /dad pa skyed par ⑩ byed pa dang / /lhag pa'i khrims sogs slob ⑫pa dang / /rnam par grol la sbyor ba'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas la ni gsol ba dang / /de dag sgrib pa spong ba'i phyir / /las lnga dag gis rgyal sras rnams/ /sems can pha dang 'dra ba yin//70—876

gang dag bstan par mi 'os pa①/ /sems can rnams la gsang byed cing / /bslab las nyams la smod pa dang / /phun sum tshogs pa ⑤bsngags pa nyid/ /gdams ngag sbyin par byed pa dang / /bdud rnams spron ①par byed pa ste/ /las lnga dag gis rgyal sras rnams/ /sems can rtsa lag 'dra ba yin/ /kun nas nyon mongs rnam byang la/ /gang dag rang blo ma 'khrul ba/ /'jig rten 'jig rten min pa yi/ /phun tshogs zad par sbyin par byed/ /skyo ba med pas ④mi phyed cing / /rtag tu phan dang bde 'dod pa/ /las lnga dag gis rgyal sras rnams/ /sems can grogs po 'dra ba yin/ /gang dag sems can smin bya la/ /rtag tu brtson pa dang ldan zhing / /yang dag nges par 'byung ba ⑤smra / /log par sgrub pa rnams la bzod/ /phun sum tshogs pa gnyis sbyin byed / /de yi ④thabs la mkhas pa ni/ /las lnga dag gis rgyal sras rnams/ /sems can bran dang 'dra ba yin/ /gang dag mi skye'i ④chos la ni/ /bzod pa thob par 'dod pa dang / /theg pa thams cad ston pa dang / /rnal 'byor grub ⑤par sbyor ba dang / /bzhin mdzes lan du phan 'dogs ⑨dang / /rnam par smin la mi lta ba/ /las lnga dag gis rgyal sras rnams/ /sems can slob dpon 'dra ba yin/ /sems can don la shin tu brtson/ /tshogs rnams rdzogs par byed pa dang / /tshogs bsags myur du grol bar byed/ /mi mthun phyogs ni spong byed cing / /'jig rten 'jig rten ma yin pa'i/ /phun sum tshogs pa la sbyor ba/ /las lnga dag gis rgyal sras rnams/ /sems can mkhan po 'dra ba yin⑫/ /longs spyod rnams la ma chags dang / /tshul khrims nyams pa med pa dang / /byas pa gzo dang ldan pa dang / /sgrub pa la yang sbyor ba'i 70—877

phyir / /pha rol phyin pa drug po la/ /de ltar 'jug pa'i lus can dag /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la ni/ /de bzhin lan du phan 'dogs yin/ /rtag tu 'phel dang nyams pa dang / /sems can rab tu smin pa dang / /sa la khyad par 'gro ba dang / /bla na med pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /'jigs spang ①yang dag bskyed pa dang / /the tshom dag ni gcod pa dang / /sgrub pa yi ⑤ni gdams ngag la/ /rgyal sras rtag tu chud mi za/ /re ba med pa'i sbyin pa dang / /yang srid mi 'dod tshul khrims dang / /thams cad la ni bzod pa dang / /yon tan kun 'byung brtson 'grus dang / /de bzhin bsam gtan gzugs med min / /shes rab thabs dang ldan pa ni/ /pha rol phyin pa drug po la/ /brtan ①pa rnams kyi yang dag sbyor/ /longs spyod chags dang nyams bcas dang //nga rgyal nyid dang bsod nyams dang / /ro myang ba dang rnam rtog ni/ /brtan pa rnams kyi nyams pa'i rgyu/ /de dag gnyen po la gnas pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ④ni/ /de las bzlog phyir khyad par gyi/ /skal can chos su shes par bya/ /sprul pa dang ni tshul 'chos dang / /bzhin mdzes pa ⑤ ni ston pa dang / /de bzhin 'phral ⑥la 'jug pa dang / /lus dang ngag ni zhi ba dang / /de bzhin smra mkhas phun sum tshogs/ /de dag sgrub dang bral ba ni//byang chub sems dpa' rnams ༅dag gi/ /yang dag min pa nyid du bshad/ /bzlog par ༅ rab tu sbyor rnams kyi/ /de dag yang dag nyid du bshad/ /blo ldan de dag sa kun du/ /sbyin la sogs pa nyer bsgrubs ⑨pas sems can rnams kyi mi mthun phyogs/ /rnam pa drug ⑫ni 'dul bar byed/ /gang zag dus kyi bye brag gis/ /blo ldan lung bstan rnam pa gnyis/ /byang chub dang ni 70—878

lung ston pa①/ /gzhan yang chen por brjod pa ni/ /mi skye bzod pa thob pa yi⑤ /nga rgyal rtsol ba spangs pa dang / /sangs rgyas sras bcas ①thams cad dang / /ngo bo gcig tu gyur pa las/ /yang de zhing dang ming dang ni/ /dus dang bskal pa'i ming dang ni/ /'khor dang dam pa'i chos dag kyang / /gnas pa'i sgo nas der 'dod do/ /blo ldan rnam pa thams cad du/ /phun tshogs skyed ④dang mi skyo dang / /rtag tu sgom par byed pa dang / /ting 'dzin nyams pa med pa dang / /bya ba 'grub dang lhun grub ①pa'i/ /bzod pa 'thob la ⑥nges par 'gyur⑦ / /mchod bslab yang dag blang ba dang / /snying rje dge ba bsgom pa dang / /de bzhin dgon par bag yod dang / /thos don ngoms mi shes pa nyid / /sa rnams kun la brtan pa yi⑤/ /gdon mi za bar bya ba nyid/ /'dod pa'i nyes dmigs shes pa dang / /'khrul pa dag la rtog pa dang / /sdug bsngal dang du len nyid dang / /dge ba dag ༷ni sgom pa dang / /bde la ro myang med nyid dang / /mtshan ma rnam par mi rtog pa/ /sa rnams kun la brtan pa yi/ /rtag tu bya ba dag yin no/ /chos sbyin tshul khrims dag pa dang / /mi skye bzod pa thob nyid ⑩dang / /theg chen brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / /mtha' la snying rje ldan gnas dang / /shes rab blo dang ldan rnams kyi⑫/ /pha rol phyin pa'i gtso bor 'dod/ /mdo sogs rnam pa'i bye brag gis/ /rig pa'i gnas ni rnam gzhag pa/ /sa rnams kun la brtan pa yi/ /chos rnams gzhag pa yin zhes bya/ /de bzhin nyid ni rnam bdun la/ /brten nas bden pa ⑫rnam par gzhag/ /rigs pa theg pa rnam gzhag pa/ /rnam pa bzhi dang rnam gsum nyid/ /tshul bzhin yid la byed pa dang / /yang dag lta ba 'bras 70—879

ldan dang / /tshad mas rnam 'byed bsam mi khyab/ /rigs pa bzhir ni shes par bya/ /bsam pa dang ni bshad nyid dang / /sbyor ba dang ni tshogs dag dang / / 'grub pa'i ①rab tu dbye ba yis/ /theg pa rnam pa gsum du 'dod/ /ming dang dngos dag phan tshun du/ /glo bur ba ni nyid du btsal/ /'dogs ༅pa rnam pa gnyis po 'dir/ /de tsam nyid du ①tshol ba 'o / /thams cad dmigs su med pa'i phyir/ /yang dag ye shes rnam pa bzhi//sa rnams kun la brtan pa yi/ /don kun sgrub ④par byed par 'gyur/ /'ching ba yi ni rten dag dang / /longs spyod sa bon rgyu mtshan 'dir/ /sems dang sems las byung ba rnams/ /rten bcas sa bon bcas te bcings/ /mdun bzhag mtshan ma gang yin dang / /bdag nyid 'dug pa gang yin pa/ /thams cad rnam 'jig blo ldan gyis/ /byang chub mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /de bzhin nyid dmigs shes pa ④dang / /gnyis su 'dzin pa rnam spangs dang / /gnas ngan len lus mngon sum ④pa/ /blo ldan de zad byed par 'dod/ /de bzhin nyid dmigs ye shes ni/ /rnam pa tha dad med bsgoms shing / /yod dang med don mngon sum pa/ /rnam rtog dbang 'byor nyid ces bya/ /byis pa yang dag nyid bsgribs nas/ /yang dag ma yin kun du snang / /byang chub sems dpa' de bsal kyi nas/ /yang dag nyid ni kun du snang / /don med pa dang don yod dag /mi snang snang ba yin zhes bya/ /de ni gnas gzhan gyur pa ste/ /'dod dgur spyod phyir thar pa yin/ /don chen ⑤rnam pa thams cad du / /gzhan dang gzhan rigs mthun snang ba/ /bar chad byed yin de lta bas / /yongs shes byas nas de spang ⑨ngo / /yongs smin rnam par sbyang bya 70—880

dang / /thob bya smin par rung bya dang / /yang dag bshad pa'i dngos po ni/ /blo ldan rnams kyi dpag tu med/ /byang chub sems ni skye ba dang / /mi skye ba yi bzod pa nyid/ /dri med mig ni dman pa dang / /zag pa zad pa nyid dang ni / /dam chos yun ring ①gnas pa dang / /bye brag shes spyod ⑤longs spyod nyid / /de la zhugs pa blo ldan gyi/ /bshad pa'i 'bras bu yin zhes bya/ /dmigs pa che ba nyid dang ni/ /de bzhin sgrub pa gnyis dag dang / /ye shes brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / /thabs la mkhas par gyur pa dang / /yang dag 'grub ①pa chen po dang / /sangs rgyas phrin las chen po ste/ /chen po 'di dang ldan pa'i phyir/ /theg chen zhes ni nges par brjod/ /rigs dang chos la mos pa dang / /de bzhin sems ni bskyed pa dang / /sbyin la sogs pa sgrub pa dang / /skyon med pa la 'jug nyid dang / /sems can rnams yongs ༅smin byed dang / /zhing ni rnam par sbyong ba dang / /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa dang / /byang chub mchog dang ston pa 'o/ /gcig ni mos pa dang ldan pa/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa dag pa gzhan/ /mtshan ma dang ni mtshan med dang / /mngon par 'du byed med spyod pa/ /lnga po 'di dag sa kun la/ /byang chub sems dpa' yin zhes bya/ /'dod la ma chags las gsum rnam par dag /khro ba zil ༅gnon yon tan mchog lhur len/ /chos las mi g.yo de nyid zab mo mthong /byang chub dga' ldan byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /phan 'dogs 'dod dang gnod pa med lta dang / /gzhan gyi gnod pa dang du len pa dang / /brtan pa bag yod mang du thos pa dang / /gzhan gyi don brtson byang chub sems dpa' yin / /rang gis ༅yongs su gzung ba'i nyes dmigs shes/ /longs spyod ma 70—881

chags zhe la khon mi 'dzin/ /rnal 'byor rgyu mtshan la mkhas lta ngan med/ /nang du rab gnas byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /brtse dang ldan pa ngo tsha yon tan gnas/ /sdug bsngal dang len rang gi bde ma chags/ /dran gtso shin tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i bdag /theg pa mi 'khrugs byang chub sems dpa' yin / /sdug bsngal sel ba sdug bsngal mi byed nyid/ /sdug bsngal bzod pa sdug bsngal 'jigs pa med/ /sdug bsngal rnam grol sdug bsngal mi rtog pa/ /sdug bsngal khas len byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /chos la mi dga' rang bzhin chos la dga'/ /chos la smod cing chos la mngon par brtson/ /chos la dbang ba chos la mun pa med/ /chos gtsor byed pa byang chub sems dpa' yin//longs spyod bag yod nges la bag yod dang / /bsrung la bag yod dge la bag yod dang / /bde la bag yod chos la bag yod dang ①/ /theg pa bag yod byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /ma gus ngo tsha nyes chung ngo tsha dang / /mi bzod ngo tsha yongs nyams ngo tsha dang / /rnam 'phro ngo tsha lta chung ngo tsha dang / /theg gzhan ngo tsha byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /'di dang pha rol dang ni btang snyoms dang / /'du byed ldan dang dbang 'byor nyid thob dang / /mtshungs par ston dang 'bras bu chen po yis/ /byang chub sems dpa' phan 'dogs byed la 'jug /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /blo ldan nyid dang gsal ba'i mchog /rgyal sras rgyal ba'i gzhi dang ni/ /rgyal byed rgyal ba'i myu gu dang / /rtsal ldan dang ni 'phags mchog dang / /ded dpon dang ni grags mchog dang / /snying rje can dang bsod nams che/ /dbang phyug de bzhin chos dang ldan/ /de nyid bzang rtogs don chen legs rtogs dang / /70—882

don kun rtogs dang kun du ①rtogs pa dang / /thabs rnams rtogs par 'gyur ba'i ④khyad par rgyu①/ /des na byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya'o/ /bdag rjes rtogs dang lta ba phra rtogs dang / /rnam rig sna tshogs rnam par rtogs dang kun/ /yang dag min rtog yin par rtogs pa'i rgyu/ /des na byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya 'o/ /ma rtogs rtogs dang rjes su rtogs pa rtogs/ /dngos med rtogs dang rab tu skye ba rtogs/ /ma rtogs rtogs pa so sor rtogs pa'i rgyu/ /des na byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya 'o/ /don med rtogs dang don dam rtogs pa dang / /don kun rtogs dang mtha' dag don rtogs dang / /rtogs bya rtogs gzhi ④rtogs pa rtogs pa'i rgyu/ /des na byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya 'o/ /grub par gyur pa rtogs dang gnas rtogs dang / /lhums rjes rtogs dang rim pa rtogs pa dang / /rab tu rtogs dang the tshom bsal rtogs rgyur④/ /des na byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya 'o/ /blo dang ldan pa blo thob ma thob dang / /rab rjoganas rtogs dang ④rjes su rtogs pa dang / /so sor 'chad blo rjod ⑤med nga bcom dang / /nga can blo gros ma smin yang dag smin/ / theg pa chen po mdo sde'i rgyan las/spu yon tan gyi le'u ste nyi shu pa'o༅// //brtse dang snyan par smra ba dang / /brtan 7pa nyid dang lag brkyang nyid/ /dgongs pa zab mo nges 'grel pa/ /'di dag blo ldan rnams kyi rtags/ /yongs gzung ④mos pa thob pa dang / /mi skyo gnyis kyis bsdu spyoba'i phyir/ /bsam pa dang ni sbyor ⑫ba las/ / rtags lngar ⑫rnam par shes par ⑩bya/ /byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ni/ /khyim pa 'khor los sgyur ༅rnams su/ /gyur 70—883

nas skye ba thams cad du/ /sems can rnams kyi ①don byed do/ /sa rnams kun la blo ldan gyi⑤/ /rab byung len pas thob pa dang / /chos nyid kyis ni thob pa gzhan①/ /rab tu byung bar ④ston byed yin/ /rab tu byung ba'i phyogs dag ni/ /yon tan tshad med rnams dang ldan/ /de ltas sdom brtson khyim pa yi ༅/ /byang chub sems dpa' las khyad 'phags/ /sa rnams kun la brtan pa yi / /pha rol sdug pa'i 'bras bu dang / /'di la dge ba ④'jug 'dod dang / /mya ngan 'das par ⑤'dod pa dang / /ma dag rnam dag rab dag pa/ /sems can rnams la bsam par 'dod/ /sa rnams kun la blo ldan pa'i / /smon lam dang ni sems mnyam dang / /bdag por gyur pa dag dang ni / /'khor sdud pa yis yongs su 'dzin/ /blo ldan rnams kyi ⑨las dang ni/ /gzhan yang smon lam dag dang ni/ /ting nge 'dzin dang dbang 'byor pa'i/ /dbang gis skye bar 'dod pa yin/ /mtshan nyid gang zag bslab pa dang / /phung po grub pa rtags dang ni/ /nges pa'i tshig dang thob ⑩pa yis/ /gnas pa dang ni sa nyid do/ /stong pa nyid ni mchog rtogs nas/ /las rnams chud mi za bar gnas/ /bsam gtan rab bdes ༅gnas nas ni/ /de yi 'og tu 'dod par skye/ /de nas byang chub phyogs mthun rnams/ /'khor ba dag tu ⑫ yongs su bsngo/ /sems kun nyon mongs med par ni/ /sems can rnams yongs smin par byed/ /ched du bsams 3te skye bas na/ /kun nas nyon mongs rjes su srung / /bgrod ༅pa gcig pa'i lam dang 'brel/ /mtshan med gcig tu nges pa'i lam/ /mtshan ma med par lhun gyis grub/ /zhing yang rnam par sbyong ba ste/ /de yi 'og tu sems can ni/ /smin par byed pa 'grub ⑫ 70—884

par 'gyur/ /ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs rnams dang / /byang chub rnam par dag pa nyid/ /rnam par bzhag pa 'di dag gis/ /sa yi mtshan nyid shes par bya/ /byang chub sems dpa' lta ba rnam dag pa①/ /tshul khrims shin tu rnam dag mnyam par gzhag /chos la nga spangs rgyud dang kun nyon mongs/ /rnam par bya ba ⑤tha dad nga rgyal med/ /skad cig gcig blo thob pa btang snyoms pa / /zhing rnams sbyong ba sems can smin byed par/ /mkhas pa mthu chen lus yongs rdzogs pa dang / /nges par ston la mkhas pa dbang bskur ⑤yin/ /chos nyid rab tu rtogs nas 'dir/ /lhag pa'i tshul khrims lhag sems dang / /lhag pa'i shes rab la rjes slob/ /shes rab spyod yul gnyis yin te/ /chos kyi de nyid dang de ni/ /mi shes shes sogs 'jug pa nyid/ /shes rab spyod yul de lta bas/ /de sa gnyis la rnam par gnas/ /bslab pa rnams dang bsgom pa yis④/ /'bras bu gzhan ni rnam pa bzhi/ /mtshan med 'du byed dang bcas par/ /gnas pa ⑤'bras bu dang po yin/ /de nyid mngon 'du ⑥byed med dang / /zhing ni rnam par dag pa dag /'bras bu gnyis par 'dod pa yin/ /sems can smin par 'grub nyid dang / /ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs rnams ni/ /'grub pa ④'bras bu dam pa yin/ /'bras bu rnam pa 'di bzhi ni/ /sa bzhi ⑤po la yang dag brten/ /chos nyid rab tu rtogs nas 'dir / /tshul khrims kyi ⑨ni phung po sbyong / /de yi 'og tu ting 'dzin dang / /shes rab phung po rnam par sbyong / /de las gzhan pa dag la ni/ /sgrib rnam bzhi dang thogs pa yi⑩/ /sgrib pa las kyang rnam grol dang / /grol ba'i ye shes rnam par sbyong / /sa rnams thams cad ma grub dang / /grub pa dag tu 70—885

shes par bya/ /grub pa dag kyang ma grub dang / /grub pa dag tu yang 'dod do/ /grub pa ji ltar rnam bzhag bzhin/ /yid la byed pas de rtog ①par/ /shes pa'i phyir dang de nyid la⑤/ /rnam mi rtog phyir rnam shes bya/ /so sor ②rang rig bya phyir dang / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi yul gyi phyir/ /sa rnams kun la bsgom ④pa dang / /grub pa yang ni bsam mi khyab/ /snang dang bcas dang mos pa dang / /ma zhum pa dang mi dman nyid⑤/ /gzhan dring mi 'jog bdag nyid dang / /thams cad rab tu rtogs pa dang / /kun la sems ni mnyam pa dang //bkri dang rjes su chags med dang / /thabs shes 'khor du skye ba ni/ /kun la rtags ༅su 'dod pa yin/ /'dun pa med pa ma yin chags dang 'khu ba'i snying med khro med ④le lo med/ /byams dang snying rje min pa'i bsam med blo gros ngan rtog rnam rtog 'phrogs pa med/ /blo gros rnam par g.yengs min ⑧bde bas mi 'phrogs sdug bsngal dag gis gnod pa med/ /dge ba'i bshes la ⑨nye bar brten cing ⑫thos pa lhur len ston pa mchod la brtson/ /thabs mchog shes pa gang zhig bsod nams yang dag bsdus 0pa shin tu rgya chen kun/ /gzhan dang thun mong byas nas nyin gcig ④bzhin du rdzogs pa'i byang chub yongs bsngo ⑫zhing / /bzang po'i gnas su skyes pas ༅rtag tu dge byed mngon shes yon tan rnams kyis brtsen bu/ /sangs rgyas sras de kun gyi bla na 'dug pa yon tan gter du shes par bya/ /sa rnams kun la rnam kun tu/ /blo ldan rnams kyi phan yon ni/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong gnyis ga la/ /lnga po'i bdag nyid dag tu 'dod/ /byang chub la ni nye ba dang / /sems can don sgrub mthong ba la/ /rab tu dga' ba skye 'gyur te/ /de phyir rab dga' zhes brjod do/ /'chal 70—886

tshul rtsol ba'i dri bral phyir/ /dri ma med pa'i sa zhes bya/ /chos kyi snang ba chen po ni/ /byed pa'i phyir na 'od byed pa'o/ /'di ltar byang chub phyogs mthun chos / /rab tu sreg byed 'od lta bu/ /de dang ①ldan phyir sa de ni/ /gnyis po sreg ⑤pas 'od 'phro can/ /sems can rnams yongs smin byed cing / /rang gi sems kyang bsrung ①ba'i phyir/ /blo ldan rnams kyis sbyang khyodaka' ba/ /de phyir sbyang dka' zhes bya'o/ /shes rab pha rol phyin brten ⑤nas/ /'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das/ /gnyis 'dir mngon du gyur pa'i phyir/ /mngon du gyur pa'i sa zhes bshad/ /bgrod gcig lam dang 'brel pa'i phyir/ /ring du song ba'i sar 'dod do/ /'du shes gnyis kyis mi g.yo'i phyir/ /mi g.yo ba zhes nges par brjod/ /so so yang dag rig blo bzang / /sa de legs pa'i blo gros yin/ /sprin bzhin gnyis kyis nam mkha'i chos/ /khyab pa'i phyir na chos kyi sprin/ /dge ba sgrub ④pa sna tshogs la/ /dga' bas rtag ༅par thams cad du / /gnas phyir byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /sa rnams gnas pa yin par 'dod / /'byung po dpag med 'jigs med phyir/ /dpag tu med pa de dag la/ /phyi phyir gong du 'gro ldan phyir/ /de dag nyid ni sar 'dod do/ /sa 'thob ④pa ni mos pa dang / /spyod pa dag la 'jug pa dang / /rtogs pa'i phyir dang sa ⑨rnams ni/ /'grub ༅pa'i sgo nas rnam pa bzhi/ /lus can theg pa chen po dang / /theg pa dman la mos pa rnams/ /gnyis ga 'dun par bya ba dang / /gdul ba'i phyir ni brtan rnams kyi/ /spyod pa bzhi po mdo bzhin du / /rjes su 'brangs ⑪nas bshad pa yin/ /⑫sems can rnams la brtse ba can / /phrad dang bral ba'i dgongs pa can/ /mi 'bral ba yi dgongs pa 70—887

can / /phan bde dgongs khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /thub pa sgrib kun nges par grol / /'jig rten thams cad zil gyis gnon/ /khrod kyi mkhyen pas shes bya khyab/ /thugs grol khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can dag ni thams cad kyi / /nyon mongs ma lus thams cad 'jomasal/ /nyon mongs 'joms mdzad nyon mongs la/ /brtse ⑤bcas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhun gyis grub cing chags mi mnga'/ /thogs par ①mi mnga' rtag par ni/ /mnyam par bzhag cing 'dri kun gyi/ /lan ldon ④khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rten dang brten pa bshad bya dang / /gsung dang mayo pa 'chad ④byed la/ /blo gros rtag thogs mi mnga' ba/ /legs ston khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gshegs nas spyod pa mkhyen mdzad de/ /de dag skad kyis ④sems can gyi/ /'ong dang 'gro dang nges 'byung la/ /legs 'doms khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lus can kun gyis khyod mthong na/ /skyes bu dam pa lags par 'tshal/ /mthong ba tsam gyis rab dang bar/ /mdzad pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /len dang gnas dang gtong ༅ba dang / /sprul dang yongs su sgyur ba dang / /ting nge 'dzin dang ye shes la/ /mnga' brnyes khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thabs dang skyabs dang dag pa dang / /theg chen nges par 'byung ba la/ /sems can rnams la rab slu ba'i / /bdud 'joms 3khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang gzhan ⑨don du ye shes dang / /spangs dang nges 'byung bgegs mdzad par/ /ston mdzad ⑫mu stegs gzhan dag gis/ /mi brdzi 7khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsrung med bsnyel ba mi mnga' bar༅/ /'khor gyi nang na bag brkyang gsung / /kun nas nyon mongs gnyis spangs pa༅/ /'khor sdud khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun 70—888

mkhyen khyod la ①rgyu ba dang / /gnas pa kun la rtag ②par ni/ /kun mkhyen min spyod mi mnga' ste/ /yang dag don ldan khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sems can kun gyi bya ba la/ /khyod ni dus las mi 'da' bas/ /mdzad pa rtag tu don mnga' ba/ /mi bsnyel khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten kun la nyin mtshan du / /lan drug tu ni so sor gzigs/ /thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa④/ /phan dgongs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyod pa dang ni rtogs pa dang / /ye shes dang ni phrin las kyis/ /nyan thos rang sangs rgyas kun gyi④/ /bla ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku gsum dag gis byang chub che/ /rnam pa kun brnyes ⑤thams cad du/ /sems can kun gyi ༅the tshom dag /gcod pa khrod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dzin pa mi mnga' nyes mi mnga' ④/ /rnyog pa mi mnga' ⑤mi gnas pa/ /mi g.yo chos rnams thams cad la/ /spros med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo / /dam pa'i don ni ⑨grub pa ste/ /sa kun las ni nges par byung ༅/ /sems can kun gyi mchog tu gyurakhya/ /sems can thams cad rnam grol mdzad/ /yon tan mi zad mnyam med ldan/ /'jig rten dag dang dkyil 'khor na'ang / /snang la lha dang mi rnams kyis/ /rnam pa kun tu mi mthong ngo / /de lta na yang de yi mthus/ /gdul bya'i skal ba ji bzhin du/ /srid pa ji ltar cheganas kyi bar / /de yi mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad/ /⑩theg pa chen po mdo sde'i rgyan las / spyod pa dang ⑫mthar thug pa'i khyale'u ste nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o// // ༅theg pa chen po khyemado sde'i rgyan ces bya ba'i ༅tshig le'ur byas pa 'phags pa byams pas spyomadzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya si ha dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ༅ dpal 70—889

brtsegs la sogs pas ①bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ slad kyi paṇ+ḍi ta pa ra hi ta dang / bram ze chen po sad dza na dang / lo tsā ba dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis cung zad bcos legs par bshad nas gtan la phab pa'o// //mjug gi blo ga gcig po 'di 'gro don 'phel ba dang gzhung gzhan na 'dug pa ltar bris ⑤pa'o// // maṅga lo/ /② ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he turnye ṣārnya thā ga to rgya wa data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e yo bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ// //④bsdur ma na/8༷5 ①mar byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉ngar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉〉tā lo kā ra/ ②〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉rgya/④〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉ngade yi bdag nyid/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉tha'i phyir te de'i bdag nyid/ ①〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉〉—rnam/ ④〈〈pe 〉ngakres/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉༅ra/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉ngar/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉༅sa kyang / ⑩〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉༅za/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉༅/8 6 ༅⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༅rma/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉8 bzhin chos kyang / ④〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉༅ka'/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sa/ ༅〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉ngatheg pa ra po mdo sde'i rgyan las le'u dang po'o// // ⑦〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉〉pa—/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉nga〈co 〉༅'ang / ⑨〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉༅rten/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉rna'i// 7 ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༅sa/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉zud/ ①〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉ngan/ ④〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉rna/༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༅dir/ 4 〈〈pe 〉༅'ar 〉༅rten/ ④〈〈snar 〉rga'i/ ⑤〈'ar 〉༅thar ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tharnyas/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉༄snyems/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉pos/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉༅/8༷8 khya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༅/ khya 〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉thazhag (chos ra 'di'i nang du gzhag ces pa rnams 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༅ bzhag ces 'khod 'dug kyang bsdur mab du bkod med/) ⑤〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉ngatheg pa ra po mdo sde'i rgyan las theg pa ra po/ ④〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉ngags so/ / ⑤〈'ar 〉ngams/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༅da/ ༅〈〈pe 〉༅〈snar 〉〉ma/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉zag te/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉mas/bya〈〈snar 〉〉mkhas/ 0〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉༅di'i/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉ri lus brgyan/ 〈'ar 〉8 las rgyan/7〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉༅skyab/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉thashams/70—890

zhing / ④〈〈pe 〉ngar 〉༅rtags/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉༅na/ ⑧〈'ar 〉༅da/ ⑨〈me 〉nga'ar 〉༅nyen/⑫〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉thang / ⑫〈'ar 〉༅sdud/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉༅thun mong bcas nas nyon cig 0〈〈pe 〉〉sngo/ ⑫〈〈pe〉༅'ar 〉༅/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉༅na/887 ①〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉ngag ⑤〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉thag ②〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉rang / 0〈'ar 〉༅ngas/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tu phyin bsten/ ④〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉tha ba/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉༅rtags/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉〉thob/⑨〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉nga/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉zab/ skye〈'ar 〉masang / ⑫〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉ngaspyod pa'i skabs rdzogs so// //888 ①〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉༅dul/ ②〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉༅rtser/ ②〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉mi/ ④〈'ar 〉༅don/⑤〈〈pe〉nga〈snar 〉༅chag ④〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉༅ga ④〈〈snar 〉༅tong / ⑧〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉༅com/⑨〈〈pe 〉༅'ar 〉༅zhin/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉chud pa/ /ston dang / ⑪〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉tha/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༅/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉༅'i/889 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ras mapo nga/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉༅rtag ②〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉rag dang ldan/ ①〈〈snar 〉〉gyis / ⑤〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉༅snyes/ ⑥〈〈snar 〉rgyas/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉༅da cing nyes pa med/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༅da cing / ⑨〈〈snar 〉ngani/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉༅byung / ⑩〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉༅gyur/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉 da/ ④〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉༅theg ra gsung rab gsal bar byed pa'i rgyan/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi 'jug ngogs chu gter che/ /zab cing rgya che gsal byed nyi ma'i 'od/ /skal ldan blo yi parngo rgyas byed yin//⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༅sa bya ba las/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉rga/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉༅sdom ni thabs ldan pha rol phyin pa dang / /tshad med byang ༅ phyogs mthun dang / /yon tan ma dang mthar thug pa/ /sa dang ༅sa bu nyid yin no// ⑫〈'ar 〉༅'i/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉khru/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉'a btsun byams pa mgon pos/ ④〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉༅da kyi lo myu ba/89༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉༅gas kyis/ ②〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉ngapa/ slad kyi ཿ ltarabris/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉ngamaṅga /④〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉ngaye dharmā ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ// //70—900
bsdur 'bras re'u migasems tsam/ (1)ji 70wa 901

༄ga /dbus dang mtha' rnam par 'byed pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa bzhugs so//①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma dh+yārnya bi snyi ga kā ri kā②/ bod skad du/dbus dang mtha' rnam par 'byed pa'i tshig le'ur byas ②pa/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshan nyid sgrib pa de kho na/ /gnyen po dag ni bsgom ④pa dang / /de yi gnas dang 'bras bu 'thob/ /theg pa bla na med pa 'o/ /yang dag ma yin kun rtog yod/ /de la gnyis po yod ma yin/ /stong pa nyid ni 'di la yod/ /de la yang ni de yod do/ /stong pa ma yin mi stong min/ /de lta bas na thams cad bshad/ /yod pas med pas yod pas na//de ni dbu ma'i lam yin no/ /don dang sems can bdag rnam rig /snang ba'i rnam par shes pa ni/ /rab tu skye 'o de'i ⑤ don med/ /de med pas na de yang med/ /yang dag ma yin kun rtog pa/ /de ni de phyir grub pa yin/ /de bzhin ma yin ye med yin༅/ /de zad nam ④ni grol bar 'dod/ /brtags ⑤70—902

pa dang ni gzhan dbang dang / /yongs su grub pa nyid kyang ngo / /don phyir yang dag min rtog phyir/ /gnyis po med pa'i phyir bshad do/ /dmigs pa la ni brten nas su/ /mi dmigs pa ni rab tu skye/ /mi dmigs pa la brten nas su/ /mi dmigs pa ni rab tu skye/ /de yi phyir na dmigs pa ni/ /mi dmigs ngo bo nyid du grub/ /de lta bas na dmigs pa dang / /mi dmigs mnyam par shes par bya/ /yang dag ma yin kun rtog ni/ /sems dang sems byung khams gsum pa/ /de la don mthong rnam par shes/ /de yi khyad nga/ra sems las byung / /gcig ni rkyen gyi ①rnam par shes/ /gnyis pa khya nye bar spyod pa can/ /nye bar spyod dang yongs gcod dang / /de yi 'jug byed sems las byung / /sgrib pa'i phyir dang 'debs pa'i phyir/ /khrid ①pa'i phyir dang kun 'dzin phyir/ /rdzogs byed phyir dang gsum gcod phyir/ /nye bar gcod ༷phyir sdud pa'i phyir/ / sbyor ba'i ⑤phyir dang mngon du'i phyir/ /sdug bsngal phyir ni 'gro nyon mongs/ /rnam gsum rnam gnyis kyang nyon mongs/ /rnam bdun yang dag min rtog las/ /stong pa nyid ni mdor bsdu na/ /mtshan nyid dang ni rnam grangs dang / /de yi don dang dbye ba dang / /sgrub pa dag ste shes par bya/ /gnyis dngos med dang dngos med pa'i/ /dngos po stong pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /yod pa ma yin med pa'ang min/ /tha dad gcig pa'i mtshan nyid min/ /stong pa nyid ni mdor bsdu na/ /de bzhin nyid dang yang dag mtha'/ /mtshan ma med dang don dam dang / /chos kyi dbyings ni rnam grangs so/ /gzhan min phyin ci log ma yin/ /de 'gog ④'phags pa'i spyod yul dang / /'phags pa'i chos kyi rgyu yi phyir/ /rnam grangs don te go rims 70—903

bzhin / /kun nas nyon mongs rnam par dag /de ni dri bcas dri ma med/ /chu khams gser dang nam mkha' rnams/ /dag pa bzhin du dag par 'dod/ /za ba bza' dang de yi lus/ /gnas kyi gzhi ①yi stong pa nyid/ /de yang gang gis ji ltar mthong / /gang phyir de yang stong pa nyid/ /dge gnyis thob par bya ba'i phyir/ /rtag tu sems can phan bya'i phyir/ /'khor ba gtang ②bar mi bya'i phyir/ /dge ba mi zad bya ba'i phyir/ /rigs kyang rnam par dag bya'i phyir//mtshan dang dpe byad thob bya'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams dag bya'i phyir/ /byang chub sems dpa' sgrub par byed/ /gang zag dang ni chos rnams kyi②/ /dngos po med 'dir stong pa nyid/ /de dngos med pa'i dngos yod pa/ /de ni de las stong nyid gzhan/ /gal te nyon mongs de ma gyur/ /lus can thams cad grol bar gyur④/ /gal te rnam dag de ma gyur/ /'bad pa 'bras bu med par 'gyur/ /nyon mongs ma yin mi rmongs ⑤min/ /de ni dag dang ma dag min/ /bstan bcos dbus dang mtha' rnam par 'byed pa las/ mtshan nyid kyi le'ur bcad pa zhes bya ba ste dang po'o// //khyab dang nyi tshe lhag pa dang / /mnyam dang len dang spong ba ni/ /gnyis kyi sgrib par bstan pa yin/ /nyon mongs mtshan nyid rnam dgu 'o/ /kun tu sbyor rnams sgrib pa yin/ /skyo ba dang ni btang snyoms dang / /de kho na ni mthong ba dang / /'jig khyatshogs lta dang de'i gzhi 'dang / /'gog dang lam dang dkon mchog dang / /rnyed pa dang ni bkur sti dang / /yo byad bsnyungs pa yongs shes la/ /dge la sogs pa bcu la gzhan/ /sbyor ba med 70/de904
