dang skye mched min/ /rnal 'byor min pas gang bskyed dang / /skye ba med dang yid mi byed/ /tshogs ni rab tu ma rdzogs dang / /rigs dang bshes gnyen mi ldan dang / /sems ni yongs su skyo ba dang / /sgrub pa dang yang mi ldan dang ①/ /skye bo ngan sdang 'grogs pa dang / /rang gi gnas ngan len gsum las/ /lhag ma shes rab ma smin dang / /rang bzhin gyis ni gnas ngan len/ /le lo dang yang bag med dang / /srid dang longs spyod chags pa dang / /sems ni zhum par gyur pa dang / /ma dad pa dang ma mos dang / /sgra bzhin du ni spyod pa dang / /dam chos ched cher mi 'dzin dang / /rnyed la gdu dang snying rje med/ /thos pas phongs ②dang nyung ba dang / /ting 'dzin sbyangs pa ma byas pa'o/ /dge dang byang chub yang dag 'dzin/ /blo ldan 'khrul med sgrib pa med①/ /bsngo dang mi skrag ser sna med/ /dbang ni dge la sogs pa 'o/ /de dag gi ①ni sgrib pa rnams/ /gsum gsum dag tu shes par bya/ / byed rgyu bcu ni skye ba dang / /gnas pa rten dang bstan bya dang / /'gyur dang 'bral dang gzhan du dang / /yid ches go 'byed 'thob rnams la/ /mig dang zas sa mar me dang / /me la sogs pa de yi dpe/ /zor ba bzo shes du ba dang / /rgyu dang lam la sogs pa gzhan/ /༅phyogs dang pha rol phyin sa la/ /sgrib pa dag ni gzhan yin no/ /gzhi la mi mkhas le lo dang / /gnyis kyis ting 'dzin nyams pa dang / /mi skyed ④pa dang nyam ④chung dang / /lta dang gnas ngan len skyon chags/ /phyug po dang ni bde 'gro dang / /sems can mi gtong sgrib pa dang / /nyes pa dag dang yon tan rnams/ /'bri dang 'phel dang 'dzud pa dang / /grol bar byed dang mi zad dang / /dge ba rgyun 70—905

mi 'chad pa dang / /nges par byed dang chos rnams la/ /longs par spyod dang yongs smin byed/ /kun du 'gro don mchog gi don/ /rgyu mthun don gyi mchog nyid dang / /yongs su 'dzin pa med don dang / /rgyud rnams tha dad med don dang / /nyon mongs rnam dag min don dang / /tha dad med pa'i don nyid dang / /bri med 'phel ba med don dang / /dbang ni rnam pa bzhi yi ①gnas / /chos kyi dbyings la ma rig༅pa/ /nyon mongs can min sgrib pa bcu/ /sa bcu'i mi mthun phyogs rnams kyi/ /gnyen po dag ni sa yin no/ /nyon mongs pa yi sgrib pa dang / /shes bya'i sgrib pa nyid du bstan/ /der ni sgrib pa thams cad de / /de zad nas ni grol bar 'dod/ /bstan bcos dbus dang mtha' rnam par 'byed pa las/ sgrib pa'i le'ur bcad pa zhes bya ba ste gnyis pa'o// //rtsa ba mtshan nyid de kho na/ /phyin ci ma log mtshan nyid dang / /'bras bu rgyu yi de kho na/ /rags pa dang ni phra ba dang / /grags dang rnam par dag yul dang / /bsdu dang dbye ba'i mtshan nyid dang / /mkhas de kho na rnam bcu ni / /bdag tu lta ba'i gnyen po 'o/ /ngo bo nyid gsum rtag med dang ②/ /yod kyang kho na ma yin dang / /yod dang med de kho na ste/ /ngo bo nyid ni gsum du 'dod/ /'di la chos dang gang zag dang / /gzung ba dag dang 'dzin pa dang / /yod dang med par sgro 'dogs dang / /skur ba 'debs par lta ba dgab /gang shes nas ni mi 'byung ba/ /de de kho na'i mtshan nyid do/ /mi rtag don ni med don dang / /skye zhing 'jig ⑤pa'i mtshan nyid dang / /dri ①bcas dri ma med don te/ /rtsa ba'i kho nar go rims bzhin/ /sdug bsngal 70/de906

len dang mtshan nyid dang / /'brel pa gzhan du 'dod pa yin/ /dngos med de ①dngos ma yin dang ②/ /rang bzhin gyis ni stong par 'dod/ /mtshan nyid med pas bdag med dang / /de dang mi mthun mtshan nyid dang / /rang gi mtshan nyid bstan pa yin/ /de phyir sdug bsngal bden par 'dod/ /bag chags dang ②ni kun nas 'byung / /ma bral ba yang de bzhin no/ /ngo bo nyid dang gnyis mi skye/ /dri ma zhi ba gnyis su 'dod/ /yongs su shes dang spang ④ba dang / /thob par mngon sum bya bas ni/ /lam gyi bden pa yang dag bshad / /btags pa dang ni shes pa dang / /de bzhin brjod pa rags pa yin / /dam pa'i don ni gcig pu 'o/ /don dang thob ⑤dang sgrub pa ni/ /don dam rnam pa gsum du 'dod/ /'gyur med phyin ci ma log pa/ /yongs su grub pa rnam pa gnyis/ /gcig gis 'jig rten grags pa ste/ /gsum gyis rigs pa'i grags pa 'o①/ /rnam dag spyod yul rnam gnyis te/ /gcig pu kho nar brjod pa yin/ /rgyu dang rnam par rtog pa dang / /ming ni rnam pa gnyis su bsdu④/ /yang dag ye shes rab kho na/ /gcig pu kho nas ④bsdus pa yin/ /'jug de kho na rnam pa gnyis/ /gnas pa dang ni ngan par zhugs/ /mtshan nyid rnam par rig dang dag /yang dag sgrub pa gcig pu 'o/ /gcig dang rgyu dang za ba dang / /byed pa dang ni dbang bsgyur ⑨dang / /bdag po'i don dang rtag pa dang / /nyon mongs pa dang dag pa'i gnas/ /rnal 'byor can dang ma grol grol/ /'di dag la ni bdag tu lta/ /kun tu rtog dang rnam rtog don / /chos nyid don gyis de dag der/ /thog ma du ma nyid dang ni/ /bsdus dang yongs su phye ba'i don/ /'dzin dang gzung ⑫dang de 'dzin pa/ /70—907

sa bon don te ༅gzhan du 'dod/ /tshor dang don rnams yongs gcod kyi/ /nyer spyod 'byung sgo gzhan yin no/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu rtsol ba la/ /sgro 'dogs med cing bskur ༅'debs med/ /mi 'dod 'dod dang rnam dag dang / /mnyam du 'byung ༅dang dbang byed dang / /'thob dang kun tu spyod pa dag /gzhan dbang nyid kyi don te gzhan/ /'dzin dang gnas dang rgyun mi 'chad/ /spyod dang dag pa gnyis kyi ༅phyir/ /'bras bu rgyu rnams spyad zin dang / /de bzhin ma spyad gzhan yin no/ /tshor ba rgyu dang bcas pa'i don/ /de yi rgyu ni sgrub pa yin/ /de zhi ba dang gnyen po'i don/ /ldan pa'i phyir na gzhan du 'dod/ / de yi rgyu ni sgrub pa yin/ /kun 'byung ba yi bden pa ste/ /༷yon tan skyon dang rnam mi rtog /shes pas gzhan las bdag gis ni/ /nges par 'byung phyir gzhan zhes bya//btags bcas rgyur bcas rgyu mtshan dang ༅ / /rab tu zhi ba ⑦don bcas ni/ /tha ma nyid du bshad pa yin/ /bstan bcos dbus dang mtha' rnam par 'byed pa las / de kho na'i le'ur bcad pa zhes bya ⑤ste gsum pa'o// //gnas ngan len phyir srid rgyu'i phyir/ /gzhi yi phyir dang ma rmongs phyir/ /bden pa bzhi la 'jug bya bas/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bsgomasal/ /mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po rnams/ /rnam pa thams cad yongs shes na⑩/ /de dag spong rgyaphyir brtson 'grus ni/ /rnam pa bzhi dag rab tu 'byung / /der gnas las su rung ba nyid/ /don rnams thams cad 'byor par 'gyur/ /nyes pa lnga spang po'adu byed brgyad/ /bsten pa'i rgyu las byung ba 'o/ /le lo dang ni gdams ngag rnams/ /brjed dang bying dang rgod pa dang / /'du mi 70—908

byed dang 'du byed de/ /'di ①dag nyes pa lngar 'dod do/ /gnas dang de la gnas pa dang / /rgyu dang 'bras bu nyid du 'o/ /dmigs pa brjed ②par ma gyur dang / /bying dang rgod pa rtogs pa dang / /de spong mngon par 'du byed dang / /zhi tshe rnal du 'jug pa 'o/ /thar pa'i cha dang mthun bskyed nas/ /'dun dang sbyor ba dbang byed dang ①/ /dmigs pa brjed ④par ma gyur dang / /mi 'phro rnam par 'byed kyang ngo / /mi mthun phyogs ni srab ⑤pa'i phyir/ / stobs ldan ⑨'bras bu phyi ma yin/ /dbang po rnams dang ④stobs rnams la/ /nges 'khyed cha mthun gnyis gnyis so/ /rang bzhin yan lag gnas yan lag /gsum ④pa nges 'byung yan lag ste/ /bzhi pa phan yon yan lag yin/ /rnam gsum nyon mongs med yan lag /'di la gzhi ⑨dang gnas dang ni/ /ngo bo nyid du bstan pa yin/ /yongs su gcod dang go byed ⑫dang / /rnam gsum gzhan yid ches par byed/ /mi mthun phyogs kyi gnyen por ni/ /lam gyi yan lag de brgyad do/ /lta dang tshul khrims yo byad bsnyungs/ /gzhan la rnam par rig byed 'dod/ /nyon mongs nye ba'i nyon mongs dbang / /mi mthun phyogs kyi gnyen po 'o/ /rjes su mthun la phyin ci log /rjes su 'brel bcas bzlog pa dang / /phyin ci ma log phyin ci log /rjes su 'grel med bsgom 0pa 'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ni/ /dmigs dang yid la byed pa dang / /'thob ⑩pas de ni khyad par 'phags/ /rgyu yi gnas dang zhugs pa dang / /sbyor dang 'bras bu brjod pa dang / /bya dang bya med khyad par dang / /de ni bla ma bla na med/ /mos pa dang ni 'jug pa dang / /nges par 'byung dang lung bstan dang / /brjod pa dang ni dbang bskur dang / /phyin pa dang ni phan 70/de909

yon dang / /bya ba bsgrub pa ①bstan pa 'o/ /chos kyi dbyings la rnam gsum ste / /ma dag ma dag dag pa dang / /rnam par dag par ②ci rigs sbyar/ /'di las ji ltar 'os 'os su/ /gang zag rnam par gzhag par 'dod/ /snod gyur rnam par ①smin brjod dang / /de yi dbang gis stobs dang ni/ /'dod dang 'phel dang rnam dag ste/ /de dag 'bras bu go rims bzhin/ /phyi ma phyi ma thog ma dang / /de goms byas dang rdzogs pa 'o/ /rjes su mthun dang mi mthun phyogs/ /bral ba dang ni khyad par dang / /bla ma dang ni bla na med/ /'bras bu gzhan te mdor bsdus pa'o/ /bstan bcos dbus dang mtha' rnam par 'byed pa las/ gnyen po bsgom pa'i le'ur bcad pa zhes bya ④ste bzhi pa'o// //bla med nyid ni sgrub pa dang / /dmigs pa dang ni yang dag 'grub/ /bstan pa yin par 'dod pa 'o/ /sgrub pa dag ni rnam drug ste/ / pha rol phyin pa de dag la'o/ /༅dam pa dang ni yid byed dang / /rjes su mthun chos mtha' spangs dang / /khyad par can dang khyad par med/ /④ dam pa bcu gnyis bdag nyid de/ /rgya che ba dang yun ring dang / /ched du bya dang ⑦mi zad dang / /rgyun mi 'chad dang ༅tshegs med ⑨dang / /dbang 'byor ba dang yongs gzung dang / /rtsom dang 'thob dang rgyu mthun dang / /'grub pa dam par 'dod pa yin/ /de phyir dam pa'i don gyis ni/ /pha rol phyin pa bcur 'dod do/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ /bsam gtan dang ni shes rab thabs/ /smon lam stobs dang ye shes dang ⑫/ /'di dag pha rol 70/de910

phyin bcu 'o/ /las ni rjes su 'dzin byed dang / /gnod mi byed dang de la bzod / /yon tan 'phel dang 'dzud nus dang / /rnam par grol bar byed pa dang / /mi zad ①pa dang rtag 'jug dang / /nges par longs spyod smin par byed②/ /theg pa chen por ji lta bur/ /chos rnams btags par mdzad pa dag② /byang chub sems dpa' rtag par yang / /shes rab gsum gyis yid byed pa'o/ /khams rtas byed dang 'jug byed dang / /de ni don rnams 'grub par 'gyur/ /de ni chos spyod rnam bcu dang / /yang dag ldan par shes par bya/ /yi ge 'dri mchod sbyin pa dang / /nyan dang klog dang len pa dang / /'chad dang kha don ④byed pa dang / /de sems pa dang bsgom ⑤pa 'o/ /spyod ④pa de bcu'i bdag nyid ni/ /bsod nams phung po dpag tu med/ /khyad par phyir dang mi zad phyir/ /gzhan la phan 'dogs ma zhi'i phyir/ /mi g.yeng phyin ci ma log par/ /gyur pa rjes su mthun pa'i ④chos/ /ldang dang yul la 'jug pa dang / /de bzhin ro myang bying dang rgod/ /yid ches pa yi bsam pa dang / /yid la byed pa ngar 'dzin dang / /chung ngu'i sems ni ⑤g.yeng ba ste⑨/ /blo ldan rnams kyis shes par bya/ /yi ge don dang yid byed dang / /mi 'phro ba dang mtshan nyid gnyis/ /ma dag dag dang glo bur dang / /mi sdang ⑩ba dang khengs pa med⑩/ /'brel pa'i phyir dang 'dris phyir dang / /ma 'brel phyir dang ma 'dris phyir/ /don yod pa dang med pa ste⑫/ /de ni yi ge ma log pa'o/ /gnyis su snang bar gyur pa ni/ /de ltar yod pa ma yin te/ /de ni don la ma log pa / /yod dang med pa rnam par spangs/ /rtog pa de yis bsgos pa yi / /rtog pa yid byed de'i gnas ni/ /yid la byed pa ma 70—911

log pa/ /gnyis su snang ba'i rgyu la 'o/ /don gyis ①med dang yod pa ste②/ /sgyu ma la sogs bzhin du 'dod/ /de ni mi 'phro ②ma log ste/ /yod dang med pa mi 'phro ④phyir/ /rtog pa thams cad mi 'jug phyir/ /thams cad ming tsam kho na ste/ /rang gi mtshan ④nyid ma log pa'o/ /don dam rang gi mtshan nyid la'o/ /chos kyi ④dbyings ni ma gtogs par/ /'di ltar chos yod ma yin te/ /de phyir spyi yi mtshan nyid der⑦/ /de ni phyin ci ma log pa'o/ /phyin ci log gi yid la byed/ /ma spangs pa dang spangs pa las⑤/ /de ni ma dag rnam dag ste/ /de yang de la ma log pa'o/ /chos kyi dbyings ni rang bzhin kyis/ /rnam par dag phyir nam mkha' bzhin/ /gnyis ni glo bur byung ba ste/ /de yang de la ma log pa'o/ /chos rnams dang ni gang zag gi/ /kun nas nyon mongs rnam dag med/ /med phyir de bas skrag dang nga༅/ /med de de ⑩'dir ma log pa'o/ / gang la gang zhig gang las 'khrul/ /ma 'khrul gang zhig gang la dang / /'a la dang ma 'khrul 'bras bu nyid/ /de gnyis kyi ni mtha' ma 'o/ /yod med phyin ci ma log dang / /gnas dang sgyu ma lta bu nyid//mi rtog pa dang rang bzhin gyis/ /rtag par 'od gsal nyid dang ni/ /kun nas nyon mongs rnam byang dang / /de bzhin nam mkha' lta bu nyid/ /'grib pa med dang lhag med pa/ /rdo rje'i tshig ni bcu zhes bya/ /⑫tha dad pa dang gcig mtha' dang / /mu stegs nyan thos gnyi ga dang / /gang zag chos la sgro 'dogs dang / /skur 'debs mtha' rnams ⑫gnyis gnyis dang / /mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po'i mtha'/ /rtag dang chad par 'du shes dang / /gzung ⑫dang 'dzin dang kun nyon mongs/ /rnam par byang la gnyis dang gsum/ /70—912

rnam par rtog pa gnyis kyi mtha'/ /de ni rnam pa bdun du 'dod/ /dngos yod dngos med zhi bya dang / /zhi byed skrag bya ①de la 'jigs/ /gzung dang 'dzin dang yang dag nyid/ /log pa nyid dang byed dang min/ /skye ba med dang mnyam pa'i dus/ /de ni rnam rtog gnyis kyi mtha'/ /khyad par can dang khyad med ni/ /sa bcu dag tu shes par bya/ /rnam par gzhag dang de bzhin dbyings / /sgrub dang sgrub dang 'dzin pa dang / /nges par 'dzin dang rab tu 'dzin/ /rab tu rtogs dang rab rgyas dang / /rnam par rtog dang rnal 'dug dang / /phul du byung ba'i dmigs par 'dod/ /ma tshang med dang mi spong dang / /mi g.yeng ba dang rab rdzogs dang / /yang dag skyed ②dang 'phel ba dang / /las su rung dang mi gnas ④dang / /sgrib pa med pa nyid dang de/ /rgyun mi gcod pa yang dag 'grub/ /dbus rnam 'byed pa'i bstan bcos te/ /rtogs par dka' ④dang snying po'i don/ /don chen de bzhin kun gyi don/ /don med thams cad sel ba 'o/ /bstan bcos dbus dang mtha' rnam par 'byed pa las / theg pa bla na med pa'i le'ur bcad ①pa zhes bya ba ste lnga pa'o// // bstan bcos ④dbus dang mtha' rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa 'phags pa ④byams pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi ⑤mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / shī len+d+ra bo dhe dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ⑨ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //70—913

༄ga /chos dang chos nyid rnam par 'byed pa bzhugs so//①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ dharma dharma tā bi snye ga ta/ bod skad du/chos dang chos nyid rnam par 'byed pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang phyir shes nas 'ga' zhig spang bya zhing / /gzhan dag 'ga' zhig mngon sum bya ba'i phyir / /des na de dag mtshan nyid las rnam dbye/ /byed par 'dod nas bstan bcos 'di mdzad do/ /'di dag thams cad ni gnyis kyis bsdus te/ chos dang chos nyid kyis so/ /chos kyis nye bar mtshon pa ni 'khor ba'o/ /chos nyid kyis nye bar mtshon pa ni theg pa gsum gyi mya ngan las 'das pa'o/ /gnyis dang brjod pa ji ltar snang ba yang dag pa ma yin pa'i kun tu rtog pa ni chos kyi mtshan nyid de/ med pa snang ba ni yang dag pa ma yin pa'o/ /kun tu rtog pa ni thams cad du don med par rtog pa tsam mo/ /gzung ba dang / 'dzin pa dang / rjod ④pa dang /70—916

brjod par bya ba'i khyad par med pa'i de bzhin nyid ni chos nyid kyi mtshan nyid do//med pa snang ba'i phyir 'khrul pa ni kun nas nyon mongs pa'i rgyu ste/ sgyu ma'i glang po che la sogs pa mthong ba bzhin nol/ /yod pa mi mthong bas kyang ngo / /med pa dang snang ba dag las gang yang rung ba zhig med na 'khrul pa dang ma 'khrul pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byang ba rjes su 'jug par mi 'gyur ro/ /gnyis po dag gcig pa dang tha dad pa ma yin te/ yod pa dang med pa'i khyad par dang khyad par med pa'i phyir ro/ /rnam pa drug gis chos rtogs pa gong na med pa yin te/ mtshan nyid dang grub pa dang / gcig pa dang / tha dad pa ma yin pa dang / kun tu gnas pa dang / thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa dang / gzung ba dang 'dzin par snang ba dngos po med par 'jug pa'o/ /mtshan nyid dang / grub ༅pa dang / gcig pa dang /tha dad pa ma yin pa rnams ni ji ltar mdor bstan pa bzhin no/ /gang gang na ⑤'khor bar byed pa de ni kun du gnas pa ste/ sems can dang snod kyi 'jig rten no/ /snod kyi 'jig rten ni thun mong ba bzhin nyid du rnam par rig ④pa'o/ /sems can gyi 'jig rten ni thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /skye ba dang /tha snyad dang / rjes su gzung ba dang / tshar gcad ⑤pa dang / yon tan dang / skyon phan tshun byed pa'i phyir phan tshun bdag po nyid kyi duni thun mong ba'o/ /gnas dang / rnam par rig pa dang / las dang bde ba dang /sdug bsngal ba dang / 'chi 'pho dang / skye ba dang / bcings pa dang /grol ba ni thun mong ma yin pa nyid kyis na thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /thun mong du phyi rol du gzung bar snang ba nyid ni 'dzin pa'i shes pa nyid yin gyi/ shes pa 70—917

las logs ①shig na don med de/ thun mong nyid kyi phyir ro/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i gzung ba'i rnam par shes pa'i don gzhan gyi ②sems la sogs pa ni mnyam par gzhag pa dang / mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i 'dzin pa'i rnam par rig pa'i yang phan tshun yul ma yin te/ mnyam par ma bzhag pa la ni rang gi rnam par rtog pa rab tu snang ba'i phyir ro/ /mnyam par gzhag pa yang ting nge 'dzin gyi ①spyod yul la de'i gzugs brnyan rab tu snang ba'i phyir ro①/ /gzung bar snang ba med na 'dzin par snang ba med par yang rab tu grub po/ /des na gzung ba dang 'dzin par snang ba med par rtog par ⑤rab tu grub po/ /thog ma med pa'i kun nas slong ①ba rab tu grub pa'i phyir gnyis ma grub par ④rab tu grub pa'i phyir ro/ /rnam pa drug gis chos nyid kyi ⑤rtogs pa gong na med pa yin te/ mtshan nyid dang / kun tu gnas pa dang / nges par /ded pa dang / reg pa dang / rjes su dran pa dang / de'i bdag nyid du nye bar 'gro bar de rab tu rtogs ⑨pa'o/ /mtshan nyid ni mdor bstan pa bzhin no/ /kun tu gnas pa'i chos thams cad dang / mdo sde gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis thams cad kyi tshig gi ⑩tshogs so/ /nges par 'khyed pa ni theg pa chen po'i mdo sde la brten nas tshul bzhin yid la byed pas bsdus pa'i sbyor ba'i lam thams cad do/ /reg pa ni yang dag pa'i lta ba thob pa'i phyir mthong ba'i lam gyis de bzhin nyid rab tu rtogs shing nyams su myong ba ste/ mngon sum nyid du sbyor bas so/ /rjes su dran pa ni ji ltar reg pa'i byang chub kyi phyogs kyis ⑫ bsdus pa de'i dri ma sel ba'i bsgom ⑫pa'i lam thams cad do/ /de'i bdag nyid du nye bar 'gro ba ni de bzhin nyid dri ma med par gyur pa las rnam pa thams 70—918

cad du de bzhin nyid tsam snang ba ste/ de ni gnas yongs su gyur pa'i yongs su grub pa'o/ /rnam pa bcu rnams kyis gnas yongs su gyur pa rtogs pa ni gong na med pa ste/ ngo bo dang / dngos po dang / gang zag dang / khyad par dang / dgos pa dang / gnas dang / yid la byed pa dang / sbyor ba dang / nyes dmigs dang / phan yon la rab tu rtogs pa'o/ /ngo bo rtogs pa ni de bzhin nyid dri ma med pa la glo bur gyi nyon mongs pa dang de bzhin nyid mi snang ba dang snang ba'o/ /dngos po rtogs pa ni thun mong gi ①snod kyi rnam par rig pa de bzhin nyid du gyur pa dang/ mdo sde'i chos kyi dbyings de bzhin nyid du gyur pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i sems can gyi khams kyi rnam par rig pa de bzhin nyid du gyur pa'o/ /gang zag rtogs pa ni dang po gnyis de bzhin nyid du gyur pa ni sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' nyid kyi'o/ /phyi ma ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi yang ngo / /khyad par rtogs pa ni sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ⑤sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa'i khyad par dang / chos kyi sku dang / longs spyod rdzogs pa'i khyad par dang /sprul pa'i sku thob pa'i khyad par kyang yin te/ mthong ba dang / ston pa dang /'byor pa brnyes pa'i khyad par gyi phyir ro/ /dgos pa rtogs pa ni sngon gyi ④smon lam gyi 0khyad par dang / theg pa chen po ston pa la dmigs pa'i khyad par gyi dang / sa bcu la rab tu sbyor ba'i khyad par gyi phyir ro/ /gnas rtogs pa ni/rnam pa drug gis rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rtogs pa'i ⑤phyir ro/ /rnam pa drug gis rtogs pa nyid ni dmigs pa las dang ①/ mtshan ma yongs su spangs pa ⑦las dang / yang dag par sbyor ba las dang / mtshan nyid kyi phyir dang /70—919

phan yon gyi phyir dang / yongs su shes pa'i phyir ro/ /rnam pa bzhis dmigs pa rtogs pa ste/ theg pa chen po ston pa dang / de la mos pa dang / nges pa dang /tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa rnams kyis so/ /rnam pa bzhis mtshan ma spong ba rtogs pa ste/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs dang / gnyen po'i phyogs dang / de bzhin nyid dang / rtogs pa'i chos kyi mtshan ma yongs su spong ba las te/ rags pa dang /'bring po dang / phra ba dang / ring du rjes su 'gro ba'i mtshan ma yongs su spong ba rnam ①grangs ji lta ba bzhin du 'dis yang dag par bstan pa yin no/ /yang dag par sbyor ba rtogs pa la yang rnam pa bzhi ste/ dmigs pa'i sbyor ba las dang / mi dmigs pa'i sbyor ba las dang / dmigs pa mi dmigs pa nyid du sbyor ba las dang / mi dmigs pa dmigs par sbyor ba las so/ /mtshan nyid rtogs pa la yang rnam pa gsum ste/ chos nyid la rab tu gnas pa'i phyir ni gnyis su med pa brjod pa dang bral ba'i chos nyid la rab tu gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /snang ⑤ba med pa'i phyir ni gnyis dang / ji ltar brjod pa dang / dbang po dang / yul dang / rnam par rig pa ④dang / snod kyi 'jig rten rnams su snang ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /de rnams kyis ni gzugs med pa/ bstan du med pa/ gnas med pa/ snang ba med pa/ rnam par rig pa med pa/ rten med pa ni rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes so zhes ji ltar mdo las gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid de gsal bar bstan pa yin no/ /snang ba'i phyir ni nam mkha'i dkyil ltar chos thams cad mthong ba'i phyir dang / sgyu ma la sogs pa ltar 'du byed thams cad mthong ba'i phyir ro/ /phan yon rtogs pa ni rnam pa bzhi ste/ chos kyi sku rdzogs par ④rab tu thob pa'i phyir dang / gong na med pa'i bde ba'i gnas pa rab tu 70—920

thob pa'i phyir dang / laston pa'i 'byor pa rab tu thob pa'i phyir ro/ /yongs su shes pa las rtogs pa yang rnam pa bzhi ste/ gnyen po yongs su shes pa'i phyir dang / mtshan nyid yongs su shes pa'i phyir dang / khyad par yongs su shes pa'i phyir dang / las yongs su shes pa'i phyir ro/ /de la gnyen po yongs su shes pa ni rnam par mi rtog ②pa'i ye shes te/ chos dang / gang zag dang /gyur pa dang / tha dad pa dang / skur pa lnga mi bde ba'i ②ngo bo las zhen pa'i gnyen po'o/ /mtshan nyid yongs su shes pa ni/ yid la byed pa med pa dang /yang dag par 'das pa dang / nye bar zhi ba dang / ngo bo'i don dang /bkra bar 'dzin pa lnga spangs pa ni rang gi mtshan nyid do/ /khyad par yongs su shes pa ni rtog pa med pa dang / phyogs gcig pa ma yin pa nyid dang /gnas pa med pa nyid dang / gtan du ba nyid dang gtan ①med pa rnam pa lnga'i khyad par gyi phyir ro/ /las yongs su shes pa ni/ rnam par rtog pa ring ⑤du byed pa dang / bla na med pa'i bde ba'i 0sbyin pa dang / nyon mongs pa dang /shes bya'i sgrib pa dang bral bar sbyor ba dang / de'i rjes las thob pa'i ye shes kyis shes bya'i rnam pa thams cad la 'jug pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dang / sems can yongs su smin pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ster bar ④byed pa'i rnam pa lnga ni las kyi khyad par ro/ /yid la byed pa rtogs pa ni/ ji skad du/ byang chub sems dpa' rnam par mi rtog ⑧pa'i ye shes de rtogs par 'dod pa de 'di ltar yid la byed pa/ de bzhin nyid mi shes pa thog ma med pa'i dus can las te/ yang dag pa ma yin pa'i kun tu rtog pa las bon thams cad pa ste/ mi bden pa gnyis su snang ba'i rgyu dang /70—921

de la rten ①pa tha dad pa yang yin te/ de la rgyu dang 'bras bur bcas pa snang du zin kyang mi bden pa yin no/ /de ltar snang bas kyang de'i chos nyid ni snang ba med la/ de snang ba med pa ⑤las kyang chos nyid snang ba yin no/ /zhes tshul bzhin yid la byed pa na⑤/ byang chub sems dpa' rnam ①par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rtogs ④pa yin no/ /de ltar nye bar dmigs pa las rnam par rig pa tsam la ④nye bar dmigs pa rtogs par byed do/ /rnam par rig pa tsam la nye bar dmigs pa las don thams cad dmigs pa med par rtogs par ⑦byed do/ /don thams cad dmigs pa med pa las rnam par rig ⑧pa tsam yang mi dmigs par rtogs par byed do/ /de mi dmigs pa las gnyi ga khyad par dmigs par ⑨rtogs par byed pa yin no/ /der gang yang gnyis dmigs pa med pa de ni/rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes te/ yul med cing / dmigs pa med pa yin te/mtshan ma thams cad mi dmigs pas nye bar mtshon pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /sbyor bas khyartogs pa ni rnam pa bzhi ste/ mos pas spyod pa'i sa la mos pas sbyor ba'i phyir dang / de nyid nges par 'byed pa'i gnas skabs so/ /⑪sa dang po la so sor rig par sbyor ba'i phyir dang / de nyid ni reg pa'i gnas skabs so/ /rnam par ma dag pa'i sa drug la sgom pa la rab tu sbyor ba'i phyir dang / yongs su dag pa gsum po la yang ngo / /de nyid ni rjes su dran pa'i gnas skabs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi sa la mthar phyin pa la sbyor ba'i yang ⑫phyir te/ lhun gyis grub par sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad pa'i phyir ro/ /de nyid ni de'i bdag nyid du nye bar 'gro ba'i nyunyeganas skabs so/ /nyes dmigs rtogs pa ni/gnas skabs su gyur pa med na'o/ /nyes dmigs rnam pa bzhi ste/ nyon mongs 70—922

pa mi 'jug pa'i rten med pa'i nyes dmigs dang / lam 'jug pa'i rten med pa'i nyes dmigs dang / gang zag mya ngan las 'das par tha snyad gzhag pa'i rten med pa'i nyes dmigs dang / byang chub rnam pa gsum gyi khyad par kyi tha snyad gzhag pa'i rten med pa'i nyes dmigs so/ /de dag las bzlog pa la brten nas gnas yongs su gyur pa yod pa la/ phan yon rnam pa bzhi nyid du rig pa'o①/ /de dag nyid ni gnas gyur pa ji lta bar rtogs pa rnam pa bcur ②rig par bya'o/ /med pa'i chos snang ba ni/ dper na ①sgyu ma dang rmi lam la sogs pa bzhin no/ /gnas gyur pa'i dpe ni/ nam mkha' dang gser dang chu la sogs pa bzhin no// //chos dang chos nyid rnam par 'byed pa 'phags pa byams pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta shārnyi bha dra dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ④ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas ⑤bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa las/ slad kyis ④kha che'i mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta pa ra he ta dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong dga' rdor gyis thugs dam sa tho ling gi gtsug lag khang du bcos shing gtan la phab pa// //maṅga lo⑦//70—923
dang sa da rnam par da pa bzhugs / 925bsdur 'bras re'u migasems r+sha/ (3) 70—925

༄ga /chos dang chos nyid rnam par 'byed pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa bzhugs so//①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ dharmā ②dharma tā bi snye ga kā ri kā/ bod skad du/ chos dang chos nyid rnam par 'byed pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ mgon po byams pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes nas gang ①zhig yongs su spang bya zhing / /gzhan 'ga' zhig ni mngon sum nyid du bya/ /des na de dag mtshan nyid rnam dbye ba/ /byed par 'dod nas ④bstan bcos 'di brtsams soX/ /'di dag thams cad mdor bsdu na/ /rnam pa gnyis su shes bya ste/ /chos dang de bzhin chos nyid kyis pya/ /thams cad bsdus pa nyid phyir ro/ /de la chos kyis phye ba ni/ /'khor ba yin te chos nyid kyis/ /rab tu phye ba theg gsum gyi/ /mya ngan las ni 'das pa 'o/ /de la ④chos kyi mtshan nyid ni/ /gnyis dang ji ltar mngon brjod par/ /snang ba yang dag ma yin pa'i/ /kun rtog pa ste med snang phyir/ /des na yang dag ma yin pa'o/ /de yang thams cad don med cing / /rtog 70/de926

tsam yin pas kun rtog pa'o/ /gzhan yang chos nyid mtshan nyid ni/ /gzung ba dang ni 'dzin pa dang / /brjod par bya dang rjod par byed/ /khyad med de bzhin nyid yin no/ /med pa snang phyir 'a la pa ni/ /kun nas nyon mongs rgyu ①yin te/ /sgyu ma'i glang chen sogs snang zhing ②/ /yod pa'ang snang ba min phyir ro②/ /med snang dag las gang rung zhig /med na 'khrul dang ma 'khrul dang / /de bzhin kun nas nyon mongs dang / /rnam par byang ba mi 'thad do/ /gnyis po dag ni gcig nyid dang / /so so ba yang ma yin te/ /yod pa dang ni med pa dag /khyad par yod dang med phyir ro/ /rnam pa drug gis chos dag ④la/ /'jug pa bla na med pa ste/ /mtshan nyid dang ni grub pa dang ⑤/ /gcig dang tha dad ma yin zhing / /gnas ni thun mong thun mong min/ /gzung dang ①'dzin par snang ba ni/ /med la rab tu 'jug pas so/ /de la mtshan nyid grub pa dang / /gcig dang tha dad ma yin pa/ /ji ltar mdor bstan bzhin du 'o/ /gang zhig gang du 'khor ba na/ /de ni kun tu gnas pa ste / /sems can khams dang snod kyi khams/ /snod kyi khams ni thun mong ④ltar / /rnam par rig pa thun mong yin/ /sems can khams ni thun mong dang / /yang na thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /de yang ⑧skye dang tha snyad dang / /rjes su gzung dang tshar gcad ⑨dang / /phan pa dang ni gnod pa dang / /yon tan skyon ni phan tshun du/ /bdag po nyid kyi ⑩phan tshun rgyu⑫/ /yin pa'i phyir na thun mong ba'o/ /gnas dang rnam par rig pa dang / /bde sdug las dang 'chi 'pho dang / /skye ba dang ni bcings pa dang / /grol ba thun mong ma yin phyir/ /de gnas 7thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /phyi rol gzung ba thun mong 70—927

bar / /snang ba 'dzin pa'i rnam rig pa'o/ /rnam par shes las phyi rol du/ /gyur pa'i don yod ma yin te/ /thun mong ba nyid yin phyir ro/ /cig shos thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /gzung ba rnam par rig pa'i don/ /gzhan gyi sems la sogs pa ni/ /mnyam par ma bzhag mnyam gzhag pa'i/ /'dzin pa'i rnam par rig pa la/ /phan tshun yul gyur ma yin te/ /mnyam par ①ma bzhag dag ⑤la ni/ /rang gi rnam rtog snang phyir dang / /mnyam par gzhag pa dag la ni/ /ting 'dzin de yi ⑤spyod yul de'i/ /gzugs brnyan rab tu snang phyir ro/ /gzung bar snang ba med grub na/ /'dzin par snang ba med grub po/ /de las kyang ni gzung ba dang / /'dzin par snang ba med pa la/ /'jug pa grub ste thog med pa'i/ /kun nas ldang ba grub pas so/ /gnyis su yongs su ma grub ④par / /rab tu grub pa ⑤yin phyir ro/ /rnam pa drug gis chos nyid la/ /'jug pa bla na med pa ste/ /mtshan nyid kun tu gnas pa dang / /nges par 'byed dang reg pa dang / /rjes su dran dang de'i bdag ④nyid/ /nye bar son la 'jug pas so/ /mtshan nyid mdo ni ji lta bzhin/ /gnas ni chos rnams thams cad dang / /gsung rab ④mdo sde thams cad do⑧/ /de la nges par 'byed pa ni/ /theg pa chen po'i mdo sde la/ /brten pa'i tshul bzhin yid byed pas/ /bsdus pa'i sbyor lam thams cad do/ /reg pa yang dag lta thob phyir / /mthong ba'i lam gyis ⑨mngon sum gyi/ /tshul du de bzhin nyid thob cing / /nyams su myong ba gang yin pa'o/ /rjes su dran pa rig ⑫pas ni/ /mthong ba'i don la bsgom ⑫lam gyi/ /byang chub phyogs kyis bsdus pa ste/ /de ni ⑫dri ma sel ba'i phyir/ /de la de yi bdag nyid du/ /nye bar son pa de 70/de928

bzhin nyid/ /dri ma med par gyur pa na/ /thams cad de bzhin nyid tsam du/ /snang ba de yang gnas gyur pa/ /grub pa yin no rnam pa bcus/ /gnas yongs ①gyur la 'jug pa ni/ /bla na med pa nyid yin te/ /ngo bo rdzas dang gang zag dang / /khyad par ②dgos pa gnas dang ni/ /yid la byed dang sbyor ba dang / /nyes dmigs phan yon 'jug pas so/ /de la ngo bor ①'jug pa ni/ /glo bur ba yi dri ma dang / /de bzhin nyid mi ④snang ba dang / /snang ba'i don du ⑤de bzhin nyid/ /dri ma med pa gang yin pa'o/ /dngos po rdzas la 'jug pa ni/ /thun mong snod kyi rnam rig pa/ /de bzhin nyid du gyur pa dang / /mdo sde chos kyi dbyings nyid kyi/ /de bzhin nyid du gyur pa dang / /thun mong min pa sems can gyi/ /khams kyi rnam par rig pa yi/ /de bzhin nyid du gyur pa 'o/ /gang zag dag la 'jug pa ni/ /dang po gnyis ni sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ni/ /de bzhin nyid yongs gyur pa ste//phyi ma nyan thos rnams dang ni/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi yang yin no/ /khyad par can la 'jug pa ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /zhing yongs ④dag pa'i khyad par dang / /chos sku longs spyod rdzogs pa dang / /sprul sku thob pas gzigs pa dang / /'doms pa dang ni dbang 'byor nyid/ /thob pa'i khyad par las yin no/ /dgos pa rtogs la 'jug pa ni/ /sngon gyi don lam khyad par dang / /theg pa chen po ④ston pa yikhya/ /dmigs pa'i khyad par sa bcu la/ /rab tu sbyor ba'i khyad par ro/ /gnas sam rten la 'jug pa ni//rnam par mi rtog ④ye shes la/ /'jug pa rnam pa drug gis te/ /dmigs dang mtshan ma spangs pa dang / /yang dag pa yi ⑫sbyor ba dang / /mtshan nyid dang 70—929

ni phan yon dang / /yongs su shes la 'jug pas so/ /de la dang po dmigs pa la/ /'jug pa rnam pa ①bzhir shes bya②/ /theg pa chen po ston pa dang / /de la mos dang nges pa dang / /tshogs ni yongs su rdzogs pas so/ /gnyis pa mtshan ma spangs pa la/ /'jug pa yang ni rnam bzhi ste/ /mi mthun pa dang gnyen po dang / /de bzhin nyid dang rtogs pa yi⑤/ /mtshan ma dag ni spangs pas so/ /'dis ༅ni rim pa ji lta bzhin/ /rags dang 'byung dang phra mo dang / /ring du rjes su 'brel pa yikhya / /mtshan ma yongs su spangs pa yin/ /yang dag pa yi sbyor ba la/ /'jug pa yang ni rnam bzhi ste/ /dmigs pa yi ni sbyor ba dang / /mi dmigs pa yi sbyor ba dang / /dmigs pa mi dmigs sbyor ba dang //mi dmigs dmigs pa'i sbyor ba 'o/ /de la mtshan nyid 'jug pa ni/ /rnam pa gsum kyis ༅ shes bya ste/ /chos nyid gnas pa nyid las ni/ /gnyis su med cing brjod med pa'i/ /chos nyid rab tu gnas phyir ro/ /snang ba med las gnyis dang ni/ /ji ltar mngon par brjod pa dang / /dbang po yul dang ④rnam rig ༅dang / /snod kyi 'jig rten snang med phyir/ /des na 'dis ni rtag ⑨med pa/ /bstan du med pa gnas med pa/ /snang ba med cing rnam rig ④med//gnas 1rtemed pa zhes bya ba ༅ste/ /rnam par mi rtog ye shes kyi/ /mtshan nyid mdo bzhin brjod pa yin/ /snang ba las ni chos thams cad/ /nam mkha'i dkyil mnyam snang phyir ro/ /'du byed thams cad sgyu ma sogs/ /lta bur snang ba yin phyir ro/ /phan yon 'jug pa rnam bzhi ste/ /chos sku rdzogs par thob pa dang / /gong na med pa'i bde thob dang / /gzigs pa dbang 'byor 'thob pa dang / /ston la dbang 'byor thob pa 'okhya/ /yongs su shes la 'jug pa ni/ /70—930

rnam pa bzhi ru shes bya ste/ /gnyen po yongs su shes pa dang / /mtshan nyid yongs su shes pa dang / /khyad par yongs su shes pa dang / /las lnga yongs su shes pa 'o/ /de la gnyen po shes pa ni/ /rnam par mi rtog ①ye shes te/ /chos dang gang zag 'dzin pa dang / /yongs gyur pa dang ②tha dad dang / /skur pa 'debs pa nyid yin te/ /med pa 'dzin pa rnam pa lnga'i/ /gnyen po bstan pa yin phyir ro/ /mtshan nyid yongs su shes pa ni/ /yid la mi byed yang dag 'das/ /nye bar zhi dang ngo bo'i don/ /mngon rtags ①'dzin pa rnam pa lnga/ /spangs pa'i rang gi ④mtshan nyid do/ /khyad par yongs su shes pa ni / /rnam par mi rtog pa nyid dang / /nyi tshe ba ni ma yin dang / /gnas med pa dang gtan du dang / /gong na med pa'i rnam pa ste/ /khyad par rnam pa lnga yin no/ /tha ma las yongs shes pa ni/ /rnam rtog ⑤ring du byed pa dang / /bla na med pa'i bde ster ④dang / /nyon mongs pa dang shes bya yi/ /sgrib pa bral bar byed pa dang / /de yi rjes las thob pa yig/ /ye shes shes bya'i rnam pa ni/ /thams cad la ni 'jug pa dang / /sangs rgyas zhing ni sbyong ba dang / /sems can yongs su smin byed dang / /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid/ /gtod cing ster ④bar byed pa ste/ /rnam ⑨lnga las kyi khyad par ro/ /yid la byad ⑫la 'jug pa ni/ /rnam par mi rtog ye shes la/ /'jug par 'dod pa'i gang zag ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa/ /'di ltar yid la byed pa ste/ /de bzhin nyid ni mi shes pas/ /mi bden par ni yongs brtags skyepa'i / /sa bon thams cad pa zhes pa/ /med pa gnyis su snang ba'i rgyu/ /de la brten ⑫pa'i tha dad rgyu/ /des na rgyu dang 'bras bur bcas/ /snang du 70—931

zin kyang med pa 'o/ /de snang chos nyid mi snang zhing / /de mi snang bas chos nyid snang / /de ltar tshul bzhin yid byed na/ /byang chub sems dpa' mi rtog pa'i / /ye shes la ni 'jug ①pa 'o/ /de ltar dmigs las ②rnam rig tsam/ / ①dmigs las don rnams mi dmigs dang / /don rnams mi dmigs pa las ni//rnam par rig tsam mi dmigs dang / /de mi dmigs las gnyis po ni/ /khyad par med pa'i dmigs la 'jug /de gnyis ①khyad par mi dmigs pa⑤/ /de ni rnam par mi rtog pa'i/ /ye shes yul med dmigs med pa/ /mtshan ma thams cad mi dmigs pas/ /rab phye ba ni yin phyir ro/ /sbyor bas sa la 'jug pa ni/ /rnam pa bzhi ru shes bya ste/ /mos pa'i rab tu sbyor bas ni/ /mos pas spyod pa'i sa la ste/ /nges par ④'byed pa'i gnas skabs so/ /so sor rab tu rtogs ༅pa yi/ /sbyor bas sa ni dang po ste/ /de nyid reg pa'i gnas skabs so/ /bsgom pas rab tu sbyor bas ni/ /ma dag pa yi ②sa drug dang / /dag pa'i sa ni gsum po ste/ /de ni rjes dran gnas skabs so/ /mthar phyin pa la sbyor bas ni/ /lhun gyis grub par sangs rgyas kyi⑨/ /mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad phyir te༅/ /de ni de yi bdag nyid du/ /nye bar 'gro ba'i gnas skabs so/ /nyes dmigs dag la 'jug pa ni/ /gnas yongs gyur pa med pa yi/ /nyes dmigs bzhi ste nyon mongs pa/ /mi 'jug rten med nyes pa dang / /lam 'jug rten med nyes pa dang / /mya ngan 'das pa'i gang zag rnams / /gdags pa'i gzhi med nyes pa dang / /byang chub gsum gyi khyad par dag /gdags pa'i gzhi ⑪med nyes pa 'o/ /bzlog nas phan yon 'jug pa ni/ /rnam pa bzhi ru shes par bya'o / /med pa'i chos rnams snang ba'i dpe//70—932

sgyu ma rmi lam sogs pa ①bzhin/ /gnas yongs gyur pa dper bya na/ /nam mkha' gser dang chu sogs bzhin / /⑤chos dang chos nyid rnam par 'byed pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ mgon po byams pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// // kha che'i mkhan ①po ma hā dza na dang / lo tsā ba dge slong ④seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o⑤// // maṅga lo/ /༅bsdur mchan/926 ①mar byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉nga〈co 〉ngar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉༅ go chos dang chos nyid rnam ༅da tshig bcad ma bzhugs/ zhes 'khod/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉〉dharma/ ①〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉༅ga'/ ④〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉〉pas/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉༅rtsom mo/ 0 〈〈pe 〉rgya/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉༅sa/927 0〈〈pe 〉bong / 〈'ar 〉bo/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉༅〈snar 〉tha snang bzhin/ ①〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉༅ yang ni mi snang phyir/④〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉rams/ ①〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉snye/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༅nga / ④〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉jongs/⑤〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉༅/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉༅cad/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉rgyas/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉༄/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉ras/928 ①〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉༅/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉ngashar 〉༅/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉nga 'dzin gyi/ ④〈〈snar 〉༅grub/⑤〈〈pe〉nga'ar 〉༅ra/ ④〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉rna dag ④〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉rna/ /'on kyang / ⑤〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉〉kyang / ⑨〈〈pe 〉rgya/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉ngag ⑩〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉rgam/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉ngasnar 〉༅/929 ①〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉༅da/ ⑤〈〈co 〉༅sa/ ④〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉༅/ ④〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉rna/ ༅〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉〉te/ ④〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉༅su/ ④〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉༅sa/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉༅sa/ ༅〈〈snar 〉tshogs/⑫〈〈snar 〉༅sa/93༷ ①〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉ngapa/ ༅〈〈pe 〉༅ ste/ 〈〈snar 〉༅ bya ste/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ngang / ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈(snar 〉〉'dir/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉༅sa/ 0〈〈co 〉chu/ ༅〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉ngadang / khya〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉༅pa/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༅rtag khya〈〈snar 〉ngags/ yi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༅pa/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ngab/ kyi〈〈pe 〉tsār/⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rang /931 ①〈〈snar 〉gogs/ ④〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉ma 'gyur ba/ ༅〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉༅rtags/ ④〈〈snar 〉rgas/ ④〈〈snar 〉〉70—933

rtogs / rjo〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉stong / ⑦〈〈snar 〉stanas/ ⑧〈〈snar 〉skasto/ ⑨〈'dir 〉mi pa ⑩〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉skrugrid/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉brtag ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉rten/932 ①〈〈snar 〉torajugs/ ②〈〈pe 〉po〈snar 〉〉pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉〉dmigs dang rnam par rig tsam du/ /du〈〈snar 〉〉nyid/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉snganams/ du〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉pas/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉rtog ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanas/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉nya)sa/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉ro/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉bzhi/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gra/933 ①〈〈pe 〉〉pa sogs/ 〈〈snar 〉〉pa so/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉ska/ // ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pasnyi ta chen/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsnyen/ du〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉ba'o/ 0〈〈pe〉sko〈snar 〉〉wamaṅga //bsdur 'bras re'u migasems tsam/ (4)70wa 934

༄ga /theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos bzhugs so//༅༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā ya na ut+ta ༅ra tan+t+ra shās/ bod skad du/ theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas chos tshogs khams dang byang chub dang / /yon tan ༅sangs rgyas phrin las tha ma ste/ /bstan bcos kun gyi lus ni mdor bsdu na/ /rdo rje yi ni gnas bdun 'di dag go/ /'di dag rang mtshan nyid kyi ༅rjes 'brel bzhu/ /go rims ji bzhin gzungs kyi rgyal po'i mdor/ /gleng gzhi ༅las ni gnas gsum rig bya ste/ /gzhi ༅ni blo ldan rgyal chos dbye ba las/ /sangs rgyas las chos chos las 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /tshogs las snying po ye shes khams thob ༅mthar/ /ye shes de thob ⑨byang chub mchog thob ⑫sogs/ /sems can kun don byed chos rnams dang ldan/ /gang zhig thog ma dbus mtha' med zhi sangs rgyas nyid rang rnam sangs rgyas/ /70—935

sangs rgyas nas ni ma rtogs rtogs phyir 'jig med rtag pa'i lam ston pa/ /ma/de brtse'i ral gri rdo rje mchog bsnams sdug bsngal myu gu gcod mdzad cing ①/ /sna tshogs lta thibs kyis bskor the tshom rtsig khyapa 'jig mdzad de la 'dud/ /'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub/ /gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs min pa༅/ /ma/de dang brtse dang nus par ldan/ /don gnyis ldan pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /thog ma dbus mtha' med pa yi/ /rang bzhin yin phyir 'dus ma byas zhi ba chos kyi sku can phyir/ /lhun gyis grub ces bya bar brjod/ /so so rang gis ༅rtogs bya'i phyir/ /gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs min pa/ /de ltar rnam gsum rtogs phyir mdon/ /lam ston phyir na thugs brtse ba/ /nus pa ye shes thugs rje yis/ /sdug bsngal nyon mongs spong phyir ro/ /dang po gsum gyis rang don te / /phyi ma gsum gyis gzhan don yin/ /gang zhig med min yod min yod med ma yin yod med las ༅gzhan du'ang / /brtag par mi nus nges tshig dang bral so so rang gis rig zhi gyeb/ /dri med ye shes 'od zer snang ldan dmigs pa kun la chags ༅pa dang / /sdang dang rab rib rnam par 'joms mdzad dam chos nyi ma de la 'dud/ /bsam med gnyis med rtog kyimed pa/ /dag gsal gnyen po'i phyogs nyid kyis/ /gang zhig gang gis chags bral ba/ /bden gnyis mtshan nyid can de chos/ /chags bral nyid ni 'gog pa dang / /lam gyi bden pa dag gis bsdus/ /go rims ji bzhin de dag kyang / /yon tan gsum gsum gyis rig bya/ /brtag ༅min phyir dang brjod min phyir/ /'phags pas mdon phyir bsam med nyid/ /zhi nyid gnyis med rtog med de/ /dag sogs gsum ni nyi bzhin no/ /sems de rang bzhin 'od gsal bas na 70—936

nyon mongs ngo bo med gzigs pas/ /gang dag ①'gro kun bdag med mtha' zhi yang dag rtogs nas thams cad la/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rjes zhugs gzigs pa sgrib pa med pa'i blo mnga' ba/ /sems can rnam dag mtha' yas yul can ye shes gzigs mnga' de la 'dud/ /ji lta ②ji snyed nang gi ni/ /ye shes gzigs pa dag pa'i phyir/ /blo ldan phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs / /bla med yon tan dang ldan nyid/ /'gro ba zhi ba'i chos nyid du/ /rtogs phyir ji lta nyid de yang / /rang bzhin gyis ni yongs dag phyir/ /nyon mongs gdod nas zad phyir ro/ /shes bya mthar thug rtogs pa'i blos/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos nyid ni/ /sems can thams cad la yod par༅/ /mthong phyir ji snyed yod pa nyid/ /de ltar rtogs pa gang yin de/ /so so rang shes mthong ba nyid/ /dri med dbyings la chags med dang / /thogs med phyir de dag pa yin/ /ye shes gzigs pa dag pas na/ /sangs rgyas ye shes bla med phyir/ /'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa ni/ /lus can kun gyi skyabs yin no/ /ston pa bstan pa bslab don gyis④/ /theg pa gsum dang byed gsum la/ /mos pa rnams kyi ༅dbang byas nas/ /skyabs gsum rnam par bzhag pa yin/ /spang phyir bslu ༅ ba'i chos can phyir/ /med phyir 'jigs dang bcas pa'i phyir/ /chos rnams ༅gnyis dang 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /gtan gyi skyabs mchog ma yin no/ /dam pa'i don du 'gro ba yi/ /skyabs ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig ༅yin/ /thub pa chos kyi sku can phyir/ /tshogs kyang de yi mthar thug phyir/ /'byung ba dkon phyir dri med phyir/ /mthu ldan phyir dang 'jig rten gyi/ /rgyan gyur phyir dang mchog nyid phyir/ /'gyur ba 70—937

med phyir dkon mchog nyid/ /dri bcas de bzhin nyid dang dri ma med/ /dri med sangs rgyas yon tan rgyal ba'i mdzad①/ /gang las dkon mchog dge khyab gsum 'byung ba/ /don dam gzigs pa rnams kyi yul nyid do/ /dkon mchog gsum po 'di yi rigs/ /thams cad gzigs pa rnams kyi yul/ /de yang rnam bzhi go rims bzhin/ /rgyu bzhi yis ni bsam mi khyab/ /dag dang nyon mongs dang ldan phyir/ /kun nas nyon mongs med dag phyir/ /rnam par dbye ba med chos phyir/ /lhun grub rnam par mi rtog ①phyir/ /rtogs bya rtogs pa de yi ni/ /yan lag rtogs par byed phyir te/ /go rims ji bzhin gnas gcig de༅/ /dag rgyu gsum ni rkyen yin no/ /rdzogs sangs sku ni 'phro phyir dang / /de bzhin nyid dbyer med phyir dang / /rigs yod phyir na lus can kun / /rtag tu sangs rgyas snying po can/ / sangs rgyas ye shes sems can tshogs zhugs phyir/ /rang bzhin dri med de ni gnyis med de/ /sangs rgyas rigs la de 'bras nyer brtags phyir/ /'gro kun sangs rgyas snying po can du gsungs / /phyingo bo rgyu 'bras las ldan 'jug pa dang / /gnas skabs de bzhin phyokun tu 'gro ba'i don/ /rtag tu mi 'gyur yon tan dbyer med ni/ /don dam dbyings kyi dgongs don yin zhes bya/ /rin chen nam mkha' chu dag bzhin / /rtag tu rang bzhin nyon mongs med/ /chos mos lhag pa'i shes rab dang / /ting 'dzin snying brtse ༅las byung ba/ /mthu dang gzhan du mi 'gyur dang / /brlan pa'i ngo bo'i sherang bzhin phyir/ /'di dag nor bu rin chen mkha'/ /chu yi yon tan chos mthun nyid/ /chos la khong khro bdag lta dang / /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs dang / /sems can don la ltos 70—938

med nyid/ /'dod chen mu stegs nyan thos dang / /rang byung ①rnams kyi sgrib rnam bzhi/ /dag rgyu lhag par mos pa lakhya// /sogs pa'i chos ni rnam bzhi nyid//theg mchog la mos sa bon shes rab ni/ /sangs rgyas chos bskyed ma dang bsam gtan gyi/ /bde ba'i ①mngal gnas snying rje'i ma ma can/ /gang yin de dag thub pa'i rjes skyes sras/ /gtsang bdag bde dang rtag nyid kyi/ /yon tan pha rol phyin pa ④'bras/ /sdug bsngal yid 'byung zhi thob par/ /'dun dang smon pa'i las can no/ /'di dag 'bras ni mdor bsdu na/ /chos kyi sku la phyin ci log /rnam pa bzhi las bzlog pa yi/ /gnyen pos rab tu phye ba nyid/ /de ni rang bzhin dag phyir dang / /bag chags spang ⑤phyir gtsang ba yin/ /bdag byudang bdag med spros pa dag /nye bar zhi bas dam pa'i bdag /yid kyi rang bzhin phung po dang / /de rgyu log phyir bde ba nyid/ /'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das/ /mnyam pa nyid du rtogs phyir rtag /bdag sred ma lus shes rab kyis bcad de/ /sems can sred phyir brtse ldan zhi thob min/ /de ltar blo brtse byang chub thabs brten ④nas/ /'phags pa 'khor ba'am mya ngan 'da' mi 'gyur/ /gal te sangs rgyas khams med na/ /sdug la skyo bar mi 'gyur zhing //mya ngan 'das la 'dod pa dang / /don gnyer smon pa'ang med par 'gyur/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das la de'i/ /sdug bde'i skyon yon mthong ba 'di/ /rigs yod las yin gang phyir de/ /rigs med dag la med phyir ro/ /rgya mtsho che bzhin dpag med pa'i༅/ /yon tan rin chen mi zad gnas/ /dbyer med yon tan dang ldan pa'i/ /ngo bo nyid phyir mar me bzhin/ /chos sku rgyal ba'i ye shes dang / /thugs rje'i khams ni bsdus pa'i phyir/ /snod 70—939

dang rin chen chu yis ni①/ /rgya mtsho dang ni mtshungs par bstan/ /dri med gnas la mngon shes dang / /ye shes dri med de nyid dang / /rnam dbye med phyir mar me yi/ /snang dang dro mdog ⑤chos mtshungs can/ /so so'i skye 'phags rdzogs sangs kyi/ /de bzhin nyid dbye'i 'jug pa las/ /de nyid gzigs pas sems can la/ /rgyal ba'i snying po 'di bstan to/ /so so ②skye bo phyin ci log /bden pa mthong ba bzlog pa ste/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ji lta bzhin / /phyin ci ma log ④spros med nyid/ /ma dag ma dag dag pa dang / /shin tu rnam dag go rims bzhin/ /sems can byang chub sems dpa' dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa zhes brjod do/ /ngo bo nyid la sogs pa'i don/ /'di drug gis ni bsdus pa yi/ /khams ni gnas skabs gsum dag tu/ /ming gsum gyis ni bstan pa yin༅/ /ji ltar rtog med bdag nyid can/ /nam mkha' kun tu rjes song ltar/ /sems kyi rang bzhin dri med dbyings/ /de bzhin kun tu 'gro ba nyid/ /de spyi'i mtshan nyid nyes pa dang / /yon tan mthar thug khyab pa ste/ /gzugs kyi rnam pa dman pa dang / /bar ma mchog la nam mkha' bzhin/ /nyes pa glo bur dang ldan dang / /yon tan rang bzhin nyid ldan phyir/ /ji ltar sngar bzhin phyis de bzhin/ /'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid do/ /ji ltar nam mkha' kun song ba/ /phra phyir ④nye bar gos pa med/ /de bzhin sems can thams cad la/ /gnas 'di nye bar gos pa med / /ji ltar 'jig rten thams cad du/ /nam mkha' la ④ni skye zhing 'jig/de bzhin 'dus ma byas dbyings la/ /dbang po rnams ni skye zhing 'jig /ji ltar nam mkha' me rnams kyis/ /sngon chad nam yang tshig pa med/ /de bzhin 70/de940

'di ni 'chi ba dang / /na dang rga ①ba'i mes mi ⑤'tshig /sa ni chu la chu rlung la / /rlung ni mkha' la rab tu gnas/ /mkha' ni rlung dang chu dag dang / /sa yi khams la gnas ma yin/ /de bzhin phung po khams dbang rnams/ /las dang nyon mongs dag la gnas/ /las dang nyon mongs tshul bzhin min/ /yid la byed la rtag ②tu gnas/ /tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed ni/ /sems kyi dag pa la rab gnas/ /sems kyi rang bzhin chos rnams ni/ /thams cad la yang gnas pa med/ /sa dang 'dra ba ④phung po dang / /skye mched khams rnams shes par bya/ /chu khams dang 'dra lus can gyi / /las dang nyon mongs shes bya ste/ /tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed ni/ /rlung gi khams dang 'dra bar lta ④/ /rang bzhin nam mkha'i khams bzhin du/ /de bzhin can min gnas pa med/ /tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed ni/ /sems kyi rang bzhin la gnas te/ /tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed kyis/ /las dang nyon mongs rab tu phye/ /las dang nyon mongs chu las ni/ /phung po skye mched khams rnams 'byung / /de 'jig ༅pa dang chags pa ltar⑤/ /skye dang 'jig par 'gyur ba yin/ /sems kyi rang bzhin nam mkha' yi/ /khams ltar rgyu med rkyen med de/ /tshogs pa med cing skye ba dang / /'jig dang gnas la'ang ⑨yod ma yin/ /sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal gang yin pa/ /de ni nam mkha' bzhin du 'gyur med de/ /yang dag min rtogs 0las byung 'dod chags sogs/ /glo bur dri mas de nyon mongs mi 'gyur/ /las dang nyon mongs chu sogs tshekyis/ /'di ni mngon par 'grub min te/ /'chi dang na dang rga ba'i me/ /mi bzad pas kyang 'tshig ⑩mi 'gyur/ /dus mtha' dmyal ba tha mal pa'i/ /me gsum 'chi ༅dang 70—941

na ba dang / /rga ba'i me gsum rim bzhin du/ /de dag ༅ 'dra bar shes par bya / /skye 'chi ⑤na dang rga ba las grol ba/ /'di yi rang bzhin ji bzhin nyid rtogs te/ /skye sogs phongs khya dang bral yang de yi ④rgyus/ /blo ldan 'gro la snying rje bskyed phyir bsten/ /'phags pas 'chi dang na ba dang / /rga ba'i sdug bsngal rtsad khya nas spangs/ /las dang nyon mongs dbang gis skye/ /de la de med phyis kyide med/ /ji bzhin yang dag mthong ba'i phyir/ /skye sogs rnams las 'das gyur kyang / /snying rje'i bdag nyid skye ba dang / /'chi dang rga dang na bar ston/ /rgyal sras 'gyur med chos nyid 'di/ /rtogs nas ma rig 3sdongs rnams kyis3/ /skye ba la sogs dag tu ni/ /mthong ba gang yin de ḍasmad do/ /'phags pa'i spyod yul thob pa gang / /byis pa'i spyod yul du ston te/ /de nyid phyir na 'gro ba yi/ /gnyen gyi tshethabs dang snying rje kyimachog /de ni 'jig rten thams cad las/ /'das kyang 'jig rten las ma g.yos/ /'jig rten don du 'jig rten na/ /'jig rten dri mas ma gos spyod/ /ji ltar pad+ma chu nang du/ /skyes pa chu yis gos pa med/ /de bzhin 'di ni 'jig rten du/ /skyes kyang 'jig rten chos mi gos/ /bya ba sgrub la rtag tu blo/ /me bzhin du ni 'bar ba dang / /zhi ba'i bsam gtan snyoms 'jug la/ /rtag tu snyoms par zhugs pa yin/ /sngon gyi 'phen pa'i dbang dang ni/ /rnam rtog thams cad bral ba'i phyir/ /de ni lus can smin pa yi/ /don du 'bad pa byed ma yin/ /bstan dang gzugs sku dag dang ni/ /spyod dang spyod lam gyis kyang rung / /gang zhig ji ltar gang gis 'dul/ /des de de lta khyanyid du shes/ /de ltar nam mkha'i mtha' klas kyithu/ /'gro la rtag tu lhun grub par/ /70—942

thogs med blo ldan de yis ①ni/ /sems can don ni yang dag 'jug /byang chub sems dpa'i tshul 'di ni/ /rjes thob de bzhin gshegs rnams dang / /sems can yang dag sgrol ba la/ /'jig rten na ni mnyam pa nyid/ /de lta mod ⑤kyi sa rdul dang / /rgya mtsho ba glang ①rmig rjes kyi/ /khyad par gang yin sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i khyad de nyid/ /gzhan 'gyur min bdag mi zad chos ldan phyir/ /'gro skyabs phyi ma'i mtha' med mur thug ④phyir/ /de ni rtag tu gnyis med mi rtog phyir/ /'jig med chos kyang ma byas rang bzhin phyir / /skye ba med cing 'chi ba med/ /gnod med rga ba med pa ste/ /de ni rtag dang brtan phyir dang / /zhi ba'i phyir dang g.yung drung phyir/ /de ni yid kyi rang bzhin gyiX/ /lus kyi skye med rtag pa'i phyir/ /bsam ༅ mi khyab 'gyur 'chi 'pho yis/ /de ni mi 'chi brtan pa'i phyir④/ /bag chags phra mo'i nad rnams kyis/ /gnod med zhi ba khya/nyid kyi phyir/ /zag med mngon par 'du byed ⑨kyis/ /g.yung drung phyir na rga ba med/ /de la tshig gnyis de bzhin gnyis / /gnyis dang gnyis kyis go rims bzhin/ /'dus ma byas pa'i dbyings la ni/ /rtag pa la sogs don shes bya/ /mi zad yon tan dang ldan phyir / /gzhan 'gyur min bdag rtag pa'i don/ /mtha' yi mu dang mtshungs pa'i phyir/ /skyabs kyi bdag nyid brtan pa'i don/ /rnam par mi rtog rang bzhin phyir/ /gnyis med chos nyid zhi ba'i don/ /ma bcos yon tan nyid phyir na༅/ /'jig med don ni g.yung drung nyid/ /gang phyir de ni chos sku de ni de bzhin gshegs/ /de ni 'phags pa'i bden pa don dam mya ngan 'das/ /de phyir nyi dang zer bzhin yon tan dbyer med pas/ /sangs rgyas nyid las ma 70—943

gtogs mya ngan 'das pa med/ /mdor na zag med dbyings la ni/ /don gyi rab tu dbye ba bzhis/ /chos kyi sku la sogs pa yi/ /rnam grangs bzhir ni rig par bya/ /sangs rgyas chos dbyer med pa dang / /de rigs de bzhin thob pa dang / /brdzun med bslu ①med chos nyid dang / /gdod ②nas rang bzhin zhi nyid do/ /rnam kun mngon rdzogs ①byang chub dang / /dri ma bag chags bcas spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas mya ngan 'das pa ni④/ /dam pa'i don du gnyis med nyid/ /rnam pa thams cad grangs med pa/ /bsam med dri med yon tan dang / /dbyer med mtshan nyid thar pa ste/ /thar pa gang de de bzhin gshegs/ /ji ltar ri mo 'dri byed pa/ /gzhan dang gzhan la mkhas pa dag /gang zhig yan lag gang shes pa/ /de gzhan nges zin ⑤med par 'gyur / /de nas 'di la khyed kun gyis/ /nga yi gzugs ni gyis shig ces/ /mnga' bdag rgyal pos de dag la/ /bka' ④yis ras ni byin pa dang / /de las ༅de ni thos gyur te/ /ri mo'i las la rab sbyor ro/ /de la ④mngon par sbyor rnams la / /gcig gcig 0yul gzhan song gyur pakyi/ /de ni yul gzhan song bas na/ /de ma tshang phyir ri mo de/ /yan lag thams cad yongs rdzogs par/ /mi 'gyur bzhin shes dper byas so/ /de rnams 'dri byed gang yin pa/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod la sogs/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'itshe—/ /stong pa nyid ni gzugs su brjod/ /shes rab ye shes rnam grol rnams / /gsal dang 'phro dang dag phyir dang / /tha dad med phyir 'od dang zer / /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rnams dang mtshungs/ /des na sangs rgyas ma thob par/ /mya ngan 'das pa mi thob ⑩ste/ /'od dang 'od zer spangs nas ni//70—944

nyi ma lta bar mi nus bzhin/ /de ltar rgyal ba'i snying po ni/ /rnam gzhag rnam pa bcu zhes brjod/ /nyon mongs sbubs nang gnas pa de①/ /dpe dag gis ni shes par bya/ /sangs rgyas pad ngan ②sbrang rtsi sbrang ma la/ /sbun la snying po mi gtsang nang na gser/ /sa la gter dang sgyug ①sogs 'bras chung ④dang / /gos hrul nang na rgyal ba'i sku dang ni/ /bud med ngan ma'i ⑤lto na mi bdag dang / /sa la rin chen gzugs yod ji lta bar④/ /glo bur nyon mongs dri mas bsgribs pa yi/ /sems can rnams la de bzhin khams 'di ④gnas/ /dri ma pad+ma srog ②chags spun pa mi gtsang sa 'bras gos hrul dang / /sdug bsngal 'bar bas mngon par gdungs pa'i bud med sa yi khams dang mtshungs/ /sangs rgyas sbrang rtsi snying po gser dang gter dang rgya gro rin chen sku/ /gling bdag mchog dang rin chen gzugs dang dri med khams mchog mtshungs pa nyid/ /ji ltar mdog ngan pad ma'i khong gnas pa/ /mtshan stong gis 'bar de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ /dri med lha yi mig ldan mis ⑨mthong nas/ /chu skyes 'dab ma'i sbubs nas khya'abyin byed pa/ /de bzhin bde gshegs mnar med gnas rnams la'ang ༅/ /sangs rgyas spyan gyis rang chos nyid gzigs te/ /sgrib med phyi mtha'i mur gnas thugs 7rje yi/ /bdag cag bsgrib pa las ni grol bar mdzad⑫/ /ji ltar mi sdug pad+ma zum la bde bar gshegs pa ni/ /de yi khong gnas lha mig mthong nas 'dab ma gcod byed ltar/ /chags sdang sogs dri sbubs bsgribs rdzogs sangs snying po 'gro gzigs te/ /thugs rjes thub pa de bzhin sgrib pa de ni 'joms par mdzad/ /ji ltar srog chags tshogs bskor sbrang rtsi ni/ /skyes bu mkhas pas ⑫de don gnyer ba yis/ /mthong nas thabs 70—945

kyis de dang chasrog chags tshogs/ /kun nas bral ①bar rab tu byed ②pa bzhin//drang srong chen pos 0kun mkhyen spyan gyis ni/ /rig ⑤khams sbrang rtsi dang 'dra de phyogazigs nas/ /de yi sgrib pa sbrang ma dang 'dra ba/ /gtan nas rab tu spong bar mdzad pa yin/ /ji ltar sbrang rtsi srog ④chags bye ba khrag khrig stong bsgribs sbrang rtsi don gnyer mis/ /sbrang ma de dag bsal ⑤te ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du sbrang rtsi'i bya byed pa/ /de bzhin lus can la yod zag pa med pa'i shes pa sbrang ma'i rtsi dang 'dra/ /nyon mongs sbrang ma dang 'dra de 'joms pa la mkhas pa'i rgyal ba skyes bu bzhin/ /ji ltar spun ldan 'bru yi snying po ni/ /mi rnams kyis 1ni spyad byar mi 'gyur ba/ /zas sogs don du gnyer ba gang yin pa / /de dag gis ni sbun ༅nas de 'byin 7ltar/ /de bzhin sems can la yod nyon mongs kyi/ /dri ma dang 'dres rgyal ba'ang ji srid du/ /nyon mongs dri ma 'dres las 7ma grol ba/ /de srid rgyal mdzad srid gsum 'du ④mi byed/ /ji ltar sā ༅lu bra bo chenas 'bru'i snying po spun las ma byung gra ma can/ /legs par ma bsgrubs mi rnams kyis 3ni spyad bya bza' ba zhim por mi 'gyur ltar/ /de bzhin sems can la yod chos kyi dbang phyug nyon mongs sbubs ⑫las ma grol lus / /nyon mongs bkres pas 3nyen pa'i 'gro la chos kyi dga' ba'i ro ster 'gyur ba min/ /ji ltar rab tu rgyu tshe mi yi gser/ /ljan ljin rul ba'i gnas su lhung gyur pa/ /mi 'jig ༅/chos can de ni der de bzhin/ /lo brgya mang po dag tu gnas pa de/ /lha mig rnam dag dang ldan lha yis ༅der/ /mthong nas mi la 'di na yod pa'i gser/ /rin chen mchog 'di sbyangs te rin chen gyis/ /bsgrub 1par bya ba gyis zhes smra ba ltar/ /de bzhin thub pas mi 70—946

gtsang dang 'dra ba'i/ /nyon mongs su bying sems can yon tan ni/ /gzigs nas nyon mongs 'dam de dag bya'i phyir/ /skye dgu rnams la dam chos chu char 'bebs/ /ji ltar ljan ljin rul pa'i gnas su lhung ba'i gser ni lha yis mthong gyur nas/ /kun tu dag par bya phyir mchog tu mdzes pa ༅mi la nan gyis ston pa ltar/ /de bzhin rgyal bas ⑤nyon mongs mi gtsang chen por lhung gyur rdzogs sangs rin po che/ /sems can rnams la gzigs nas de dag bya phyir lus can rnams la chos ston to/ /ji ltar mi dbul khyim nang sa 'og na④//mi zad pa yi gter ni yod gyur la/ /mi des de ma shes te ④gter de yang / /de la nga 'dir yod ces mi smra ༅ltar/ /de bzhin yid kyi nang chud rin chen gter / /dri med gzhag dang bsal med chos nyid kyang / /ma rtogs pas na dbul ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ /rnam mang rgyun du skye dgu 'dis myong ngo / /ji ltar dbul po'i khyim nang du ni rin chen gter chud gyur pa'i mi la ni/ /rin chen gter bdag yod ces rjod ༅ par mi byed de ni mi yis shes min ltar/ /de bzhin chos gter yid kyi khyim gnas sems can rnams ④ni dbul po lta bu ste/ /de dag rnams kyis de thob bya phyir 'jig rten du ni drang srong yang dag bstams༅//ji ltar a mra la sogs shing 'bras la/ /yod pa'i sa bon myu gu 'jig med chos//sa rmos chu sogs ldan pa'i buljon shing gi/ /rgyal po'i dngos po rim gyis 'grub pa ltar/ /sems can rnams kyi ma rig ༅ sogs 'bras kyi/ /pags sbubs nang chud chos khams dge ba yang / /de bzhin dge ba de de la brten nas/ /rim gyis thub pa'i rgyal po'i dngos por 'gyur/ /chu dang nyi ma'i 'od dang rlung dang sa dus nam mkha'i rkyen rnams kyisayi/ /ta la dang ni a mra'i 'bras 70—947

spubs gseb nas shing skye ji ltar ①bar/ /sems can nyon mongs 'bras lpags nang chud rdzogs sangs sa bon myu gu yang / /de bzhin dge rkyen de dang de las chos mthong ༅'phel bar 'gyur ba yin/ /ji ltar rin chen las byas rgyal ba'i gzugs / /gos hrul dri ngan kyis ni gtums ①gyur pa/ /lam gnas lha yis mthong nas grol bya'i phyir/ /lam gnas don de de la smra ba ltar/ / thogs med spyan mnga' ༅rnam pa sna tshogs kyi/ /nyon mongs kyis gtums bde gshegs dngos po nyid/ /dud 'gro la yang gzigs nas de bzhin de/ /thar par bya ba'i 4don du thabs ston mdzod rjo/ /ji ltar rin chen rang bzhin de bzhin gshegs sku dri ngan gos gtums 3pa/ /lam gnas lha yi ⑤mig gis mthong nas thar phyir 6mi la ston pa ltar/ /de bzhin nyon mongs gos hrul gyis gtums — 'khor ba'i lam na gnas pa'i khams/ /dud 'gro la yang gzigs nas thar par bya phyir rgyal ba rgyachos ston to/ /ji ⑫ltar mi mo gzugs ngan mgon med 'ga'/ /mgon med 'dug gnas su ni 'dug gyur la/ /mngal gyis rgyal po'i dpal ni 'dzin byed pas/ /rang lto na yod mi bdag mi shes ltar//srid par skye ba mgon med khyim bzhin te/ /ma dag sems can mngal ldan bud med bzhin/ /de la gang zhig yod pas mgon bcas pa/ /dri med khams ni de yi mngal gnas bzhin/ /ji ltar bud med lus la dri bcas gos gyon ⑫mi sdug gzugs ldan pa/ /sa bdag mngal na gnas kyang mgon med khang par sdug bsngal mchog myong ltar/ /de bzhin bdag rang nang gnas mgon yod gyur kyang mgon med blo ldan pa/ /'gro ba nyon mongs dbang gis yid ma zhi bas ⑫sdug bsngal gzhi 3 la gnas/ /ji ltar nang gi gser zhun gzugs rgyas pa/ /70—948

zhi ba phyi rol sa yi rang bzhin can/ /mthong nas de shes pa dag nang gi gser//sbyang ①phyir phyi rol sgrib pa sel byed ltar/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal dri med khyarnams kyang ni/ /glo bur bar ni rnam par gzigs gyur nas①/ /rin chen 'byung gnas lta bu'i 'gro ba rnams/ /sgrib pa dag las sbyong mdzad byang chub mchog /ji ltar dri med gser 'bar las byas sa yi nang du chud gyur gzugs//zhi de rang bzhin mkhas pas rig nas sa dag sel bar byed par ④ltar/ /de bzhin kun mkhyen dag pa'i gser 'dra zhi ba'i yid ni mkhyen gyur nas/ /chos 'chad tshul gyis brdeg 2spyad sgrub pas sgrib pa dag ①ni sel bar ④mdzad/ /pad+ma srog chags bung ba dang / /sbun pa dang ni mi gtsang sa/ /'bras shun gos hrul bud med kyi/ /mngal dang sa yi spubs na yang / /sangs rgyas sbrang rtsi snying po bzhin/ /gser bzhin gter bzhin ljon pa bzhin/ /rin chen sku dang 'khor lo yis/ /bsgyur ༅ba bzhin dang gser gzugs bzhin/ /sems can khams kyi nyon mongs sbubs/ /ma 'brel thog ma med pa na/ /sems kyi rang bzhin dri med ni/ /thog ma med pa yin par brjod / /chags dang sdang dang rmongs dang de'i/ /kun ldang ༅drag dang bag chags dang / /mthong sgom lam spang ⑩ma dag dang / /dag pa'i sa la brten pa yi/ /dri ma rnam dgu pad+ma yi / /sbubs sogs dpe ④ni rab bstan te/ /nye ba'i nyon mongs sbubs kyi ni/ /dbye ba ⑫bye ba mtha' las 'das/ /chags sogs dri ma ༅dgu po 'di/ /mdor bsdus nas ⑫ni go rims bzhin/ /pad+ma'i sbubs la sogs pa yi/ /dpe dgu dag gis yang dag bstan/ /dri 'di dag gis byis rnams dang / /dgra bcom slob pa ⑫blo ldan rnams/ /rim bzhin bzhi dang gcig dang ni/ /gnyis dang 70—949

gnyis kyis ①ma dag nyid/ /ji ltar pad+ma 'dam skyes de/ /mdun du gyur na yid dga' dang / /phyis lanas dga' ba med 'gyur ba④/ /'dod chags dga' ba de bzhin no/ /ji ltar srog chags sbrang ma ni/ /shin tu 'khrugs te mdung brdeg ④ltar/ /de bzhin zhe sdang skye bas ⑤na/ /snying la sdug bsngal skyed par byed/ /ji lta ④'bras sogs snying po ni/ /phyi rol spun pas bsgribs pa ltar/ /de bzhin snying po'i don mthong ba/ /ma rig sgo nga'i spubs kyis ④bsgribs / /ji ltar mi gtsang mi mthun pa/ /de bzhin chags dang bcas rnams kyi/ /'dod pa bsten pa'i rgyu yin phyir/ /kun nas ldang ༅ba mi gtsang 'dra / /ji ltar nor ni bsgribs pas na/ /mi shes gter mi thob pa ⑨ltar/ /de bzhin skye la rang byung nyid/ /ma rig bag chags sa yis bsgribs/ /ji ltar myug sogs rim skye bas / /sa bon shun pa gcod pa ltar/ /de bzhin de nyid mthong ba yis/ /mthong spang ⑫rnams ni bzlog 7par 'gyur/ /'phags pa'i lam dang 'brel pa las/ /'jig tshogs snying po bcom rnams kyis//bsgom bralam ye shes spang khyabya rnams/ /gos hrul dag dang mtshungs par bstan//sa bdun la brten kyidri ma ni/ /mngal sbubs dri ma dag dang mtshungs/ /mngal spubs bral 'dra mi rtog ༅pa'i/ /ye shes rnam par smin pa bzhin/ /sa gsum rjes 'brel dri ma rnams/ /sa 'dam gos bzhin shes bya ste/ /bdag nyid chen po rdo rje lta'i/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis gzhom bya yin/ /de ltar chags sogs dri ma dgu/ /pad+ma la sogs dag dang mtshungs/ /rang bzhin gsum gyis bsdus phyir khams/ /sangs rgyas sogs dang chos mtshungs so/ /'di yi rang bzhin chos sku dang / /de bzhin nyid dang rigs kyang ste/ /de ni dpe 70—950

gsum gcig dang ni/ /lnga rnams kyis ni shes par bya/ /chos sku rnam gnyis shes bya ste/ /chos dbyings shin tu dri med dang / /de yi rgyu mthun zab pa dang //sna tshogs tshul ni ston pa 'o/ /'jig rten 'das phyir 'jig rten na/ /'di la dpe ni mi dmigs pas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid dang khams/ /'dra ba nyid du bstan pa yin/ /phra mo zab mo'i tshul bstan ni/ /sbrang rtsi ro gcig pa bzhin te/ /rnam pa sna tshogs tshul bstan ni/ /sna tshogs sbubs snying bzhin shes bya/ /rang bzhin 'gyur ba med pa dang / /dge dang rnam par dag pa'i phyir / /de bzhin nyid khya'adi gser gyi ni/ /gzugs dang mtshungs par brjod pa yin/ /gter dang 'bras bu'i shing bzhin du/ /rigs de rnam gnyis shes bya ste/ /thog med rang bzhin gnas pa dang / /yang dag blang ba ༅mchog nyid do/ /rigs 'di gnyis las sangs rgyas kyi/ /sku gsum thob par 'dod pa yin/ /dang po'i ⑤sku ni dang po ste/ /gnyis pa yis ni phyi ma gnyis/ /ngo bo nyid sku mdzes pa ni/ /rin chen sku 'drar shes bya ste/ /rang bzhin gyis ni byas min dang / /yon tan rin chen gter yin phyir/ /chos chen rgyal srid che ldan phyir/ /rdzogs longs 'khor los sgyur bzhin no/ /gzugs brnyan gyi ④ni rang bzhin phyir/ /sprul pa gser gyi gzugs lta bu/ /rang byung rnams kyi don dam de ༅ / /dad pa nyid kyis rtogs bya yin ༅/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba/ /mig med pas ni mthong ba med/ /'di la bsal ④bya ci yang med/ /gzhag par bya ba cung zad med/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag lta / /yang dag mthong na rnam par grol/ /rnam dbye bcas pa'i mtshan nyid can / /glo bur dag gis khams stong gi⑤/ /rnam dbye med pa'i mtshan nyid 70/de951

can / /bla med chos kyis ①stong ma yin/ /sprin dang rmi lam sgyu bzhin de dang der / /shes bya thams cad rnam ②kun stong pa zhes/ /gsungs nas yang 'dir ba rgyal rnams sems can la/ /sangs rgyas snying po yod ces ci ste ④gsungs//sems zhum sems can dman la brnyas pa dang / /yang dag min 'dzin yang dag chos la skur/ / bdag cag ④lhag pa'i skyon lnga gang dag la/ /yod pa de dag de spang ༅don du gsungs/ /yang dag mtha' ni 'dus byas kyis / /rnam pa thams cad dben pa ste/ /nyon mongs las dang rnam smin don/ /sprin la sogs pa bzhin du brjod/ /nyon mongs sprin 'dra bya ba yin/ /las ni rmi lam longs spyod bzhin/ /nyon mongs las kyi rnam par don/ /phung po sgyu ma sprul pa bzhin//sngar ni de ltar rnam bzhag nas/ /slar yang bla ma'i rgyud 'dir ni/ /nyes pa lnga dag spang ba'i phyir/ /khams yod nyid ces bstan pa yin/ /'di ltar de ni ma thos par༅/ /bdag la brnyas pa'i nyes pa yis/ /sems ni zhum pa 'ga' zhig nasakhya/ /byang chub sems ni skye mi ⑫'gyur/ /gang la byang chub sems skyes pas/ /bdag ni mchog ces shes pa na/ /byang chub sems ma skyes pa la/ /dman pa'i 'du shes rab tu 'jug /de ltar sems pa de la ni/ /yang dag shes pa mi skye ba/ /des na yang dag min 'dzin cing 7/ /yang dag don ni rig /༅mi 'gyur/ /bcos ma glo bur ba nyid phyir/ /sems can skyon ⑫de yang dag min/ /yang dag nyes de bdag med pa/ /yon tan rang bzhin dag pa yin/ /yang dag min pa'i nyes 'dzin cing ⑫/ /yang dag yon tan skur 'debs pa༅/ /blo ldan bdag dang sems can la⑩/ /mtshungs mthong byams pa thob mi 'gyur/ /'di ltar ༅de ni thos ⑫pa las/ /spro ⑫dang ston pa bzhin 70—952

gus dang / /shes rab ye shes byams chen skye/ /chos lnga skye ①phyir de las ni/ /kha na ma tho med mtshungs lta/ /skyon med yon tan ldan pa dang / /bdag dang sems can mtshungs byams las⑤/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni myur du 'thob①/ /theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos dkon mchog gi rigs rnam par dbye ba las/de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i skabs te dang po'o// //dag thob bral ba rang bzhin don/ /de brten zab ④dang rgya che dang / /bdag nyid chen po de yang ni/ /ji srid ༅dus dang ji lta nyid/ /ngo bo rgyu dang 'bras bu dang / /las dang ldan la ④'jug pa dang / /de rtag bsam mi khyab nyid kyis/ /sangs rgyas sa ni mnyam par gzhag④ /rang bzhin 'od gsal zhes brjod gang yin nyi du dang mkha' bzhin glo bur gyi / /nyon mongs shes bya'i sprin tshogs stug po'i sgrib pa yis ni bsgribs gyur pa⑫/ /dri med sangs rgyas yon tan kun ldan rtag brtan g.yung drung sangs rgyas nyid/ /de ni chos la mi rtog rnam 'byed ye shes dag la brten nas 'thob nya/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni dbyer med pa/ /dag pa'i chos kyis rab phye ba/ /nyi ma ༅mkha' bzhin yiye shes dang / /spangs pa gnyis kyi mtshan nyid do/ /'od gsal byas min dbyer med par/ /'jug can gang gā'i nyusteklung gi ni/ /rdul las 'das phyir snye sangs rgyas kyi༅/ /chos rnams kun dang ldan pa nyid/ /rang bzhin gyis ni ma grub dang / /khyab dang glo bur ba nyid kyis/ /nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa der / /sprin dang 'dra bar brjod pa yin/ /sgrib pa gnyis dang bral ba yi/ /rgyu ni ye shes gnyis yin te/ /mi rtog ⑩pa dang de yi ni/ /rjes thob de ni ye 70—953

shes 'dod/ /dri med chu ldan rim rgyas pad+mas khebs pa'i mtsho bzhin dang / /sgra gcan kha nas thar ba'i zla ba nya ba lta bu dang / /sprin tshogs nyon mongs dag las grol ba'i nyi ma lta bur ni/ /dri med yon tan ldan phyir 'od zer snang ldan de nyid do/ /thub pa khyu mchog sbrang rtsi snying po dang / /rin chen gser dang gter dang ljon pa /༅bzhin/ /dri med rin chen bde gshegs sku dang ni/ /sa bdag gser gyi gzugs 'dra rgyal ba nyid/ /chu mtsho ②sogs bzhin 'dod chags sogs/ /glo bur nyon mongs dag pa ni/ /mdor na mi rtog ye shes kyi/ /'bras bu yin par rab tu brjod/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i①/ /sangs rgyas sku ni nges thob pa/ / de ni rjes las thob pa yi/ /④ye shes 'bras bu yin par ston༅/ /'dod chags rdul ni spang ④phyir dang / /gdul bya yi ni pad+ma la/ /bsam gtan chu ni 'bab phyir de④/ /chu dag rdzing dang mtshungs pa nyid༅—/ /zhe sdang sgra gcan las grol bas/ /snying rje byams chen 'od zer gyis/ /'gro ba khyab pa'i phyir na de/ /dri med zla ba nya ba bzhin/ /gti mug sprin las rnam grol batshe/ /'gro bar ye shes 'od zer gyis⑩/ /mun pa sel phyir sangs rgyas nyid/ /de ni dri med nyi ma bzhin/ /mi mnyam mnyam pa'i chos phyir dang //dam chos ro ni sbyin mdzad dang / /shun pa dang ni bral phyir de/ /bde gshegs sbrang rtsi snying po bzhin/ /dag ༅phyir yon tan rdzas kyis ⑩ni/ /dbul ba sel bar byed phyir dang / /rnam grol 'bras bu 'byin 7byed phyir/ /gser dang gter dang ljon pa 0bzhin/ /rin chen chos kyi sku phyir dang / /rkang gnyis bdag po'i mchog lhosnyephyir dang / /rin chen gzugs kyi rnam pa'i phyir/ /de ni rin chen rgyal gser bzhin/ /zag pa med khyab 'jig med chos can te/ /70—954

brtan zhi rtag ①pa 'pho med gnas yin no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mkha' bzhin dag ②pa yi/ /dbang po drug don nyams su pyong ba'i rgyu/ /'byung med gzugs don blta ①dang gtam bzang ni/ /gtsang ma mnyan ①dang bde gshegs tshul khrims kyi/ /dri gtsang snom dang 'phags chen dam chos ro/ /myang ⑤dang ting 'dzin reg bde nyams pyong dang / /rang gi ngo bo nyid kyi zab pa'i ④tshul/ /rtogs ④pa'i rgyur gyur zhib ⑤mor bsams pa ⑨na/ /don dam bde mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ /nam mkha' bzhin du rgyu mtshan rnams dang bral/ /mdor na ye shes gnyis po yi/ /las su 'di ni shes bya ste/ /grol ba'i sku ni rdzogs pa dang / /chos kyi sku ni sbyong ba 'o/ /rnam grol chos kyi sku dag ni/ /rnam gnyis rnam gcig shes bya ste/ /zag pa med phyir khyab pa'i phyir / /'dus ma byas phyir ⑫gnas nyid phyir/ /nyon mongs rnams ni bag chags dang / /bcas pa 'gags phyir zag med de/ /chags med thogs pa ⑪med pa'i phyir/ /ye shes khyab pa nyid du 'dod/ /gtan du 'jig pa med pa yi / /rang bzhin yin phyir 'dus ma byas/ /'jig med nyid ni bstan pa ste//brtan ⑫sogs rnams kyis de bshad do/ /'jig ④pa rnam bzhir shes bya ste/ /brtan ⑫sogs dag las bzlog phyir ro/ /myags dang rnam 'gyur chad pa dang / /bsam mi khyab 'gyur ⑫'pho ba ste/ /de med phyir na brtan zhi dang / /rtag dang 'pho med shes par bya/ /dri med shes de ⑫dkar po yi/ /chos kyi rten yin phyir na gnas/ /ji ltar rgyu min nam mkha' ni/ /gzugs mthong ba dang sgra dang dri/ /ro dang reg dang chos rnams ni/ /thos la sogs pa'i rgyu yin ltar / /de bzhin sku gnyis sgrib med pa'i/ /sbyor bas bstan ⑫pa'i dbang 70—955

don la/ /zag pa med pa'i yon tan dag /skye ba yi ni ①rgyu yin no/ /bsam med rtag brtan zhi ba ⑤g.yung drung nyid/ /rab tu zhi khyab rtog bral nam mkha' bzhin/ /chags med kun tu thogs med rtsub reg spangs/ /lta ⑤gzung med dge sangs rgyas dri ma med/ /rnam grol chos kyi sku dag gis/ /rang dang gzhan gyi ༅don bstan te/ /rang gzhan don brten de la ni/ /bsam mi khyab sogs yon tan ldan/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yul/ /sangs rgyas shes gsum yul min phyir/ /ye shes lus can rnams kyis ni/ /bsam mi khyab par rtogs par bya/ /phra phyir thos pa'i yul min te/ /don dam yin phyir bsam bya'i min/ /chos nyid zab phyir 'jig rten pa'i/ /bsgom ④pa la sogs yul ma yin/ /gang phyir gzugs la dmus long bzhin/ /byis pas de sngon mthong ma myong / /btsas pa'i khyim nas ④bu chung gis/ /nyi ma'i gzugs bzhin 'phags pas kyang / /skye dang bral phyir rtag pa ste/ /'gag ⑤med phyir na kyibartan pa yin/ /gnyis med phyir de zhi ba ste/ /g.yung drung chos nyid gnas phyir ro/ /rab zhi 'gog pa'i bden pa'i phyir/ /thams cad rtogs phyir khyab pa nyid/ /gnas pa med phyir rtog ༅med de/ /nyon mongs spangs phyir chags pa med/ /shes bya'i sgrib kun dag pa'i phyir/ /thams cad du ni thogs pa med/ /gnyis med las su rung ba'i phyir/ /rtsub pa'i reg dang bral ba yin/ /de gzugs med phyir bltar med de/ /mtshan ma med phyir gzung du med / /dge ba rang bzhin dag pa'i phyir/ /dri med dri ma spangs phyir ro/ /thog ma dbus mtha' med cing rnam dbyer med/ /gnyis med gsum bral dri med rnam rtog med/ /chos dbyings rang bzhin gang yin de rtogs pa/ /70—956

mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor pa yis mthong / /gzhal med gang gā'i ①bye ma las 'das pa/ /bsam med mnyam med yon tan rnams dang ldan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dri med dbyings de ni/ /bag chags bcas pa'i nyes pa rnam ②spangs pa'o/ /sna tshogs dam chos 'od zer mnga' ba'i skus/ /'gro ba'i rnam grol don grub la brtson pa/ /mdzad pa yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal bzhin te/ /sna tshogs dngos kyang ①de yi rang bzhin min/ /'jig rten zhi ba'i lam la 'jug pa dang / /rab tu smin dang lung ston ④rgyu yi gzugs/ /gang yin de yang 'dir ni rtag gnas te/ /nam mkha'i khams su gzugs kyi khams bzhin no/ /rang byung ⑤rnams kyi thams cad mkhyen/ /sangs rgyas nyid ces gang brjod pa/ /mchog tu mya ngan 'das bsam med/ /dgra bcom so so'i bdag gyur pa/ /de dbye zab dang rgya che dang / /bdag nyid chen po'i yon tan gyi/ /chos kyis ④rab phye rang bzhin la/ /sogs pa'i sku gsum dag gis 'jug /de la sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni/ /ngo bo nyid sku mtshan nyid lnga/ /mdor na yon tan lnga dang ni/ /ldan pa nyid du rig par bya/ /'dus ma byas shing rnam dbyer med/ /mtha' gnyis dag ni rnam par spangs/ /nyon mongs shes bya snyoms 'jug gi/ /sgrib gsum las ni nges grol te/ /dri med rnam par rtog med dang / /rnal 'byor rnams kyi yul yin phyir/ /chos dbyings ngo bo nyid kyis ni/ /dag pa'i phyir na 'od gsal ba/ /gzhal med grangs med bsam med pa/ /mnyam med dag pa'i mthar thug pa'i④/ /yon tan rnams dang yang dag par/ /ngo bo nyid kyi sku ldan te/ /rgya che'i phyir dang grangs med phyir / /rtog ge'i yul ni min phyir dang / /'ba' zhig bag chags bcas 70—957

spang ①phyir/ /gzhal med la sogs go rims bzhin/ /sna tshogs chos la rdzogs longs spyod/ /rang bzhin chos ni snang phyir dang / /thugs rje dag pa'i rgyu mthun pa/ /'gro don rgyun mi 'chad phyir dang / /rnam par rtog med lhun grub par/ /'dod pa ji bzhin yongs skong ①phyir/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /rdzogs par ④mongs spyod rnam par gnas/ /brjod ston mdzad rgyun mi 'chad dang / /mngon par 'du byed med pa dang / /de yi ngo bo 0min ston la༅ / /'dir ni sna tshogs rnam lngar ston④/ /ji ltar tshon ni sna tshogs kyis / /nor bu de dngos min snang ltar/ /de bzhin /de rkyen ⑧sna tshogs pas/ /khyab bdag de dngos min par snang / /thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten mdon/ /'jig rten kun la gzigs nas ni/ /chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par/ /sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis/ /skye ba mngon par skye ba dang / /dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang / /lhums su 'jug dang bltams pa dang / /bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang / /btsun mo'i 'khor dgyes rol pa dang / /nges 'byung dka' ba spyod pa dang / /byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang / /bdud sde 'joms dang rdzogs par ni/ /byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo dang / /mya ngan 'das par gshegs mdzad rnams/ /yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su/ /srid pa ji srid gnas par ston/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal bdag med dang / /zhi ba'i sgra yis thabs mdon pasargya/ /sems can srid gsum skyo bskyed nas/ /mya ngan 'das la rab 'jug mdzad/ /zhi ba'i lam la rab zhugs pa/ /mya ngan 'das thob 'du shes can/ /dam chos pad+ma dkar la sogs/ /chos kyi de nyid bstan pa yis/ /de dag sngar 'dzin las bzlog ste/ /thabs dang shes 70—958

rab yongs bzung bas/ /theg pa mchog la smin mdzad de/ /byang chub mchog tu lung bstan gto/ /zab dang mthu ni phun tshogs dang / /byis pa'i don mthun rab 'dren phyir/ /'di dag grangs bzhin zab pa dang / /rgya che ②bdag nyid che zhes ②bya/ /'dir ni dang po chos sku ste/ /phyi ma dag ni gzugs kyi sku/ /nam mkha' la ni gzugs gnas bzhin/ /dang po la ni tha ma gnas/ /rgyu ①mtha' yas dang sems can zad med dang / /brtse dang 'phrul dang ma/zhe dang phun tshogs ldan/ /chos kyi dbang phyug 'chi ba'i bdud bcom dang / /ngo bo med phyir 'jig rten mgon pos brtagakhya /lus dang srog dang longs spyod rnams/ /btang nas dam chos 'dzin phyir dang / /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /dang por dam bcas mthar phyin ④phyir/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni ④gtsang ba dang / /dag pa'i thugs rje rab 'jug phyir/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa ston par ⑤ni/ /de yis gnas par spyod pa'i phyir/ /mdon pas 'khor dang mya ngan 'das/ /gnyis su 'dzin las grol ba'i phyir/ /rtag tu bsam yas ting 'dzin gyi / /bde ba phun sum tshogs ldan phyir/ /'jig rten na ni spyod pa na/ /'jig rten chos kyis gos med phyir/ /'chi med zhi ba'i gnas thob la/ /'chi bdud rgyu ⑫ba med pa'i phyir/ /'dus ma byas pa'i rang bzhin gyi⑫/ /thub pa gdod nas rab zhi'i phyir/ /rtag pa skyabs med rnams kyi ⑫ni/ /skyabs la sogs par 'thad phyir ro/ /dang po yi ni rgyu bdun ⑩gyis/ /gzugs kyi sku yi ⑫rtag nyid de/ /phyi ma gsum gyis kyiston pa ni / /chos kyi sku yi ⑫rtag pa nyid/ /ngag yul min phyir don dam gyis bsdus phyir / /rtogs gnas min phyir dpe las 'das pa'i phyir/ /bla na med phyir 70—959

srid zhis ma bsdus phyir/ /rgyal yul 'phags rnams kyis kyang bsam mi khyab/ /bsam med brjod du med phyir te①/ /brjod med don dam yin phyir ro/ /don dam brtag ⑤bya min phyir te/ /brtag min rjes dpag bya min phyir/ /dpag min khyabla na med pa'i phyir/ /bla na med pa ma bsdus phyir/ /ma bsdus gnas pa med phyir te④/ /yon tan skyon rtog med phyir ro/ /rgyu lnga dag gis phra ba'i phyir/ /chos sku bsam mi khyab pa ste/ /drug pas de yi dngos min phyir//gzugs sku bsam mi khyab pa 'o/ /bla med ye shes thugs rje che sogs yon tan gyis༅ / /yon tan pha rol byon pa'i rgyal ba bsam mi khyab/ /des na rang byung rnams kyi tha ma'i tshul 'di ni/ /drang srong chen po dbang thob rnams kyis kyang rig min/ /theg pa chen po ⑥rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos dkon mchog gi rigs rnam par dbye ba las/ byang chub kyi skabs te gnyis pa'o// //rang don gzhan don don dam sku dang ni/ /de la brten pa ④kun rdzob sku nyid de/ /bral dang rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu ni/ /yon tan dbye ba drug cu bzhi 'di dag /bdag nyid kyi ni 'byor khyapa'i gnas/ /dam pa'i don kyi sku yin te/ /drang srong rnams kyi brda yi sku/ /pha rol phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas / /dang po'i sku ni stobs la sogs/ /bral ba'i yon tan rnams dang ldan / /gnyis pa skyes bu chen po'i mtshan/ /rnam smin yon tan dag dang ldan / /stobs nyid ma rig sgrib la rdo rje bzhin/ /mi 'jigs nyid ni 'khor du seng ge bzhin⑨/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ⑩ma 'dres mkha' bzhin te/ /thub pa'i bstan pa rnam gnyis chu zla bzhin/ /gnas dang gnas min las rnams kyi//70—960

rnam smin dang ni dbang po dang / /khams rnams dang ni mos pa dang / /kun 'gro'i lam dang bsam gtan sogs/ /nyon mongs dri ma med pa dang / /gnas ni rjes su dran pa dang / /lha yi mig dang zhi ba dag /mkhyen pa'i stobs ni rnam pa bcu/ /gnas dang gnas min rnam smin khams dang 'gro ba'i mos pa sna tshogs dang / /nyon mongs rnam byang dbang po'i tshogs dang sngon gnas rjes su dran pa dang / /lha yi mig dang zag pa zad tshul mi shes go cha rtsig brtan dang / /shing rnams 'bigs dang 'jig khyadang gcod phyir stobs gang yin pa rdo rje bzhin/ /chos sku ②rdzogs par byang chub dang / /gegs ni 'gog par byed ④pa dang / /lam ston pa dang 'gog ston la/ /mi 'jigs pa ni rnam pa bzhi/ /bdag gzhan shes bya'i dngos po rnam ༷kun shes dang shes mdzad phyir/ /spang dngos spangs ⑤dang spong mdzad phyir dang brten bya bsten ④pa'i phyir/ /thob bya bla med shin tu dri med thob dang thob mdzad phyir/ /rang gzhan don ldan ④gsung phyir drang srong gang du'ang thogs pa med/ /ri dwags dbang po ji ltar nags mthar rtag 'jig khyamed/ /ri dwags rnams la skrag pa med par rgyu ba ltar/ /de bzhin tshogs nang ④thub pa'i dbang po seng ge yang / /legs gnas ltos med brtan pa'i rtsal dang ldan par gnas/ /'khrul dang ca co mi mnga' ste/ /ston la dran pa nyams mi mnga'/ /mnyam par ma bzhag thugs mi /nga'/ /'du shes sna tshogs kyang mi mnga'/ /ma brtags btang snyoms mi mnga' ste/ /'dun dang tsobartson 'grus dran pa dang / /shes rab rnam grol rnam grol gyi⑪/ /ye shes gzigs pa nyams mi mnga'/ /las rnams cha ye shes sngon 'gro dang / /dus la ye shes sgrib kyipa med/ /de ltar bco brgyad nga0—961
