pa yil/ /dpe dgu dag gis yang dag bstan/ /gang gis na de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po nyon mongs pa'i sbubs bye ba mtha' yas pas g.yogs pa zhes brjod la/ rgyas par ni 'di dag nyid brgyad khri bzhi stong gi ②rnam pa'i rab tu dbye bas de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes bzhin du ⑤mtha' yas par 'gyur ro/ /dri 'di dag gis byis rnams dang / /dgra bcom slob dang blo ldan rnams/ /rim bzhin bzhi dang gcig dang ni/ /gnyis dang gnyis kyis ④ma dag nyid/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis sems can thams cad ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po can no zhes bka' sprul pa gang yin pa de la sems can thams cad ni mdor bsdu na rnam pa bzhi ④brjod de/ 'di lta ste/ so so'i skye bo dang / dgra bcom pa dang / slob pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'o/ /de la 'di dag zag pa med pa'i dbyings su go rims ji lta ba bzhin ①nyon mongs pa bzhi dang / gcig dang / gnyis dang / gnyis kyis ma dag pa bstan to//yang ④ji ltar 'dod chags la sogs pa nyon mongs pa dgu po 'di dag pad+ma'i spubs la sogs pa dang 'dra bar rig par byas ⑧la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i khams sangs rgyas kyi gzugs la sogs pa dang chos mthun par yang ji ltar rig par bya zhe na/ ji ltar pad+ma 'dam skyes de/ /mdun du gyur na yid dga' dang / /phyi nas dga' ba med 'gyur ba/ /'dod chags dga' ba de bzhin no//ji ltar srog chags sbrang ma ni/ /shin tu 'khrugs te mdung brdeg ⑨ltar/ /de bzhin zhe sdang skye bas ⑫na/ /snying la sdug bsngal skyed ⑫par byed/ /ji ltar 'bras sogs ⑫snying po ni/ /phyi rol sbun pas bsgribs pa ltar/ /de bzhin snying po'i don mthong ba/ /ma rig sgo nga'i spubs kyis 0bsgribs/ /ji ltar mi 70—1070

gtsang mi mthun pa/ /de bzhin chags dang bcas rnams kyil/ /'dod pa bsten pa'i rgyu yin phyir/ /kun nas ldang ba mi gtsang 'dra/ /ji ltar nor ni bsgribs pas na/ /mi shes gter mi thob pa ltar/ /de bzhin skye la rang byung nyid / /ma rig ②bag chags sa yis ①bsgribs/ /ji ltar myug sogs rim skyes pas/ /sa bon shun pa gcod pa ltar/ /de bzhin de nyid mthong ba yis/ /mthong spangs ④rnams ni ldog par 'gyur/ /'phags pa'i lam dang 'brel pa las / /'jig tshogs snying po bcom rnams kyi/ /bsgom ④lam ye shes spang bya rnams / /gos hrul dag dang mtshungs par bstan/ /sa bdun la brten dri ma ni/ /mngal spubs dri ma dag dang mtshungs/ /mngal spubs bral 'dra mi rtog pa'i/ /ye shes rnam par smin pa bzhin/ /sa gsum rjes 'brel dri ma rnams / /sa 'dam gos bzhin shes bya ste/ /bdag nyid chen po rdo rje lta'i④/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis gzhom bya yin/ /de ltar chags sogs dri ma dgu/ /pad+ma la sogs dag dang mtshungs/ /rang bzhin gsum gyis bsdus phyir khams/ /sangs rgyas tshogs ④dang chos mtshungs so/ /sems kyi rnam par byang ba'i khams de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po rang bzhin rnam pa ④gsum gyi dbang du byas te/sangs rgyas kyi ⑨gzugs la sogs pa rnam pa dgu dang chos mthun par rtogs par bya'o / /rang bzhin rnam pa gsum gang zhe na/ 'di yi rang bzhin chos sku dang / /de bzhin nyid dang rigs kyang ste/ /de ni dpe gsum gcig dang ni/ /lnga rnams kyis ni shes par bya/ /sangs rgyas kyi gzugs dang / sbrang rtsi dang /'bru'i snying po'i dpe gsum gyis ni khams de chos kyi sku'i rang bzhin du shes par bya'o / /gser gyi dpe gcig gis ni de bzhin nyid kyi rang bzhin lta bu'o/ /70—1071

gter dang shing dang rin po che'i ①sku dang 'khor los sgyur ba dang / gser gyi gzugs kyi ④dpe lngas ni sangs rgyas kyi ①sku gsum bskyed pa'i rigs kyi rang bzhin du'o/ /de la chos kyi sku gang zhe na/ chos sku rnam gnyis shes bya ste/ /chos dbyings shin tu dri med dang / /de yi rgyu mthun zab pa dang / /sna tshogs tshul ni ston pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi ④sku ni rnam pa gnyis su rtogs par bya'o / /shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings ni/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i spyod yul gyi yul lo/ /de yang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi so so rang gis rig rjopar bya ba'i chos kyi dbang du byas te rtogs par bya'o/ /de thob pa'i rgyu shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi rgyu mthun pa ni gdul bya ji lta bar sems can gzhan la rnam par rig par 'byung ngo / /de yang bstan pa'i chos kyi dbang du byas par rig par bya'o/ /bstan pa yang rnam pa gnyis te/phra ba dang rgya chen po'i chos rnam par 'jog pa'i tshul gyis dbye ba las te①/'di lta ste/ don dam pa'i bden pa'i dbang du byas nas byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod zab mo'i chos kyi tshul ston pa dang / kun rdzob kyi bden pa'i dbang du byas te/ mdo dang / dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa dang / lung bstan pa dang / tshigs su bcad pa dang / ched du brjod pa dang / gleng gzhi ⑦la sogs pa rnam pa du mar sna tshogs pa'i chos rnam par 'jog pa'i tshul bstan pa'o//'jig rten 'das phyir 'jig rten na/ /'di la dpe ni mi dmigs pas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid dang khams/ /'dra ba nyid du bstan pa yin/ /phra mo zab mo'i gatshul bstan ④ni/ /sbrang rtsi ⑫ro gcig pa bzhin te/ /rnam pa sna tshogs tshul bstan ni/ /sna tshogs spubs snying bzhin shes bya/ /de ltar sangs 70—1072

rgyas kyi gzugs dang sbrang rtsi dang snying po'i dpe 'di gsum gyis ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi skus ①lus pa med pa'i sems can gyi khams khyab pa'i don kyi dbang du byas nas/ sems can 'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po can yin ②no zhes bstan no/ /gang zhig de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku las phyi rol du gyur pa'i sems can de ni 'ga' yang sems can gyi khams na med de/nam mkha'i khams ni ①gzugs bzhin no/ /ji skad du/ ji ltar nam mkha' rtag tu kun song 'dod/ /de bzhin de yang rtag tu kun song 'dod/ /ji ltar nam mkha' gzugs rnams kun du song / /de bzhin 'di yang sems can tshogs kun song / /zhes gsungs so/ /rang bzhin 'gyur ba med pa dang / /dge dang rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ /de bzhin nyid 'di gser gyi ④ni/ /gzugs dang mtshungs par brjod pa yin/ /sems gang yin pa de ni nyon mongs pa dang sdug bsngal mtha' yas pa dang rjes su 'brel kyang rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba nyid kyis rnam par 'gyur ba la mi ston pa de'i phyir gser bzang po bzhin du gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i don kyis de bzhin nyid ces brjod do/ /de yang log pa nyid du nges pa'i rgyu can gyis sems can thams cad la yang rang bzhin khyad par med du zin kyang / glo bur gyi nyon mongs pa mtha' dag rnam par dag pa de ⑤las gyur pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro ste / des na 'dir gser gyi dpe gcig gis de bzhin nyid la dbyer med pa'i don gyi dbang du byas nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i de bzhin nyid sems can de dag gi ④snying po yin no zhes bstan pa yin no/ /sems kyi rang bzhin rnam par dag pa gnyis su med pa'i chos nyid nye bar bzung nas/ bcom ldan 'das 70—1073

kyis ji skad du bka' stsal pa ni/ 'jam dpal de la de bzhin gshegs pa ①ni bdag gi nye bar len pa'i gzhi rtsa yongs su mkhyen pas bsrung ba mdzad de/bdag rnam par dag pas sems can thams cad rnam par dag par rtogs so/ /bdag rnam par dag pa gang yin pa dang / sems can thams cad rnam par dag pa gang yin pa de ni gnyis su med de gnyis su byar med do zhes gsungs so/ /de skad du/② thams cad la ni khyad med kyang / /de bzhin nyid dag las gyur pa / /de bzhin gshegs nyid de yi phyir/ /'gro kun de yi snying po can/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gter dang 'bras bu'i shing bzhin du/ /rigs de rnam gnyis shes bya ste/ /thog med rang bzhin gnas pa dang / /yang dag blang ba ②mchog nyid do/ /rigs 'di gnyis las ④sangs rgyas kyi/ /sku gsum thob par 'dod pa yin/ /dang pos sku ni dang po ste/ /gnyis pa yis ni phyi ma gnyis / /ngo bo nyid sku mdzes pa ni/ /rin chen sku 'drar shes bya ste/ /rang bzhin gyis ni byas min dang / /yon tan rin chen gter yin phyir/ /chos chen rgyal srid che ldan phyir/ /rdzogs longs 'khor los sgyur bzhin no/ /gzugs brnyan gyi ni rang bzhin phyir/ /sprul pa gser gyi gzugs lta bu/ /de'i ༅phyir de ltar gter dang ljon ⑥shing dang / rin po che'i sku dang /'khor los sgyur ④ba dang / gser gyi gzugs te/ dpe lhag ma lnga po 'di dag gis ni sangs rgyas kyi sku rnam pa gsum bskyed pa'i rigs yod pa'i dbang du byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i khams sems can 'di dag thams cad kyi snying por bstan pa yin no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid ni sangs rgyas kyi sku rnam pa gsum gyis rab tu phye ba yin te/ des na de bzhin gshegs pa'i khams thob 70—1074

pa'i rgyu yin pas khams kyi don ni 'dir ①rgyu'i don to/ /gang gi phyir de la yang sems can dang sems can la de bzhin gshegs pa'i khams 'grub pa'i snying por gyur pa yod mod kyi/ sems can de dag gis shes pa ma yin no zhes gsungs so/ /de skad du/ thog ma med dus can gyi khams/ /chos rnams kun gyi gnas yin te/ /de yod pas na 'gro kun dang / /mya ngan 'das pa'ang thob pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la ji ltar na thog ma med pa'i dus gang khya yin zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po nyid kyi dbang du mdzad nas / sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs so zhes bstan cing ①rab tu gzhag pa gang yin pa'o/ /khams zhes bya ba ni/ ji skad du/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ④gang lags pa 'di ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi snying po rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag pa'i chos kyi snying po'o zhes gsungs so/ /chos rnams kun gyi gnas yin te/ /zhes bya ba ni/ ji skad du/ bcom ldan 'das de'i slad du de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ni 'brel pa/ rnam par dbye ba med pa/ bral mi shes pa/ 'dus ma byas pa'i chos rnams kyi gnas dang ⑤gzhi dang rten lags la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ni ma 'brel ⑥ba rnam par dbye ba dang bcas pa'i chos/ bral shes pa/ 'dus byas kyi chos rnams kyi yang gzhi dang / gnas dang / rten lags so zhes gsungs pa'o/ /de yod na ni 'gro kun dang / /zhes bya ba ni/ ji skad du/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po mchis na de la 'khor ba zhes tshig gis btags pa lags so zhes gsungs so/ /mya ngan 'das pa'ang thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba ni/ ji skad du/ bcom ldan 'das gal te de 70—1075

bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ma mchis na sdug bsngal la yang yid 'byung bar mi 'gyur zhing ①mya ngan las 'das pa la yang 'dod pa dang / don du gnyer ba dang / smon par yang mi 'gyur ro zhes rgyas par gsungs so/ /chos kyi sku ltar rgya che ba de bzhin gshegs pa dang dbyer med pa'i mtshan nyid nges pa'i rigs kyi rang bzhin de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po de yang thams cad kyi tshe thams cad la khyad par med pa'i tshul du yod do zhes bya ba'i bar ni/ chos nyid tshad mar byas nas blta bar bya ste/ ji skad du/ rigs kyi bu 'di ni chos rnams kyi chos nyid dekhya/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byung yang rung ma byung yang rung ste/ sems can 'di dag ni rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po can no zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid ni 'dir gang gis de lta bu kho nar 'gyur gyi gzhan du mi 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i rigs pa dang sbyor ba dang thabs yin te/ thams cad du sems nges par rtogs pa dang /sems yang dag par shes pa la ni/ chos nyid kyi rtogs ②pa dang / chos nyid kyi rigs ④pa yin no de ni bsam par mi bya/ rnam par brtag par mi bya'i⑤/lhag par 6mos par bya ba 'ba' zhig tu zad do/ /rang byung rnams kyi ④don dam de༅/ /dad pa nyid kyis rtogs bya yin/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba/ /mig med pas ni mthong ba med/ /mdor bsdu ⑨na/ gang zag bzhi po 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po mthong ba la mig dang mi ldan par rnam par gzhag pa yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ so so'i skye bo dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / theg pa la gsar du zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ste/ ji skad du/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin 70—1076

gshegs pa'i snying po 'di ni 'jig ①tshogs la lta bar lhung ba rnams dang /phyin ci log la mngon par 'dod pa ②rnams dang / stong pa nyid las ①sems rnam par g.yengs pa rnams kyi spyod yul ma lags so zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /de la 'jig tshogs la lta bar lhung ba ni byes pa so so'i skye bo la brjod de/ 'di ltar de dag ni gtan du phung po la sogs pa'i chos zag pa dang bcas pa rnams la bdag dang bdag gi ba nyid du khas blangs nas ngar 'dzin pa dang / nga yir 'dzin pa la mngon par zhen pas na 'jig ④tshogs 'gags pa zag pa med pa'i dbyings la lhag par mos par mi nus pa dag ste/ de dag gis thams cad mkhyen pa'i yul de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po rtogs par lta ga la 'gyur te 'di ni gnas med do/ /de la phyin ci log la mngon par dga' ba ni/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dag la brjod do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di lta ste/de dag kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po rtag pa nyid du bsgom par bya ba las/slar ⑤de rtag pa'i 'du shes su sgom ④pa las bzlog nas mi rtag par 'du shes su sgom ④pa la mngon par dga' ba nyid dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po bde bar bsgom ⑤par bya ba las/ slar de bde ba'i 'du shes su sgom ༅pa las bzlog nas/ sdug bsngal ba'i 'du shes yongs su sgom pa la ⑫mngon par dga' ba nyid dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po bdag tu bsgom par bya ba las/slar de la bdag gi 'du shes su sgom ⑪pa las bzlog nas/ bdag med pa'i 'du shes su sgom ⑫pa la dga' ba nyid dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po gtsang bar bsgom par bya ba las/ slar de la gtsang ba'i 'du shes su sgom ⑩pa las bzlog nas/ mi gtsang ba'i 'du shes sgom pa la ⑫mngon par dga' ba 70—1077

nyid kyi phyir rol/ /de ltar ②rnam grangs 'dis ni chos kyi sku thob pa dang 'gal ba'i lam la mngon par dga' ba'i phyir mchog tu rtag pa dang / bde ba dang /bdag dang / sdug pa'i mtshan nyid kyi khams de ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yang spyod yul ma yin no zhes bshad pa yin no/ /de ltar phyin ci log la mngon par dga' ba④/ mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / bdag med pa dang / mi sdug pa'i 'du shes can rnams kyi spyod yul ma yin pa de ltar rgyas par yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i mdor/bcom ldan 'das kyis rdzing gi chu'i nor bu'i dpe rab tu bsgrubs te/ 'di lta ste / dge slong dag dper na so ga'i dus la bab pa na/ skye bo dag khrus ras bcings te/ rang rang gi rgyan dang nye bar spyod pa dag gis chu la rtse'o/ /de nas der cig ④gis rigs dang ldan pa'i nor bu bai ḍūr+ya chu'i nang du gzhag pa dang / de nas bai ḍūr+ya de'i don du de dag thams cad rgyan gzhag nas zhugs ⑤par gyur to/ /de nas de na yod pa'i gseg ma'am gyo mo de dag la nor bu'o snyam nas bzung ste/ bdag gis nor bu rnyed do snyam ste ④phyung ngo / /phyung nas rdzing bu'i 'gram du bltas pa na 'di ni nor bu ma yin no snyam pa'i 'du shes rab tu 'jug go/ /rdzing gi chu de yang nor bu'i mthus nor bu'i 'od dang 'dra bar snang ngo / /de dag de ltar snang ba'i chu de yang e ma'o nor bu'o snyam du yon tan gyi ④'du shes rab tu zhugs so/ /de nas de la thabs mkhas shing yid gzhungs pa cig ⑤gis nor bu de de kho na bzhin du rnyed par gyur to/ /dge slong dag de bzhin du nor bu ltar chos kyi don de kho na mi shes pa khyed kyis thams cad mi rtag pa dang / thams cad sdug bsngal ba dang / thams cad bdag med pa dang /70—1078

thams cad mi sdug pa'o zhes 'dzin pa thams cad kyis sgom zhing / sgom ①pa lan mang du byas shing mang du byas pas ②nye bar gzhag pa de thams cad ni don med do/ /dge slong dag de'i phyir rdzing ①de dag gi gseg ma dang / gyo mo'i ④rnam par gnas pa ltar mi 'gyur bar khyed cag thabs la mkhas par gyis shig /dge slong dag khyed kyis gang dang gang thams cad mi rtag pa nyid dang / thams cad sdug bsngal ba dang / thams cad bdag med pa dang / thams cad mi gtsang ba'o zhes 'dzin pa thams cad kyis sgom zhing sgom ④pa mang du byas shing mang du byas pa de dang de nyid la rtag pa dang / bde ba dang / sdug bsngal dang /④ bdag nyid yod pa yin no zhes rgyas par chos kyi de kho na nyid dam par rnam par gzhag pa las brtsams te phyin ci log tu gyur pa bstan pa ni mdo ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs par bya'o/ /de la stong pa nyid las sems rnam par g.yengs pa ni theg pa la gsar du zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' stong pa nyid kyi tshul du de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po las nyams pa dag la brjod do/ /gang dag yod pa'i chos nyid dus phyis rgyun 'chad cing zhig pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'o zhes dngos po gzhig pa'i phyir stong pa nyid kyi rnam par thar pa'i sgo 'dod pa'am/ yang gang dag gang zhig rtogs ④par bya ba dang / bsgom ༅par bya ba stong pa nyid ces bya ba gzugs la sogs pa las tha dad pa'i dngos po yod pa yin no zhes stong pa nyid la dmigs pas stong pa nyid la brten pa'o/ /de la stong pa nyid kyi khyatshul du brjod pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po gang zhe na/'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ /gzhag ⑫par bya ba cung zad med/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag lta/ /yang dag mthong nas ⑫rnam par grol/ /rnam dbyer 70—1079

bcas pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /glo bur dag gis khams stong gi①/ /rnam dbyer med pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /bla med chos kyis stong ma yin/ /'dis ci bstan zhe na/ gang gi phyir rang bzhin gyis ②yongs su dag pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i khams 'di las bsal bar bya ba kun nas nyon mongs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni 'ga' yang med la/ glo bur ba'i dri ma dang bral ba ni 'di'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'di la rnam par byang ba'i rgyu mtshan can gzhag par bya ba yang cung zad kyang yod pa ma yin te/ rnam par dbye ba med pa'i chos dag pa'i chos nyid ni rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ni/ rnam par dbye ba yod pa/ bral shes pa/ nyon mongs pa'i spubs thams cad kyis ni stong pa yin la/ rnam par dbye ba med pa/ bral mi shes pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos gang gā'i klung gi bye ma las 'das pa ni mi stong ngo zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar na gang zhig gang na med pa de ni des stong ngo zhes yang dag par rjes su mthong la/ gang zhig lhag par gyur pa de ni de la rtag par yod do zhes yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du shes so/ /tshigs su bcad pa 'di gnyis kyis ni sgro 'dogs pa dang skur pa 'debs pa'i mtha' dang bral ba'i phyir/ phyin ci ma log pa stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid bstan to/ /de la gang zhig stong pa nyid kyi tshul 'di las sems khya phyi rol tu rnam par g.yeng zhing rnam par 'phro ④la mnyam par mi 'jog cing rtse gcig tu mi 'gyur ba des na de dag stong pa nyid las sems rnam par g.yengs pa zhes brjod do/ /de la don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi ye shes med par ni rnam par rtog pa med pa'i dag pa'i ⑤dbyings rtogs shing mngon par 'du bya bar mi nus so/ /'di la dgongs nas 70—1080

gsungs pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i ye shes nyid ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi stong pa nyid kyi ye shes yin la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po de ①yang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis ②sngar ma mthong ma rtogs pa'o zhes rgyas par gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ②ji ltar chos kyi sku'i snying po ④yin pa de ltar ni/ 'jig tshogs la lta bar lhung ba rnams kyi spyod yul ma yin par brjod do/ /chos kyi dbyings ni lta ba'i gnyen po yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ji ltar chos kyi sku 'jig rten las 'das pa'i snying po yin pa de ltar ni phyin ci log la mngon par dga' ba rnams kyi spyod yul ma yin no zhes brjod do/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi sku ni mi rtag pa la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i chos kyi gnyen por bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /ji ltar chos kyi sku yongs su dag pa'i chos kyi snying po yin pa de ltar ni stong pa nyid las ④sems rnam par g.yengs pa rnams kyi ④spyod yul ma yin no zhes brjod do/ /de rnam par dag pa'i yon tan gyis 'chos rnam par dbye ba med pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi skus rab tu phye ba rnams ni glo bur gyi ⑤dri mas stong pa'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir ro / /de la tshul gcig po chos kyi dbyings dang tha mi dad pa'i ye shes kyi sgo rtogs nas/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi sku'i ⑨rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag pa la lta ba gang yin pa 'di ni 'dir gang gis sa bcu la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpas de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po cung zad mthong ngo zhes gsungs pas yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin gyi ༅ye shes kyis kun mthong bar 'dod do/ /de skad du/ sprin mthong ༅mkha' la nyi bzhin 'dir khyod phyogs gcig blo gros can//blo mig dag pa'i 'phags rnams kyis kyang thams cad mthong ma lags/ /bcom 70—1081

ldan 'das khyod chos sku gang dag blo gros mtha' yas pa/ /shes bya mtha' med mkha' dbyings khyab pa de dag gis kun mthong / /zhes gsungs so/ /smras pa/ gal te de ltar chags pa med pa'i mthar phyin pa'i sa la gnas pa'i ༅'phags pa'i mchog rnams kyi yang thams cad ②yul ma yin na/ khams 'di lta bar dka' ba des na byis pa so so'i skye bo las brtsams ②te/ bstan pa 'dis ni ci zhig bya zhe na/ bstan pa'i dgos ①pa sdud pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gnyis te/ gcig gis ni dris la/ gnyis pas ༷ni lan bstan pa'o/ / sprin dang ⑥rmi lam sgyu ④bzhin de dang der/ /shes bya thams cad rnam kun stong pa zhes/ /gsungs nas yang 'dir rgyal rnams sems can la/ /sangs rgyas snying po yod ces ci ste gsungs/ /sems zhum sems can dman la brnyas pa dang / /yang dag mi 'dzin yang dag chos la skur/ /bdag cag ④lhag nga/'i skyon lnga gang dag la/ /yod pa de dag de spong don du gsungs/ /tshigs su bcad pa gnyis po ⑨'di'i don ni mdor bsdus te tshigs su bcad pa bcus rig par bya ste/ yang dag mtha' ni 'dus byas kyis⑫/ /rnam pa thams cad dben pa ste/ /nyon mongs las dang rnam smin don/ /sprin la sogs pa bzhin du brjod/ /nyon mongs sprin 'dra bya ba yi⑫/ /las ni rmi lam longs spyod bzhin / /nyon mongs las kyi rnam par smin/ /phung po sgyu ma sprul pa bzhin/ /sngar ni de ltar rnam gzhag nas/ /slar ⑫yang bla ma'i rgyud 'dir ni/ /nyes pa lnga dag spang ba'i khyaphyir/ /khams yod nyid ces bstan pa yin/ /'di ltar de ni ma thos pas/ /bdag la brnyas pa'i nyes pa yis/ /sems ni zhum pa 'ga' zhig la/ /byang chub sems ni skye mi 'gyur/ /gang la byang chub sems 70—1082

bskyed pas/ /bdag ni mchog ces zos pa na/ /byang chub sems ma skyes pa la//dman pa'i 'du shes rab tu 'jug /de ltar sems pa de la ni/ /yang dag shes pa mi skye ba/ /des na yang dag mi 'dzin zhing / /yang dag don ni rig mi 'gyur / /bcos ma glo bur pa nyid phyir/ /sems can skyon de yang dag min//yang dag nyes de bdag ①med pa/ /yon tan rang bzhin dag pa yin/ /yang dag min pa'i nyes 'dzin zhing / /yang dag yon tan skur 'debs pa/ /blo ldan bdag dang sems can ni/ /mtshungs mthong byams pa thob mi 'gyur/ /'di ltar de ni thos pa las/ /spro dang ston pa bzhin gus dang / /shes rab ye shes byams chen skyes/ /chos lnga skye ①phyir de la ni/ /kha na ma tho med mtshungs ltar④ / /skyon med yon tan ldan pa dang / /bdag dang sems can mtshungs byas te/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni myur du 'thob④/ /theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos dkon mchog gi rigs rnam par dbye ba las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i skabs te tshigs su bcad pa dang po'i don gyis ④bsdus pa'i bshad pa rdzogs so / /'dri ma dang bcas pa'i de bzhin nyid bshad zin to// //da ni dri ma med pa'i de bzhin nyid brjod par bya'o/ /de la dri ma med pa'i de bzhin nyid gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi zag pa med pa'i dbyings la dri ma'i rnam pa thams cad dang bral ba'i phyir gnas yongs su gyur pa'i rnam par gzhag pa gang yin pa'o/ /de yang mdor bsdu ④na don rnam pa brgyad kyi dbang du byas te rig par bya'o/ /don brgyad gang zhe na/dag thob bral ba rang gzhan ༅don/ /de brten zab dang rgya che dang / /bdag 70—1083

nyid chen po de yang ni/ /ji srid dus dang ji lta nyid/ /tshigs su bcad pa 'dis /༅ni go rims ji lta ba bzhin du don brgyad po 'di dag bstan te/ 'di lta ste/ ngo bo'i don dang / rgyu'i don dang / 'bras bu'i don dang / las kyi ༅don dang / ldan pa'i don dang / 'jug pa'i don dang / rtag pa'i don dang / bsam kyis mi khyab pa'i don no/ /de la khams gang zhig nyon mongs pa'i spubs las ma gol ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po zhes brjod pa de rnam par dag pa ni gnas yongs su gyur pa'i ngo bo nyid du rig par bya ste/gang gi phyir bcom ldan 'das gang zhig nyon mongs pa'i sbubs bye ba snyed mtha' ⑤dag gis g.yogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po la dogs pa ma mchis pa de dag ni nyon mongs pa mtha' dag gi ④spubs las grol ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi khyasku la yang dogs pa ma mchis pa lags so zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /ye shes ni rnam pa gnyis te/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rnam par rtog ①pa med pa dang / de'i khrurjes las thob pa'i 'jig rten pa'o/ / 'jig rten pa dang ⑧'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes gnas yongs su gyur pa'i rgyu ni thob pa'i sgras bstan te/ 'dis thob pas na thob pa'o/ /de'i 'bras bu ni rnam pa gnyis te/nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang bral ba dang / shes bya'i sgrib pa dang bral ba'i bral ba rnam pa byeganyis so/ /go rims bzhin du rang dang gzhan gyi don sgrub pa ni las so/ /de'i rten dang ldan pa ni ldan pa'o/ /zab pa dang rgya che ba dang ⑫bdag nyid chen pos rab tu phye ba sangs rgyas kyi sku gsum po dag gis 'gro ba ji srid par bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam pas 'jug pa ni 'jug pa'o/ /sdom ni/ ngo bo rgyu dang 'bras bu dang / /las dang ldan dang 'jug pa 70—1084

dang / /de rtag bsam gyis mi khyab kyis/ /sangs rgyas sa ni rnam par gnas//de la sangs rgyas nyid dang de thob pa'i thabs su gyur pa ngo bo'i don dang rgyu'i don las brtsams te tshigs su bcad pa/ rang bzhin 'od gsal zhes brjod ①gang yin nyi ma ②mkha' bzhin glo bur gyi/ /nyon mongs shes bya'i sprin tshogs stug po'i sgrib pa yis ni bsgribs gyur pa/ /dri med sangs rgyas yon tan kun ldan rtag brtan g.yung drung sangs rgyas nyid/ /de ni chos la mi rtog rnam 'byed ye shes dag la brten nas 'thob/ /tshigs su bcad pa 'di'i don ni mdor bsdu ②na tshigs su bcad pa bzhis rig par bya ste/ sangs rgyas nyid ni dbyer med pa/ /dag pa'i chos kyis rab dbye ①ba/ /nyi ⑤mkha' bzhin du ye shes dang / /spangs pa gnyis kyi ④mtshan nyid do④/ /'od gsal byas min dbyer med par/ /gzugs ⑧can gang gā'i klung gi ni/ /rdul las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyi⑨/ /chos rnams kun dang ldan pa nyid/ /rang bzhin gyis ni ma grub dang / /khyab dang glo ⑩bur ba nyid kyis/ /nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa de/ /sprin dang 'dra bar brjod pa yin/ /sgrib pa gnyis dang bral ba yi7/ /rgyu ni ye shes gnyis yin te/ /mi rtog pa dang de yi ⑫ni/ /rjes thob de ni ye shes 'dod/ /rnam par dag pa ni gnas yongs su gyur pa'i ngo bo nyid yin no/ /zhes brjod pa gang yin pa de la rnam par dag pa ni mdor bsdu na rnam pa gnyis te/ rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa dang / dri ma med pa'i rnam par dag pa'o/ /de la rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa ni/ gang zhig rnam par grol ba dang bral ba ni ma yin pa ste/ sems kyi tshurang bzhin 'od gsal ba glo bur gyi ⑫dri ma dang ma bral ba'i phyir ro/ /dri ma med pa'i rnam par dag pa ni/ rdul la sogs pa la chu la 70—1085

sogs pa bzhin du rnam par grol ba dang bral ba ste/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba la glo bur gyi dri ma mtha' dag dang bral ba'i phyir ro/ /de la dri ma med pa'i rnam par dag pa'i 'bras bu'i don las brtsams ①te tshigs su bcad pa/ dri med chu ldan rim rgyas pad+mas ⑤khebs pa'i mtsho bzhin dang / /sgra gcan kha nas thar ba'i zla ba nya ba lta bu dang / /sprin tshogs nyon mongs dag las grol ba'i nyi ma lta bur ni/ /dri med yon tan ldan phyir 'od zer snang ldan de nyid do/ /thub pa'i khyu mchog sbrang rtsi snying po dang / /rin chen gser dang gter dang ljon pa bzhin/ /dri med rin chen ༅bde gshegs sku dang ni/ /sa bdag gser gyi gzugs 'dra rgyal ba nyid/ /tshigs su bcad pa gnyis po 'di'i don ni mdor bsdu na/ tshigs su bcad pa brgyad kyis rig par bya ste/ /chu mtsho sogs bzhin 'dod chags sogs/ /glo bur nyon mongs dag pa ni/ /mdor na mi rtog ye shes kyi / /'bras bu yin par rab tu brjod/ /rnam pa ༅kun gyi mchog ldan pa'ikhya/ /sangs rgyas sku ni nges thob pa/ /de ni rjes las ④thob pa yi/ /ye shes tshu'abras bu yin par bstan/ /'dod chags rdul ni spang phyir dang / /gdul ༅bar bya ba'i pad+ma la/ /bsam gtan chu ni 'bab phyir de//chu dang rdzing dang mtshungs pa yin/ /zhe sdang sgra gcan las grol bas/ /snying rje byams chen 'od zer gyis/ /'gro ba khyab pa'i phyir na de/ /dri med zla ba nya ba bzhin / /gti mug sprin las rnam grol bas/ /'gro ba ye shes 'od zer gyis/ /mun pa sel phyir sangs rgyas nyid/ /de ni dri med nyi ma bzhin/ /mi mnyam mnyam pa'i chos nyid phyir/ /dam chos ro ni sbyin mdzad dang / /shun pa dang ni bral phyir te༅/ /bde gshegs sbrang rtsi'i snying po bzhin/ /dag phyir yon tan rdzas 70—1086

kyis ni/ /dbul ba ①sel bar byed phyir dang / /rnam grol 'bras bu smin byed phyir//gser dang gter dang ljon pa bzhin/ /rin chen chos kyi sku phyir dang / /rkang gnyis bdag po mchog phyir dang / /rin chen gzugs kyi rnam pa'i phyir/ /de ni rin chen rgyal gser bzhin/ /gnas yongs su gyur pa 'jig rten las 'das pa rnam par mi rtog pa dang /de'i rjes la thob pa ye shes kyi rgyu can bral ba'i 'bras bu'i ming can gnas yongs su gyur pa'i rgyu yin la/ de'i las ni rang dang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa gang ②yin par brjod do/ /de la rang dang gzhan gyi ༅don phun sum tshogs pa gang zhe na/ gang zhig bag chags dang bcas pa'i nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib ①pa las thar ba'i phyir dang / sgrib ⑤pa med pa'i chos kyi sku thob pa 'di ni rang gi don phun sum tshogs par brjod la/ gang zhig de'i steng du 'jig rten ji srid par lhun gyis grub pa sku gnyis kyis kun du ston pa dang / bstan pa la dbang 'byor pa gnyis kyis 'jug pa 'di ni gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs ⑥pa de la las kyi don las brtsams ⑦te tshigs su bcad pa gsum ste/ zag pa med khyab 'jig med ⑤chos can te/ /brtan zhi rtag pa 'pho ba med pa'i gnas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mkha' bzhin dag pa yi/ /dbang po drug don nyams su myong ba'i ⑨rgyu/ /dbang 'byor gzugs don lta dang gtam bzang ni/ /gtsang ma nyan dang bde gshegs tshul khrims kyi/ /dri gtsang snom dang 'phags chen dam chos ro/ /myang dang ting 'dzin reg bde nyams pyong dang / /rang gi ngo bo nyid kyis ⑫zab pa'i tshul/ /rtogs pa'i rgyur gyur zhib mor bsams pa na⑨/ /don dam bde mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ /nam mkha' bzhin du rgyu mtshan 70—1087

rnams dang bral/ /tshigs su bcad pa gsum po 'di'i don ni mdor bsdu na/tshigs su bcad pa brgyad kyis rig par bya ste/ mdor na ye shes gnyis po yi/ /las su 'di ni shes bya ste/ /'gro ①ba'i sku ni rdzogs pa dang / /chos kyi sku ni sbyong ba 'o/ /rnam grol chos kyi sku dag ni/ /rnam gnyis rnam gcig shes bya ste//zag pa med phyir khyab pa'i phyir/ /'dus ma byas pa'i gnas nyid ②phyir/ /nyon mongs rnams ni bag chags dang / /bcas pa 'gags ④phyir zag med de/ /chags med thogs pa med pa'i phyir/ /ye shes khyab pa nyid du 'dod/ /gtan du 'jig pa med pa yi/ /rang bzhin yin phyir 'dus ma byas/ /'jig med chos ④ni brtan pa ste/ /bstan sogs rnams kyis 'di bshad do/ /'jig pa rnam bzhir shes bya ste/ /bstan ④sogs dag las ④bzlog phyir ro/ /myags dang rnam 'gyur chad ④pa dang / /bsam mi khyab par ⑤'pho ba ste/ /de med phyir ni brtan 1zhi dang / /rtag dang 'pho med shes par bya/ /dri med shes de dkar ⑫po yi/ /chos kyi rten 7yin phyir na gnas/ /ji ltar rgyu 7min nam mkha' ni/ /gzugs mthong ba dang ⑩sgra dang dri/ /ro dang reg dang chos rnams ni/ /thos la sogs pa'i rgyu yin ltar/ /de bzhin sku gnyis sgrib med pa'i/ /sbyor bas bstan pa'i dbang don la/ /zag med pa yi khyayon tan dag /skye ba yi ⑫ni rgyu yin no/ /ji skad du/ sangs rgyas nam mkha'i mtshan nyid do/ /zhes bya ba ⑫bshad pa de ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi ma 'dres pa'i don dam pa'i mtshan nyid la dgongs nas gsungs pa yin te/ gang gi phyir gal te skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis ༅de bzhin gshegs pa lta bar gyur na ni/ des na 'khor los sgyur tshuba'i rgyal po yang de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so/ /70—1088

de la don dam pa'i mtshan nyid kyi ldan pa'i don las brtsams ①te tshigs su bcad pa/ bsam med rtag brtan zhi ba g.yung drung nyid/ /rab tu zhi khyab rtog bral nam mkha' bzhin/ /chags med kun tu thogs med rtsub ②reg spangs/ /blta gzung med dge sangs rgyas dri ma med/ /tshigs su bcad pa 'di'i don ni mdor bsdu na tshigs su bcad pa brgyad kyis rig par bya ste/ rnam grol chos kyi sku dag gis/ /rang dang gzhan gyi ①don bstan te/ /rang gzhan don rten de la ④ni/ /bsam mi khyab sogs yon tan ldan/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ⑤ye shes yul/ /sangs rgyas shes gsum yul min phyir/ /ye shes lus can rnams kyis ni/ /bsam mi khyab par rtogs par bya/ /phra phyir thos pa'i yul min te/ /don dam yin phyir bsam bya'i ⑥min/ /chos nyid zab phyir ⑦'jig rten pa'i/ /sgom pa la sogs yul ma yin/ /gang phyir gzugs la dmus long bzhin/ /byis pas de sngon mthong ma pyong / /btsas pa'i khyim nas bu chung gis⑧/ /nyi ma'i gzugs bzhin 'phags pas kyang / /skye dang bral zhing rtag pa ste/ /'gag pa med phyir brtan pa yin/ /gnyis med phyir na ⑨zhi ba ste/ /g.yung drung chos nyid gnas phyir ro/ /rab zhi 'gog pa'i bden pa'i phyir/ /thams cad rtogs phyir khyab pa nyid/ /gnas pa med phyir rtog med de/ /nyon mongs spangs phyir chags pa med/ /shes bya'i sgrib kun dag bya'i phyir/ /thams cad du ni thogs pa med/ /gnyis med las su rung ba'i phyir/ /rtsub ⑫pa'i reg dang bral ba'i phyir⑫/ /de gzugs med cing bltar med de/ /mtshan ma med phyir gzung du med/ /dge ba'i rang bzhin dag pa'i phyir/ /dri med dri ma spangs phyir ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid 'di snyenam mkha' ltar 'dus ma 70—1089

byas pa'i yon tan dang / rnam par dbye ba med par 'jug pa yang srid pa ji srid kyi bar du bsam gyis mi khyab pa thabs chen po dang / snying rje dang /shes rab kyis ①yongs su sbyong ba'i khyad par gyis 'gro ba la phan pa dang bde ba sgrub pa'i rgyu'i ⑤ngo bo nyid dang / rdzogs par longs spyod pa dang / sprul pa ste/dri ma med pa ①gsum gyis bar chad med cing rgyun mi 'chad par lhun gyis grub pas 'jug par blta ④bar bya ste ma 'dres pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /de la 'jug pa'i don las brtsams rjonas/ sangs rgyas kyi sku rnam par dbye ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di bzhi ste/ /thog ma dbus mtha' med cing rnam dbyer ④med/ /gnyis med gsum bral dri med rnam rtog med/ /chos dbyings rang bzhin gang yin de rtogs pa/ /mnyam par gzhag pa'i rnal 'byor pa yis mthong / /gzhal med gang gā'i bye ma las 'das pa/ /bsam med mnyam med yon tan rnams dang ldan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dri med dbyings de ni/ /bag chags bcas pa'i nyes pa rnam spangs pa/ /sna tshogs dam chos 'od zer mnga' ba'i skus/ /'gro ba'i rnam grol don grub la brtson pa/ /mdzad pa yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal bzhin te/ /sna tshogs dngos dang de yi rang bzhin min/ /'jig rten zhi ba'i lam la 'jug pa dang / /rab tu smin dang lung ston rgyu yi gzugs / /gang yin de yang 'dir ④ni rtag gnas te/ /nam mkha'i khams su gzugs kyi khams bzhin no/ /tshigs su bcad pa bzhi po 'di'i don ni/tshigs su bcad pa nyi shus rig ⑤par bya ste/ rang 'byung ⑨rnams kyi thams cad mkhyen/ /sangs rgyas nyid ces ⑩gang brjod pa/ /mchog tu mya ngan 'das bsam med/ /dgra bcom so so'i bdag gyur paskye/ /de dbye zab dang rgya che 70—1090

dang / /bdag nyid chen po'i yon tan gyi/ /chos kyis charab phye rang bzhin la//sogs pa'i sku gsum dag gis 'jug /de la sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni/ /ngo bo nyid sku mtshan nyid lnga/ /mdor na yon tan lnga dang ni/ /ldan pa nyid du rig par bya/ /'dus ma byas shing rnam dbyer med/ /mtha' gnyis dag ni rnam par spang ⑤/ /nyon mongs shes bya'i snyoms 'jug gis①/ /sgrib gsum las ni nges grol te/ /dri med rnam par rtog med ①dang / /rnal 'byor rnams kyi yul yin phyir/ /chos dbyings ngo bo nyid kyis ni/ /dag pa'i phyir ni 'od gsal ba//gzhal med grangs med bsam med pa/ /mnyam med dag pa'i mthar ⑤thug pa/ /yon tan rnams dang yang dag par/ /ngo bo nyid kyi sku ldan te/ /rgya che'i phyir dang grangs med phyir/ /rtog ge'i yul ni min phyir dang / /'ba' zhig bag chags bcas spangs phyir/ /gzhal med la sogs go rims bzhin/ /sna tshogs chos la rdzogs longs spyod/ /rang bzhin chos ni snang phyir dang / /thugs rje dag pa'i rgyu mthun pa/ /'gro don rgyun mi 'chad phyir dang / /rnam par rtog med lhun grub par/ /'dod pa ji bzhin yongs skong ⑦phyir/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /rdzogs par longs spyod rnam par gnas/ /brjod ston mdzad rgyun mi 'chad dang / /mngon par 'du byed med pa dang / /de yi ngo bo mi ston la/ /'dir ni sna tshogs rnam lngar ④brjod/ /ji ltar tshon ⑤ni sna tshogs kyis/ /nor bu de dngos mi snang ltar/ /de bzhin 'gro rkyen sna tshogs pas/ /khyab bdag de dngos min par ⑨snang / /thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten mkhyen/ /'jig rten kun la gzigs nas ni/ /chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par/ /sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis/ /skye ba mngon par skye ba 70—1091

dang / /dga' ldan nas ni 'pho ba dang / /lhums su 'jug dang bltams pa dang / /bzo ①yi gnas la ②mkhas pa dang / /btsun ④mo'i 'khor gyis ①dgyes rol ④dang / /nges 'byung dka' ba spyod pa dang / /byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang / /bdud sde 'joms dang rdzogs par ni/ /byang chub chos kyi ⑥'khor lo dang / /mya ngan 'das par gshegs mdzad rnams/ /yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su/ /srid pa ji srid gnas par ston/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal bdag med dang / /zhi ba'i sgra yis thabs mdon pas④/ /sems can srid gsum skyo bskyed nas/ /mya ngan 'das la rab 'jug mdzad/ /zhi ba'i shes la rab zhugs pa / /mya ngan 'das thob 'du shes can/ /dam chos pad+ma dkar la sogs/ /chos kyi de nyid bstan pa yis/ /de dag ngar 'dzin las bzlog ste/ /thabs dang shes rab yongs bzung bas/ /theg pa mchog la smin mdzad de/ /byang chub mchog tu lung ston to/ /zab dang mthu ni sna tshogs dang / /byis pa don mthun rab 'dren phyir / /'di dag grangs bzhin zab pa dang / /rgya che'i bdag nyid cher shes bya/ /'di ni dang po'i chos sku ste/ /phyi ma dag ni gzugs kyi sku/ /nam mkha' la ni gzugs gnas bzhin/ /dang po la ni tha ma gnas/ /sku gsum po ni 'di dag nyid kyis 'gro ba la phan pa dang bde ba sgrub pa 'jug pa rtag /༅pa'i don las brtsams ⑨nas tshigs su bcad pa/ rgyu mtha' yas dang sems can mi zad ༅dang / /brtse dang 'phrul dang ma/de dang phun tshogs ldan/ /chos kyi dbang phyug 'chi ba'i bdud bcom dang / /ngo bo med phyir 'jig rten mgon po rtag /'di'i bsdus pa'i don tshigs su bcad pa drug gis rig par bya ste/ /lus dang srog dang longs spyod rnams/ /btang nas 70—1092

dam chos 'dzin phyir dang / /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /dang po'i dam bcas mthar 'byin phyir/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni ①gtsang ba dang / /dag pa'i thugs rje ②rab 'jug phyir/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa ston pa ni/ /de yis gnas par spyod pa'i phyir/ /mkhyen pas 'khor dang mya ngan 'da'/ /gnyis su 'dzin pas grol ba'i phyir/ /rtag tu bsam yas ting 'dzin gyi/ /bde ba phun sum tshogs ldan phyir/ /'jig rten na ni spyod pa na①/ /'jig rten chos kyis gos med phyir/ /'chi med zhi ba'i gnas thob pa/ /'chi bdud rgyu ba med pa'i phyir/ /'dus ma byas pa'i rang bzhin gyi/ /thub pa gdod nas rab zhi'i phyir/ /rtag pa skyabs med rnams kyi ni/ /skyabs la sogs pa 'thad phyir ro / /dang po yi ni rgyu bdun ni④/ /gzugs kyi sku yi brtag nyid de/ /phyi ma gsum gyis stong pa na/ /chos kyi sku yi ④rtag pa nyid/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi gnas yongs su gyur pas rab tu phye ba thob pa'i tshul de yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul gyis rtogs par bya ba yin pas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i don las brtsams te tshigs su bcad pa/ ngag yul min phyir don dam gyis bsdus phyir/ /rtogs gnas min phyir dpe las 'das pa'i phyir/ /bla na med phyir srid zhis ma bsdus phyir/ /rgyal yul 'phags rnams kyis kyang bsam mi khyab/ /'di'i bsdus pa'i don ni tshigs su bcad pa bzhis rig par bya ste/ bsam med brjod du med phyir te/ /brjod med don dam yin phyir ro/ /don dam brtag bya min phyir te/ /brtag min rjes dpag bya min phyir/ /dpag min bla na med pa'i phyir/ /bla na med pa ma bsdus phyir//ma bsdus gnas pa med phyir te/ /yon tan skyon rtogs gamed phyir ro/ /rgyu lnga 70—1093

dag gis phra ba'i phyir/ /chos sku bsam mi khyab pa ste/ /drug pas de yi ①dngos min phyir/ /gzugs sku bsam gyis ⑤mi khyab pa'o/ /bla med ye shes thugs rje che ④sogs yon tan gyis/ /yon tan pha rol byon pa'i rgyal ba bsam mi khyab / /des na rang byung rnams kyi ④tha ma'i tshul 'di ni/ /drang srong chen po dbang thob rnams kyis kyang rig min/ /theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos dkon mchog gi rigs rnam par dbye ba las/ byang chub kyi skabs zhes bya ba ste le'u gnyis pa'o / /⑤dri ma med pa'i de bzhin nyid bshad zin to // // ①da ni gang dag de la brten pa nor bu'i 'od dang mdog dang dbyibs bzhin du dbyer med pa'i rang bzhin nyid kyis shin tu dri ma med pa'i yon tan de dag bshad par bya ste/ des na de'i rjes thogs su sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rnam par dbye ba las brtsams te tshigs su bcad pa/ rang don gzhan don don ④dam sku dang ni/ /de la brten pa'i kun rdzob sku nyid de/ /bral dang rnam par smin pas 'bras bu ni/ /yon tan dbye ba drug cu bzhi 'di dag /'di cis bstan zhe na/ bdag nyid kyi ⑤ni 'byor pa'i gnas/ /dam pa'i don ni ༅sku yin te/ /drang srong rnams kyi ༅brda yi sku/ /pha rol phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas / /dang po'i sku ni stobs la sogs/ /bral ba'i yon tan rnams dang ldan//gnyis pa skyes bu chen po'i mtshan/ /rnam smin yon tan dag dang ldan/ /'di man chad kyi gzhung ni stobs la sogs pa gang yin pa dang / ji ltar rtogs par byas pa de ltar de'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /sdom ni/ stobs nyid ma rig bsgribs ⑫la rdo rje bzhin/ /mi 'jigs pa ni 'khor du seng ge bzhin/ /70—1094

de bzhin gshegs pa'i ma 'dres mkha' bzhin te/ /thub pa'i bstan pa rnam laganyis chu zla bzhin/ /stobs rnams dang ldan pa ⑤zhes bya ba ni/ gnas dang gnas min las rnams kyi①/ /rnam smin dang ni dbang po dang / /khams rnams dang ni mos pa dang / /kun 'gro'i lam dang bsam gtan sogs/ /nyon mongs dri ma med pa dang / /gnas ni rjes su dran pa dang / /lha yi mig dang zhi ba ④dag /mkhyen pa'i stobs ni rnam pa bcu/ /rdo rje bzhin zhes bya ba ni/ /gnas dang gnas min rnam zhin khams dang 'gro ba mos pa sna tshogs dang //nyon mongs rnam byang dbang po'i tshogs ⑤dang sngon gnas rjes su dran pa dang / /lha yi mig dang zag pa zad tshul mi shes go cha rtsig brtan ④dang / /shing rnams 'bigs dang gzhig dang gcod phyir stobs gang yin pa rdo rje bzhin/ /mi 'jigs pa bzhi brnyes ④pa zhes bya ba ni/ chos kun rdzogs par byang chub dang / /gegs ni 'gog par byed pa ⑤dang / /lam ston pa dang 'gog ston la/ /mi 'jigs pa ni rnam pa bzhi/ /bdag gzhan shes bya'i dngos po rnam kun shes dang shes mdzad phyir/ /spangs dngos spangs dang spong mdzad phyir dang bsten bya ⑨bsten pa'i phyir/ /thob bya bla med shin tu dri med thob dang thob mdzad phyir/ /rang gzhan don bden gsungs phyir drang srong ⑫gang du'ang thogs pa med/ /seng ge bzhin zhes bya ba ni/ ri dwags dbang po ji ltar nags mthar rtag 'jigs med/ /ri dwags rnams la skrag pa med par rgyu ba ltar / /de bzhin tshogs na thub pa'i dbang po seng ge yang / /legs gnas ltos med brtan ⑪pa'i rtsal dang ldan par gnas/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/70—1095

'khrul dang ca co mi mnga' ste/ /ston la dran pa nyams mi mnga'/ /mnyam par ma bzhag thugs mi mnga'/ /'du shes sna tshogs kyang mi mnga' ma brtags ①btang snyoms mi mnga' ste/ /'dun pa brtson 'grus dran pa dang / /shes rab rnam grol rnam grol gyi/ /ye shes gzigs pa nyams mi mnga' las rnams ye shes sngon 'gro dang / /dus la ye shes sgrib pa med/ /de ltar bco brgyad 'di dang gzhan/ /ston pa'i ma 'dres yon tan yin/ /'khrul dang ca co bsnyel dang thugs g.yo tha dad kyi ni 'du shes dang / /ngang gis btang ⑤snyoms drang srong la med 'dun pa dang ni brtson 'grus dang / /dran dang rnam dag dri med shes rab rtag tu rnam par grol ba dang / /shes bya'i don kun gzigs pa'i ①grol ba'i ye shes las ni nyams mi mnga'/ /gang gi ④las gsum thams cad ye shes sngon 'gro rjes su 'jug pa dang / /dus gsum dag tu thogs med nges ④pa mkhyen pa rgya che 'jug pa ste/ /gang rtogs 'gro bar 'jigs med dam chos 'khor lo chen po rab bskor ba/ /thugs rje chen po dang ldan rgyal ba nyid de sangs rgyas rnams kyis brnyes/ /nam mkha' bzhin ④zhes bya ba ni/ sa sogs la yod chos nyid gang yin chos nyid de ni nam mkha'i min/ /nam mkha'i mtshan nyid sgrib med la sogs mtshan nyid gang de gzugs la med/ /sa chu me rlung nam mkha' mtshungs pa 'jig rten dag na thun mong ste/ /ma 'dres nyid ni rdul phran tsam yang 'jig rten dag na thun mong min/ /skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan pa'i gzugs mnga' ba zhes bya ba ni/ legs gnas 'khor los mtshan pa dang / /yangs dang zhabs long mi mngon dang / /sor mo ring dang phyag zhabs ring ④/ /dra ba yis ni 70—1096

'brel ba dang / /pags 'jam ①gzhon sha can legs nyid/ /sku ni bdun dag mtho ba dang / /byen pa e na ②ya 'dra gsang / /glang po bzhin du spubs su nub/ /ro stod seng ge ②'dra ba dang / /thal gong bar med rgyas pa dang / /dpung pa ④legs zlum phyag 'jam ring / /zlum zhing mthon dman med pa dang //phyag ring yongs su dag pa yiX/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor dag dang ldan/ /mgrin pa dri med dung 'dra dang / /'gram pa ri dwags rgyal po 'dra/ /tshems ni bzhi bcu mnyam pa dang / /rab dngas tshems thags bzang ba dang / /rnam ①dag shesas mnyam nyid dang ni/ /mche ba rab mchog dkar ba nyid/ /ljags ring mtha' med bsam med pa/ /ro bro ba yi mchog nyid dang / /rang byung sa la ping ga yi/ /sgra dang tshangs pa'i dbyangs nyid dang / /spyan bzangs ⑦/del khyu mchog rdzi 'dra dang / /zhal mdzes dri med mdzod spu dkar bar ldan/ /gtsug tor dbu ldan dag cing srab pa dang / /pags pa gser gyi ⑤mdog 'dra sems can mchog /ba spu legs phra 'jam zhing re re nas/ /sku yi gyen 0du g.yas phyogs 'khyil ba dang / /dbu skra dri med rin chen mthon mthing bzhin/ /rgya gro rdzogs pa'i ljon shing dkyil 'khor 'dra/ /kun tu bzang po dpe med drang srong che/ /sred med bu yi stobs mnga' ⑫mkhregs pa'i sku/ /bsam mi khyab par sum cu rtsa gnyis po/ /'di dag ston pas mi dbang mtshan du gsungs/ /chu zla bzhin ⑩zhes bya ba ni/ ji ltar sprin med nam mkha'i zla ba'i gzugs/ /ston ga'i chu sngon mtshor 0ni mthong ba ltar/ /de bzhin rgyal sras tshogs kyi spyokhyab bdag gzugs/ /rdzogs sangs ⑫dkyil 'khor nang du mthong bar 'gyur/ /de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang /70—1097

sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad dang / skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis po de dag rnam pa gcig tu mngon par bsdus te drug cu rtsa bzhir 'gyur ro/ /yon tan drug cu rtsa bzhi po/ /'di dag so sor ①rgyur bcas te/ /go rims ji bzhin rin chen gyi/ /mdo yi ②rjes 'brangs shes par bya/ /ji skad bstan pa nyid kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan drug cu rtsa bzhi po 'di dag gi ②rnam par dbye ba go rims 'di nyid kyis bstan pa ni/ bu mo rin po che'i mdo'i rjes su 'brangs te shes par bya'o/ /gnas 'di dag la go rims bzhin du rdo rje dang / seng ge dang /nam mkha' dang / chu zla'i dpe brjod pa gang yin pa de'i bsdus pa'i don ①tshigs su bcad pa bcus rig ⑤par bya ste/ mi phyed pa dang mi zhan dang / /mtshungs pa med dang g.yo med phyir/ /rdo rje seng ge mkha' dag dang / /chu yi zla ba'i dpes bstan to/ /stobs sogs rnams las stobs drug dang / /gsum dang gcig gis rim pa bzhin/ /shes bya snyoms par 'jug pa dang / /bag ༅ chags bcas pa kun bsal ④bas/ /go cha rtsig pa shing bzhin du/ /phug dang bshig dang bcad phyir ro/ /gling dang snying brtan mi phyed pas/ /drang srong stobs ni rdo rje 'dra/ /gang phyir brling ba snying po'i phyir/ /gang phyir snying po bstan ༅pa'i phyir/ /gang phyir brtan pa mi phyed phyir/ /mi phyed phyir na rdo rje bzhin/ /'jigs med phyir dang ltos med phyir/ /brtan phyir rtsal ni phun tshogs pas/ /thub pa seng ge seng ge bzhin/ /'khor gyi tshogs su 'jigs mi mnga'/ /kun mngon mkhyen pas gang las kyang / /'jigs med par ni rnam par gnas/ /dag pa'i sems can dang yang ⑨bdag /mi 70—1098

mnyam gzigs phyir ltos pa med/ /thugs ni chos rnams thams cad la/ /rtse gcig phyir na brtan pa nyid/ /mchog tu ma rig bag chags kyi/ /sa las rgal ①phyir rtsal ldan no/ /'jig rten nyan thos mtha' gcig pu/ /spyod dang blo ldan rang byung rnams/ /gong nas gong du blo dag ni/ /phra phyir dpe ni rnam pa lnga/ /'jig rten kun gyi nyer 'tsho'i ⑤phyir/ /sa chu me rlung rnams dang mtshungs/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /mtshan nyid las 'das nam mkha' bzhin//de dag yon tan sum cu ni/ /gnyis 'di chos skus rab phye ste/ /nor bu rin chen 'od mdog dang / /dbyings bzhin dbye ba med phyir ro/ /mthong na tshim byed yon tan gang / /sum cu rtsa gnyis zhes bya ba/ /sprul pa chos la rdzogs par ni/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku gnyis la brten⑤/ /dag las ring dang nye rnams las④/ /'jig rten rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /chu dang nam mkha' zla gzugs bzhin/ /de mthong ba ni rnam pa gnyis/ /theg pa chen po ⑤rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos dkon mchog gi rigs rnam par dbye ba las/ yon tan gyi skabs te le'u gsum pa'o / / ①dri ma med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yon tan bshad zin to// //da ni de'i las rgyal ba'i mdzad pa brjod par bya'o/ /de yang mdor bsdu ④na lhun gyis grub pa dang / rgyun mi 'chad pa rnam pa gnyis kyis ⑧'jug ste/des na de'i rjes la lasangs rgyas kyi ⑫mdzad pa lhun gyis grub cing rgyun mi 'chad pa nyid las brtsams te tshigs su bcad pa/ gdul bya'i khams dang 'dul byed thabs dang ni/ /gdul bya'i khams kyi ⑨gdul bya'i bya ba dang / /de yi yul dang dus su gshegs pa la⑫/ /khyab bdag rtag tu lhun gyis grub par 'jug /70—1099

yon tan rin chen mchog tshogs dang ldan ye shes chu mtsho bsod nams ye shes nyi 'od can/ /theg pa ma lus nges par bsgrubs te mtha' dang dbus med rgya chen nam mkha' ltar khyab pa/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni yon tan dri ma med ster sems can kun la khyad med rnams gzigs nas/ /nyon mongs shes bya'i sprin gyi ①dra ba sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rje'i rlung gis rnam par 'thor 'di gnyis kyi ①bsdus pa'i don ni/ go rims bzhin du tshigs su bcad pa gnyis dang brgyad kyis rig ②par bya ste/ gang zhig ④gang gis 'dul ba yi/ /bya gang gang du gang gi tshe/ /de ni rnam rtog skye med phyir/ /thub pa rtag tu lhun gyis grub/ /gdul bya'i khams ni gang zhig gi/ /gdul ba'i ⑤thabs mang gang dag gis⑥/ /gdul bya'i bya gang gang du ni/ /gang tshe yul dang dus de dag /nges 'byin de yi rton pa dang / /de'i 'bras de yi yongs 'dzin dang / /de sgrib de gcod rkyen la ni/ /rnam par rtog pa med phyir ro/ /nges par 'byin pa sa bcu ste/ /tshogs gnyis dag ni de yi rgyu/ /de 'bras byang chub mchog yin te/ /byang chub sems can yongs su 'dzin/ /de sgrib mtha' yas nyon mongs dang / /nye ba'i nyon mongs bag chags so/ /dus kun tu ni de 'joms pa'i/ /rkyen ni thugs rje chen po yin/ /gnas drug 'di rnams go rims bzhin/ /rgya mtsho nyi ma nam mkha'i ④gter/ /sprin dang rlung bzhin shes par bya/ /shes chu yon tan rin chen dang / /ldan phyir sa rnams rgya mtsho bzhin / /sems can thams cad nyer 'tsho'i phyir/ /tshogs gnyis dag ni nyi ma bzhin/ /rgya che mtha' dang dbus med phyir/ /byang chub nam mkha'i khams bzhin no/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs chos nyid phyir/ /sems can khams ni 70—1100

gter dang 'dra/ /glo bur khyab dang ma grub phyir/ /de yi nyon mongs sprin tshogs bzhin/ /de gtor ba yi nyer gnas phyir/ /thugs rje mi bzad rlung dang 'dra/ /gzhan gyi dbang gis nges 'byung dang / /bdag dang sems can mtshungs gzigs dang / /mdzad pa yongs su ma rdzogs phyir/ /'khor ba ①srid du mdzad ②mi 'chad/ /skye ba dang 'gag pa med pas rab tu phye ba zhes brjod pa'i sangs rgyas nyid gang yin pa de/ 'dir ni ji ltar na 'dus ma byas pas 'jug pa med pa'i mtshan nyid sangs rgyas nyid las lhun gyis grub cing rgyun mi 'chad par 'jig rten ji srid du/ rnam par ②rtog pa med par sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa rgyun du 'jug ces sangs rgyas kyi che ba'i bdag nyid chos nyid las brtsams te/ the tshom dang som nyi med ④pa rnams sangs rgyas kyi yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mos pa bskyed pa'i phyir/ dpe'i che ba'i bdag nyid ⑤las tshigs su bcad pa/brgya byin rnga sprin tshangs pa dang / /nyi ma nor bu rin chen bzhin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sgra brnyan bzhin/ /nam mkha' dang ni sa bzhin no/ /mdo'i gnas lta bu'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di'i rnam par dbye ba rgyas par bstan pa ni/ go rims ji lta ba bzhin du gzhung lhag mas rig par bya'o/ /brgya byin du snang ba bzhin no ④zhes bya ba ni/ ji ltar bai ḍūr ④dag pa yi/ /rang bzhin sa stengs ⑤'dir 'gyur te/ /dag ༅phyir lha yi dbang po der/ /lha yi bu mo'i tshogs dang bcas/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzangs ⑩dang / /lha gnas de las gzhan dag dang / /de yi gzhal yas sna tshogs dang / /lha rdzas rnam mang de mthong ngo / /de nas skyes pa bud med tshogs/ /sa yi steng na 70—1101

gnas pa rnams/ /snang ba de ni mthong gyur te/ /nged kyang ring por ①mi thogs par/ /lha dbang 'di 'drar gyur cig ces/ /'di 'dra'i smon lam 'debs byed cing / /de thob don du dge ba ni/ /yang dag blangs te gnas par 'gyur/ /de dag dge ba'i las des na/ /'di snang tsam zhes de lta bur/ /shes pa med kyang sa steng na⑤/ /'phos te lhar ni skye bar 'gyur/ /snang ba de ni shin tu yang / /rtogs ②pa med cing g.yo ba med/ /de lta mod kyi sa stengs ④na / /don chen gyis ni nye bar gnas/ /de bzhin dad sogs dri med can/ /dad sogs yon tan sgom pa yi/ /rang sems la snang rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /mtshan dang dpe byad dang ldan pa/ /'chag pa dang ni bzhengs pa dang / /bzhugs pa dang ni gzims pa dang / /spyod lam sna tshogs mdzes pa can/ /zhi ba'i chos ni gsung ba ④dang / /mi gsung ⑤mnyam par gzhag gyur pa/ /cho 'phrul rnam pa sna tshogs dag /mdzad pa gzi mdangs chen po can/ /sems can rnams kyis mthong bar 'gyur/ /de mthong nas kyang 'dod ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas nyid phyir rab sbyor te/ /de rgyu yang dag blangs nas ni/ /'dod pa'i go 'phang thob par byed/ /snang ba de ni shin tu yang / /rtog med g.yo ba med pa nyid/ /de lta na yang 'jig rten na/ /don chen pos ni nye bar gnas / /'di ni rang sems snang ba zhes/ /so so'i ④skye bos mi shes mod⑤/ /de lta na yang gzugs mthong ste/ /de dag la ni don yod 'gyur/ / rim gyis ⑨de mthong la brten nas/ /theg pa 'di la gnas pa rnams/ /nang gi dam pa'i chos sku ni/ /ye shes mig gis mthong bar 'gyur/ /ji ltar sa kun dman ⑫pa'i gnas gzhan dang bral dri 7med bai ḍūr+ya/ /gsal mdzes nor bu'i 70—1102

yon tan dri bral dpal ldan steng ni mnyam gyur te/ / dag phyir der ①ni lha dag gnas ⑤tshogs lha dbang lha yi gzugs shar te/ /rim gyis sa yi yon tan bral phyir de ni slar yang mi snang 'gyur/ /de dngos thob phyir bsnyen gnas brtul zhugs nges par sbyin sogs la phyogs pa/ /bud med skyes tshogs smon pa'i sems kyis me tog la sogs 'thor ⑤ba ltar/ /dag pa'i bai ḍūr+ya 'dra rjosems la snang ba'i thub dbang thob bya'i phyir/ /rab dga'i ④sems ldan rgyal ba'i sras rnams de bzhin sems ④rab skyed par byed/ /ji ltar bai ḍūr sa gzhi ⑦gtsang ma la/ /lha dbang lus kyi gzugs brnyan snang ba ltar/ /de bzhin 'gro sems sa gzhi gtsang ma la/ /thub pa'i dbang po'i sku yi gzugs brnyan 'char / /'gro bar gzugs brnyan 'char nub rnyog med dang / /rnyog pa'i rang sems rab 'jug dbang gis 'jug /ji ltar 'jig rten dag na gzugs snang ltar/ /de bzhin yod dang zhig ces de mi lta/ /lha'i rnga bzhin zhes bya ba ni / ji ltar lha nang lha rnams kyi/ /sngon gyi ⑧dkar po'i mthu yis ni/ /'bad dang gnas dang yid gzugs dang / /rnam par rtog pa med bzhin du/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal bdag med dang / /zhi ba'i sgra yis bag med pa'i/ /lha rnams thams cad yang nas yang / /chos kyi rngas ni skul byed ltar/ /de bzhin khyab bdag 'bad sogs dang / /bral dang 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /sangs rgyas gsung gis khyab mdzad de/ /skal ldan rnams la chos ston to/ /ji ltar lha nang 0lha rnams kyi/ /rnga sgra rang gi ⑩las las byung / /de bzhin 'jig rten thub ⑪pa'i chos/ /gsung ba'ang rang gi ⑫las las 'byung / /'bad gnas lus dang sems bral ba'i/ /sgra de ji ltar zhi sgrub ⑩ltar/ /de bzhin 70—1103

bzhi dang bral ba yi/ /chos 'di zhi ba sgrub par byed/ /ji ltar lha yi grong na rnga sgra'i rgyun 'byung mi 'jigs sbyin pa ni/ /nyon mongs g.yul du 'jug tshe lha min g.yul rgyal rtsed mo sel ba bzhin/ /de bzhin 'jig rten dag na bsam gtan gzugs med la sogs rgyus byung ba/ /sems can nyon mongs sdug bsngal rab 'joms zhi ba bla med lam tshul brjod/ /ci'i phyir 'dir chos kyi rnga nyid kyi dbang du byas kyi/ lha'i sil snyan gyi rnam pa de las gzhan pa dag kyang ma yin te/de dag lha rnams kyi sngon byas pa'i las kyi dbang gis mod kho nar lha'i rna bar yid 'phrog pa'i sgra'i rjes su 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ①dbyangs dang de dag chos mi mthun pa'i yon tan rnam pa bzhi'o/ /de dag kyang gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ nyi tshe ba nyid dang / phan pa ma yin pa nyid dang / bde ba ༅ma yin pa nyid dang / nges par 'byin par byed pa ma yin pa nyid do//chos kyi rnga ni bag med pa'i lha'i ①tshogs mtha' dag bskul ba nyid dang / de'i dus la mi 'da' bas na nyi tshe ba ma yin pa nyid du bstan to/ /lha ma yin la sogs pa pha rol gyi tshogs nye bar 'tshe ba'i 'jigs pa las yongs su skyob pa nyid dang / bag yod pa'i gnas la rab tu sbyor bas na phan pa nyid dang / dam pa ma yin pa'i 'dod pa'i dga' ba de rnam par 'byed pa nyid dang / chos kyi kun dga'i dga' ba de nye bar sgrub ④pas na bde ba nyid do/ /mi rtag pa dang /sdug bsngal ba dang / stong pa dang / bdag med pa'i sgra sgrogs pa nyid dang /nye bar 'tshe ba'i phongs phyopa thams cad nye bar zhi bar byed pas na nges par 'byin par byed pa nyid du bstan to/ /mdor bsdu na rnam pa bzhi po 'di dag gis chos kyi rnga dang chos mthun pas na/ sangs rgyas kyi dbyangs kyi dkyil 70—1104

'khor khyad par du 'phags so/ /des na sangs rgyas kyi ①dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor las brtsams te tshigs su bcad pa/ /gang phyir skye kun pa nyid dang / /phan bde cho 'phrul gsum ldan pa / /de phyir thub dbyangs lha rdzas kyi④/ /sil snyan rnams las khyad par 'phags / /rnam pa bzhi po 'di dag gis nges par bstan pa ni/ mdor bsdu na tshigs su bcad pa bzhis grangs ji lta ba bzhin du rig par bya ste/ lhar ni rnga yi sgra chen po/ /sar gnas rnams kyi rnar mi 'gro/ /sangs rgyas rnga sgra 'khor ba yi/ /sa 'og 'jig rten dag tu 'gro/ /lhar ni lha yi sil snyan bye ba mang / /'dod me mngon par 'phel ba'i don du sgogs/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid rnams kyi ②dbyangs gcig kyang / /sdug bsngal mi rab zhi ba'i don du 'jug /lhar ni mdzes shing yid 'ong sil snyan sgra/ /sems kyi rgod pa 'phel bar gyur pa'i rgyu/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung ①/ /ting 'dzin sems gtong bsam pa skul byed nyid/ /mdor na ma lus 'jig rten khams rnams su'ang / /lha dang sa yi khyabade ba'i rgyu gang yin/ /de ni ma lus 'jig rten khyab snang ba/ /dbyangs nyid la ni rab tu brten par brjod/ /lus kyi cho 'phrul gyis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi ④khams ma lus par khyab pas ni/rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul zhes bstan to/ /sems kyi rnam grangs mkhyen pas de rtogs pa sems can gyi sems kyi spyod pa zab mo ④snang ba ni kun brjod pa'i cho 'phrul lo//ngag gi dbyangs brjod pas nges par 'byin pa'i lam skelas brtsams te 'doms pa dang rjes su bstan pa ni/ rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul lo/ /de ltar thogs pa med par 'gro ba'i sangs rgyas kyi dbyangs ⑨kyi dkyil 70—1105

'khor nam mkha'i khams ltar yongs su chad pa med par 'jug kyang thams cad du rnam pa ①thams cad kyis dmigs par ma gtogs pa gang yin pa der sangs rgyas kyi dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi nyes pa ni ma yin no zhes bstan pa'i don du de ma gtogs pa rnams kyi bdag nyid kyi nyes pa las brtsams te tshigs su bcad pa② / ji ltar rna ba dang bral bas/ /phra mo'i sgra ni mi myong bzhin/ /thams cad lha yi rna bar yang / /rna lam du ni mi 'gro bzhin/ /de bzhin chos phra mchog tu ni/ /zhib mo'i ye shes spyod yul yang / /nyon mongs med yid 'ga' zhig gi/ /rna ba'i lam du 'gyur ba yin/ /sprin bzhin zhes bya ba ni/ji ltar dbyar gyi dus na sprin/ /lo tog phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu/ /chu yi phung po 'bad med par/ /sa la mngon par ①'bebs pa ltar/ /de bzhin thugs rje'i sprin las ni/ /rgyal ba'i dam chos chu yi char/ /'gro ba'i dge ba'i lo tog rgyu/ /rnam par rtog pa med par 'bebs/ /ji ltar 'jig rten dge ba'i lam 'jug pa④/ /rlung bskyod ⑤chu char sprin gyis 'bebs pa ltar/ /de bzhin brtse rlung 'gro dge mngon 'phel phyir/ /sangs rgyas sprin las dam chos char pa ④'bebs / /srid la mkhyen dang brtse chen 'gyur ba dang / /mi 'gyur ma gos nam mkha'i dkyil gnas pa/ /ting 'dzin gzungs chu dri med snying po can/ /thub dbang sprin ni dge ba'i lo tog rgyu/ /snod rnams sna tshogs nyid las ni/ /ji ltar bsil zhing mngar dang 'jam pa dang / /yang ba'i chu ni sprin de las 'thon ④pa/ /sa la ba tsha ⑤la sogs gnas 'brel bas/ /shin tu mang po'i ror ni 'gyur ba bzhin/ /de bzhin 'phags ⑨pa'i yan lag brgyad chu'i ⑩char//rab yangs brtse sprin snying po las 'thon ⑩pa/ /'gro ba'i rgyud kyi gnas kyi dbye 70—1106

ba las/ /rnam pa mang po'i ro dang ldan par 'gyur/ /ltos pa med par 'jug pa las ni/ theg pa mchog la dang ba dang / /bar ma dang ni sdang ba yi/ /phung po gsum ni mi dag dang / /rma bya dang ni yi dwags 'dra/ /dpyid mthar sprin med pa na 1mi dang mkha' mi rgyu ba'i phyo/bya dag dang / /dbyar tshe sa la char bab ༅pas na yi dwags dag ni sdug pa ltar/ /snying rje'i sprin tshogs dag gis chos chu byung dang ma byung ba las kyang / /chos 'dod pa dang chos la sdang ba'i 'jig rten na ni dpe de nyid/ /thigs ༅ pa rags 'bebs rdo tshan ༅dang ni rdo rje'i me ni 'bebs pas na/ /srog chags phra dang ri sul song ba dag la ji ltar sprin ltos med//phra dang rgya chen rigs ༅thabs tshul gyis mkhyen pa dang ni brtse ba'i sprin/ /nyon mongs dag 'gyur bdag lta'i bag chags dag las rnam pa khyakun ltos med/ /sdug bsngal gyi me rab tu 'jil ba las ni/ 'khor ba'i skye 'chi thog mtha' med der 'gro ba'i lam ni rnam pa lnga/ /mi gtsang ba la dri zhim med bzhin 'gro lnga dag la bde ba med/ /de'i sdug 3rtag tu mi mtshon kha ba rgya tsha ⑨la sogs reg skyes bzhin/ /thugs rje'i sprin las dam chos char chen de rab zhi byed rab tu 'bebs / /lha la 'chi 'pho mi la yongs tshol sdug bsngal zhes bya rtogs ༅pa'i phyir / /shes rab ldan pa lha mi'i dbang phyug mchog la'ang mngon par 'dod med de/ /shes rab dang ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab dad pa'i rjes 'brangs nas/ /'di ni sdug bsngal 'di rgyu khye'adi ni 'gog ces shes pas mthong phyir ro/ /nad ni shes bya nad kyi rgyu ②ni spang bya la/ /bder gnas thob bya sman ni bsten ༅par bya ba ltar/ /sdug bsngal rgyu dang de 'gog pa dang de bzhin lam/ /shes bya spang bya rig par bya zhing bsten par bya/ /tshangs pa 70—1107

chen po ①bzhin zhes bya ba ni/ /ji ltar tshangs pa tshangs pa yi/ /gnas nas 'pho ba med bzhin du/ /lha yi gnas ni thams cad du/ /snang ba 'bad med ②ston pa ltar / /de bzhin thub pa'i chos sku las/ /bskyod pa med par khams kun tu/ /skal ①ldan rnams la 'bad med par/ /sprul pa dag gis ston par mdzad/ /ji ltar tshangs rtag gzhal yas khang nas mi g.yo 'dod khams zhugs pa de④/ /lha rnams kyis mthong de ④mthong de yang yul la dga' ba spong byed ltar/ /de bzhin bde gshegs chos kyi sku las mi bskyod ④'jig rten kun du de/ /skal ༷ldan gyis mthong de ni mthong de rtag tu dri ma kun sel byed/ /sngon gyi rang nyid smon lam dang / /lha rnams kyi ni dge ba'i mthus/ /ji ltar tshangs pa 'bad med snang / /rang byung sprul sku de bzhin no/ /mi snang ba las ni/ 'pho dang lhums 'jug bltams dang yab kyi khab gshegs dang / /dgyes rol pa dang dben ⑤par spyod dang bdud bcom dang / /byang chub che brnyes zhi ba'i grong khyer lam ston dag /bstan nas thub pa skal med mig gi lam mi 'gyur/ /nyi ma bzhin zhes bya ba ni/ji ltar nyi mas gdungs pa ⑨dus gcig tshe nyid la/ /pad sogs rgyas dang ku mu ta ni rab zum pa/ /chu skyes 'byed dang zum pa'i yon tan skyon dag la/ /nyi ma rtog med 'dir ni 'phags pa'i nyid de 0bzhin/ /sems can gyi ༅khams ni rnam pa gnyis te/ gdul bya dang gdul bya ma yin pa'o/ /de la gdul bya ni de'i dbang du byas te/ pad+ma lta bu dang chu dang ba'i snod lta bu'o/ /ji ltar nyi ma rtog med pa/ /rang 'od cig car spros pa yis / /pad+ma rgyas par byed pa dang / /gzhan dag smin par byed pa ⑩ltar/ /de bzhin de bzhin gshegs pa yi0/ /nyi ma dam chos 'od zer dag /gdul 70—1108

bya'i skye bo pad+ma la/ /rnam par rtog pa med par 'jug /chos dang gzugs kyi sku dag gis/ /byang chub snying po'i mkhar shar ba/ /kun mkhyen nyi ma 'gro bar ni/ /ye shes 'od zer spro bar mdzad/ /gang phyir gdul bya dag pa yi/ /chu yi snod ni thams cad la/ /bde gshegs nyi ma'i gzugs brnyan ni/ /dpag tu med pa cig char 'char/ /de ltar sangs rgyas rnams 7rnam par rtog pa med pa yin yang / sems can gyi ⑤tshogs rnam pa gsum la ston pa dang /'doms pa 'jug pa'i tshul gyis ༅dbang du byas te nyi ma dang 'dra ba nyid ni/rtag tu thams cad la khyab pa/ /chos dbyings nam mkha'i dkyil du ni/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma gdul bya yi/ /ri la ji ltar 'os par 'bab/ /ji ltar rgya che 'od zer snang ldan nyi ma bzhin/ /'jig rten kun tu snang bar byas nas rim gyis ni/ /mchog dang bar ma dman pa'i ri la 'bab ④de bzhin/ /rgyal ba'i khyanyi ma sems can tshogs la rim gyis 'bab/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor khyad par du gyur pa ni/ zhing kun nam mkha'i dkyil 'phro nyi ma la med la/ /mi shes mun bkab shes bya'i don ston pa yang min/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid sna tshogs mdog bkye'i 'od tshogs kyis/ /gsal ba dag ni 'gro la shes bya'i don ston ④mdzad / /sangs rgyas grong du gshegs tshe mig dang mi ldan pa yi skye bo rnams/ /mthong zhing don med tshogs bral don de mthong ba las ni ⑤myong ba dang / /gti mug gis ldongs srid pa'i mtshor lhung lta ba'i mun pas bsgribs ༅pa rnams/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma'i 'od kyis blo snang ma mthong ba yi gnas mthong 'gyur/ /yid bzhin nor bu bzhin zhes bya ba ni/ ji ltar yid bzhin nor bu ni/ /rtog pa med kyang cig car du/ /spyod yul gnas pa rnams kyi ni/ /bsam kun so 70—1109

sor rdzogs byed ltar/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas yid bzhin la/ /brtan ①nas bsam pa tha dad rnams/ /sna tshogs chos ni thos 'gyur yang / /de ni de las rnam mi rtog /ji ltar yid bzhin nor bu rin chen 'dod pa'i nor/ /'bad pa khyamed par gzhan pa dag la rab ster ltar/ /de bzhin thub pa 'bad med ji ltar 'os par ni/ /gzhan gyi don du srid pa ji srid rtag tu bzhugs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba rnyed par dka' ba zhes bya ba ni/ gang phyir rgya mtshor ①sa 'og gnas de ④la 'dod pas/ /ji ltar nor bu bzang po 'gro 'dir rab rnyed dka'/ /de bzhin 'gro ba shin tu skal ngan ④nyon mongs zin/ /yid 'dir bde gshegs mthong ba rnyed dka' shes par bya/ /sgra snyan ④gyi sgra bzhin zhes bya ba ni/ ji ltar sgra brnyan gyi ni sgra/ /gzhan gyi rnam rig las byung ba④/ /rnam rtog med cing bzo ⑤med la/ /phyi dang nang la mi gnas ltar//de bzhin de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung / /gzhan gyi rnam rig las byung ba/ /rnam par rtog med bsam med pa/ /phyi dang nang na gnas ma yin/ /nam mkha' bzhin zhes bya ba ni/ /cung zad med cing snang ba med/ /dmigs pa med cing rten med la/ /mig gi lam las rab 'das pa/ /gzugs med bstan du med pa yi/ /⑨mkha' la ji ltar mtho dang dma'/ /mthong ༅yang de ni de ltar min/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /mthong khyayang de ni de ltar khyamin/ /sa bzhin zhes bya ba ni/ ji ltar sa las skye ba kun⑩/ /rtog med sa la brten nas ⑫ni/ /'phel dang bstan dang yangs ⑫'gyur ltar/ /de bzhin rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa/ /rnam rtog med pa la brten nas/ /'gro ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ni/ /ma lus par ni 'phel bar 'gyur/ /dpe rnams 70—1110

kyis bsdus pa'i don ni/ 'bad rtsol med par bya ba 'ga'/ /byed pa mthong med de bas na/ /gdul bya'i the tshom bcad pa'i phyir/ /dpe rnams ①dgu ni bstan pa yin/ /gang du dpe dgu po 'di dag /rgyas par rab tu bstan gyur pa / /mdo sde yi ni ming nyid kyis/ /de yi dgos ⑤pa bstan pa nyid/ /thos pa las byung shes pa yi/ /snang ba rgya chen 'dis brgyan pa'i/ /blo ldan myur du sangs rgyas kyi/ /spyod yul kun la 'jug par 'gyur/ /de don bai ḍūr ②brgya byin gyi/ /gzugs brnyan la sogs dpe dag ni/ /rnam pa dgu brjod de la ni//de yi ④bsdus don nges par gzung / /ston dang gsung dang khyab pa dang / /sprul dang ye shes spro ba dang / /thugs gsung sku yi gsang ba dang / /thugs rje'i bdag nyid ④thob pa nyid/ /'bad rtsol rgyun kun rab zhi ba/ /rnam par rtog pa med pa'i thugs/ /dri med bai ḍūr ④brgya byin gyi/ /gzugs brnyan shar ba la sogs bzhin/ /'bad rtsol zhi ba dam bca' ste/ /rtog ④med thugs ni gtan tshigs so/ /rang bzhin don ni grub don du/ /dpe ni brgya byin gzugs sogs yin / /'dir ni skabs don 'di yin te/ /ston pa la sogs rnam dgu ni/ /ston pa skye 'chi dang bral ba/ /'bad pa med par rab tu 'jug /don 'di nyid kyi dbang du byas te dpe bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa bzhi ste/gang zhig brgya byin rnga dang sprin bzhin dang / /tshangs nyi ⑧rin chen yid bzhin nor rgyal bzhin/ /sgra snyan ⑨nam mkha' sa bzhin srid pa'i bar/ /'bad med gzhan don byed de rnal 'byor rig /ston pa rin chen lha dbang gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /legs par 'doms mdzad lha yi rnga dang 'dra/ /khyab bdag mkhyen dang brtse chen sprin tshogs ni/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba srid rtse'i ⑫bar du 70—1111

khyab / /tshangs bzhin zag med gnas las ma bskyod par/ /sprul pa rnam pa du ma rab tu ston/ /nyi bzhin ye shes snang ba rab spro gang / /rnam dag rin chen yid bzhin nor 'dra'i thugs/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi gsung de brag ca bzhin du yi ge med/ /sku ni nam mkha' bzhin du khyab dang gzugs med rtag pa nyid/ /sa bzhin 'gro ba dkar po'i chos kyi sman rnams ma lus pa'i/ /rnam pa kun du gzhir ①gyur pa ni sangs rgyas sa ⑤yin no/ /yang ji ltar na dpe brjod pa 'dis/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams rtag tu skye ba med cing 'gag pa med pa yin/ skye ba dang ni 'gag par mthong ba dang / 'di dag gis sangs rgyas kyi phrin las 'gro ba thams cad du lhun gyis grub pa rgyun mi 'chad par bstan pa yin zhe na/ dag pa bai ḍūr+ya 'dra yi//sems la sangs rgyas mthong ba'i rgyu/ /de dag pa ni mi zlogs ⑤pa'i/ /dad pa'i dbang po brtas pa nyid④/ /dge ba skye dang 'jig pas na④/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni skye dang 'jig /brgya ①byin bzhin du thub pa ni/ /chos kyi sku la skye 'jig med/ /de bzhin du ni 'bad med par/ /skye med 'gag med chos sku las/ /srid pa ji srid gnas bar du/ /ston pa la sogs mdzad pa 'jug /dpe 'di rnams kyis bsdus pa yi/ /don ni 'di yin rim pa yang ⑦ //snga ma phyi mas chos mi mthun⑤/ /spangs pa'i sgo nas brjod pa yin/ /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan lta bu ste1/ /dbyangs dang mi ldan de 'dra min/ /lha yi rnga bzhin thams cad du/ /don byed min pa de 'dra min/ /sprin chen dang mtshungs don med pa'i/ /sa bon spong min de 'dra'ang min/ /tshangs chen bzhin de gtan du ni/ /smin par byed min de 'dra'ang min/ /nyi ma'i 70—1112

gzugs bzhin gtan du ni/ /mun pa 'joms min de 'dra'ang min/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra 'byung ba ni/ /rnyed par mi dka' de 'dra'ang min/ /sgra brnyan ①bzhin de rkyen las ni/ /'byung bas de dang 'dra ba'ang ②min/ /nam mkha' dang 'dra dge ba yi/ /gzhi min de dang 'dra ba'ang min/ /'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das pa/ /'gro ba'i phun tshogs ma lus pa/ /de gnas pa yi rten yin phyir/ /sa yi dkyil 'khor dag dang 'dra/ /sangs rgyas byang chub la brten nas/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i lam byung phyir/ /dge ba'i las lam bsam gtan dang / /tshad med pa dang gzugs med 'byung / /theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos dkon mchog gi rigs rnam par dbye ba las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i phrin las mdzad pa'i skabs te le'u bzhi pa'o// //tshigs su bcad pa'i don gyis ①bsdus pa'i bshad pa rdzogs so// //'di man chad ni ji skad bsgrags pa'i gnas bzhi po 'di dag nyid la ④lhag par mos pa rnams kyi lhag par mos pa'i phan yon gyi tshigs su bcad pa drug go / /sangs rgyas khams dang sangs rgyas byang chub dang / /sangs rgyas chos dang sangs rgyas phrin las te/ /dag pa'i sems kyis kyang ni bsam bya min/ /'di ni 'dren pa rnams kyi spyod yul yin/ /blo ldan rgyal ba'i yul 'di la mos pa//sangs rgyas yon tan tshogs kyi snod gyur te/ /bsam med yon tan tshogs la mngon dga' bas/ /sems can kun gyi bsod nams zil gyis gnon/ /gang zhig byang chub don du gnyer bas gser bzhin nor bus ④spras pa ni/ /sangs rgyas zhing rdul ①mnyam pa nyin re chos rgyal nyid la rtag 'bul ba/ /70—1113

gzhan gang 'di las latshig tsam thos shing thog ②nas kyang ni mos na 'di/ /sbyin pa las byung dge ba de las bsod nams ches mang thob par 'gyur/ /blo ldan gang zhig bla med byang chub 'dod pas bskal pa du mar yang / /lus ngag yid kyi ②'bad pa med par tshul khrims dri med srung byed la/ /gzhan dag 'di las tshig tsam thos shing thos nas kyang ni mos na 'di/ /tshul khrims las byung dge ba de las bsod nams ches mang thob par 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'di na srid pa gsum gyi nyon mongs me 'joms bsam gtan ni/ /lha dang tshangs gnas mthar son ④rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'pho med thabs bsgoms la/ /gzhan gang 'di las tshig tsam thos shing thos nas kyang ni mos na 'di/ /bsam gtan las byung dge ba de las bsod nams ches mang thob par 'gyur/ /gang zhigo sbyin pas longs spyod dag ni sgrub byed cing / /khrims kyis mtho ris bsgoms pas nyon mongs spong byed la/ /shes rab nyon mongs shes bya kun spong de yi phyir/ /'di mchog nyid de de yi rgyu ni 'di thos yin/ /tshigs su bcad pa 'di rnams kyi don ni/ tshigs su bcad pa dgus bshad par rig par bya ste/ gnas dang de ni ④gyur pa dang / /de ①yi yon tan don grub ste/ /rgyal ba yi ni mdon pa'i yul/ /rnam bzhi ji skad brjod 'di la/ /blo ldan yod dang nus nyid dang / /yon tan ldan par mos pas na⑦//myur du de bzhin gshegs pa yi⑤/ /go 'phang 'thob pa'i skal ldan 'gyur/ /bsam mi khyab pa'i yul 'di ni/ / yod dang ⑨bdag 'dras thob rtenus dang / /thob pa 'di 'dra'i yon tan dang / /ldan zhes dad pas mos pa'i phyir/ /'dun brtson dran dang bsam gtan dang / /shes rab la sogs yon tan snod//70—1114

byang chub sems ni de dag la/ /rtag tu nye bar gnas par 'gyur/ /de ni rtag tu nyer gnas pas/ /rgyal ba'i sras po phyir mi ldog /bsod nams pha rol phyin rdzogs dang / /yongs su dag pa nyid du 'gyur/ /bsod nams pha rol phyin pa lnga/ /de la rnam gsum rtog med pas/ /de rdzogs yongs su dag pa ni/ /de yi mi mthun phyogs spangs phyir/ /sbyin byung bsod nams sbyin pa de//tshal khrims las byung tshul khrims yin/ /bzod dang bsam gtan gnyis dag ni//sgom byung brtson 'grus kun tu 'gro/ /'khor gsum rnam par rtog pa gang / /de ni shes bya'i sgrib par 'dod/ /ser sna la sogs rnam rtog gang / /de ni nyon mongs sgrib par 'dod/ /shes rab las gzhan 'di dag ni/ /spong rgyu gzhan med de yi phyir/ /shes rab mchog yin de bzhi ①ni/ /thos pa de phyir thos pa mchog /de ltar yid ches lung dang rigs pa la/ /brten nas bdag nyid 'ba' zhig dag phyir dang / /gang dag mos dge phun sum tshogs ldan blo/ /de dag rjes su gzung phyir 'di bshad do/ /ji ltar bshad pa 'di las brtsams te tshigs su bcad pa/ ji ltar sgron glog nor bu nyi zla la/ /brten nas mig dang ldan pa lta ba bzhin/ /de bzhin don chen chos spobs 'od mdzad pa/ /thub la brten nas 'di ni rab tu bshad / /gang bshad pa de las brtsams te tshigs su bcad pa/ gang zhig don ldan chos dang nyer 'brel zhing / /khams gsum kun nas nyon mongs spong byed gsung / /zhi ba'i phan yon ston par mdzad pa gang / /de ni drang srong gsung yin bzlog pa gzhan/ /gang gis bshad pa de las brtsams te tshigs su bcad pa/ gang zhig 70—1115

rgyal ba'i bstan ①pa 'ba' zhig gis/ /dbang byas rnam g.yeng med yid ⑤can gyis bshad༅ / /thar pa thob pa'i lam dang rjes mthun par④/ /de yang drang srong bka' bzhin spyi bos blang / /bdag bsrung ba'i ༅thabs las brtsams te tshigs su bcad pa/ gang phyir rgyal las ches mkhas 'ga' yang 'jig rten 'di na yod min te/ /ma lus de nyid mchog ni tshul bzhin kun mdon gyis mdon gzhan min pa/ /de phyir drang srong rang nyid kyis gzhag mdo sde gang yin de mi dkrub④/ /thub tshul gzhig phyir de yang dam chos la ni gnod pa byed par 'gyur/ /nyon mongs rmongs bdag ④rnams kyis 'phags la skur pa dang / /des gsungs chos la brnyas gang de kun zhenakhyaltas byas/ /des na zhen lta'i dri can de la blo mi sbyar/ /gos gtsang tshon gyis rnam bsgyur snum gyis gos pa min/ /nyams pa'i rgyu las brtsams te tshigs su bcad pa/ blo dman phyir dang dkar ༅mos bral phyir 0 log pa'i nga rgyal bstan ⑪phyir dang / /dam chos phongs pas bsgrib /rtepa'i bdag phyir drang don de nyid 'dzin pa'i phyir/ /rnyed la brkam phyir lta ba'i dbang phyir chos sun 'byin pa brten phyir dang / /chos 'dzin bsrings ༅phyir mos pa dman phyir ⑫dgra bcom rnams kyi chos spong byed/ /nyams pa'i 'bras bu las brtsams te tshigs su bcad pa/ ji ltar zab mo'i chos rnams 0de bzhin mkhas pa rnams kyis me dang ni/ /mi bzad ⑫sbrul gdug gshed ma dang ni thog la'ang shin tu 'jigs mi bya/ /me sbrul dgra dang rdo rje'i ⑫mes ni srog dang bral ba tsam byed de/ /de las mnar med rnams kyi 'gro ba shin tu 'jigs par 'gro mi 'gyur/ /gang zhig yang yang sdig grogs bsten pas sangs 70—1116

rgyas ngan sems ldan gyur dang / /pha ma dgra bcom gsod pa bya ba min byed mchog tshogs 'byed pa'i mi/ /de yang chos nyid nges par bsams pas ①myur du de las thar 'gyur gyi/ /gang zhig yid ni chos la sdang ba de la thar pa ga la yod/ /dkon mchog rnam par byang khams dri med byang chub yon tan phrin las te/ /don gnas rnam bdun tshul bzhin bshad las bdag gis dge ba gang thob pa/ /des ni 'gro 'di mtha' yas 'od mnga' drang srong tshe dpag med mthong zhing / /mthong nas kyang ni chos mig dri med skyes te byang chub mchog thob shog /tshigs su bcad pa bcu po 'di dag gis bsdus pa'i don yang tshigs su bcad pa rnam pa ②gsum gyis rig par bya ste/ gang las rgyu mtshan gang phyir ni//ji lta bur ni gang brjod dang / /rgyu mthun pa ni gang yin de/ /tshigs su bcad pa bzhis bstan to/ /gnyis kyi ①bdag nyid dag pa yiX/ /thabs dang gcig gis nyams pa'i rgyu/ /de nas tshigs su bcad pa ni/ gnyis kyis 'bras bu bstan pa yin/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor bzod pa dang / /byang chub thob pa'i ⑤chos brjod pa'i/ /mdor na 'bras bu rnam gnyis ni/ /tha ma yis ni bstan pa yin/ /theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos/ dkon mchog gi rigs rnam par dbye ba las phan yon gyi le'u ste lnga pa'o// //tshigs su bcad pa'i don gyis ④bsdus pa'i bshad pa rdzogs so// //theg mchog dam chos rin chen bshad 'di las/ /bsam yas bsod nams bdag gis gang thob pa/ /des ni 'gro kun theg mchog dam pa'i chos/ /rin chen dri ma med pa'i snod gyur cig /'phags pa mgon po byams pas mdzad pa/ theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos kyi rnam par bshad pa slob 70—1117

dpon thogs med kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //dpal grong yo chen po dpe med kyi mkhas pa chen po bram ze rin chen rdo rje'i dbon po/ paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa chen po sad dza na dang / lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis/ grong khyer dpe med de nyid du bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/987 lamang byang 'di chos ra 'di'i mar bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉༅ gatheg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos kyi rnam par bshad pa 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa bzhugs so/ /zhes 'khod/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉 / ①〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉khrus/ ④〈'ar 〉thazhi/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉༅sam/ ④〈〈pe〉nga'ar 〉༅ni/ ⑦〈〈pe〉nga〈snar 〉ngan/988 ①〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉༅gyis/ ②〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉nga'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉〉te/ ①〈'ar 〉rgas/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༄lta/ ①⑦〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉༅/989 ①〈〈snar 〉༅gas/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉ngalas/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉ngachos kyi/ ④〈'ar 〉༅phreng / ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༅'i/ ④〈'ar 〉tshogs/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rna'i/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉༅khas/ ⑨〈'ar 〉༅/⑫〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉rgyas/99 ①〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉ram/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉rgas/ khya〈〈snar 〉thazhi'i/ ④〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉༅zhi/ ⑤〈〈pe〉〉〈'ar 〉ngashin tu/ ④〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉༅la/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉rgyas/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉ngal/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༅/991 ①〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉rna/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉༅mnga' ba/ ①〈'ar 〉rgyas/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉thugs/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༄sgrubs/ ④〈〈snar 〉skod/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ngayongs su/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉nga'i/992 ①〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉bsgrub/ ②〈〈snar 〉༅zhi'i/ ②〈'ar 〉nga/ ④〈〈pe 〉༅zhi'i le'u rjes thugs/〈〈snar 〉thazhi'i le'u rjes thogs/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉chus/ ④〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉༅sa/993 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ngaba'i/ ④〈'ar 〉ngarnams/ ①〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉mi/ ④〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉 ra/①〈〈snar 〉〉phyi/ ①〈〈pe〉nga〈snar 〉ngami/ ④〈〈pe 〉nga'ar 〉༅'o/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉ngams/994 ①〈〈pe 〉༅snying / ⑤〈〈snar 〉༅thar/ ①〈〈pe 〉nga〈snar 〉ram par/ ④〈〈pe 〉༅'ar 〉༅rtul/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉70—1118
〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ du〈〈pe 〉4)/bsdur 'bras re'u migasems cazla/ (6)70wa 1130

khog /mdo sde'i rgyan gyi bshad pa/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ sru tra a lo kā ra byā khye②/ bod skad du/mdo sde'i rgyan gyi bshad pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don shes don ston rab tu byed pa ngag dang tshig rnams dri med pas/ /sdug bsngal bsgral phyir sdug bsngal 'gro la snying rje'i phyir te de'i bdag nyid/ /theg mchog bstan pa'i rnam pa chos kyi de yis 'gro ba'i sems can la/ /'byor pa'i don tshul bla med gyur pa lnga yi bdag nyid ston par byad②/ /don shes don ston rab tu byed pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni ci zhes bstan pa las brtsams ④pa yin no/ /su zhig brgyan dupar byed ce na/ don shes pa'o/ /rgyan ci zhig brgyan ①par byed ce na/ don ston rab tu byed pa'o/ /cis she na/ngag dang tshig rnams dri med pas te/ ngag dri ma med pas zhes bya ba ni/grong khyer pa la sogs pas so/ /tshig dri ma med pas ⑦zhes bya ba ni/ tshig 70—1131

dang yi ge rigs pa ༅dang 'brel pa zhes bya ba rgyas par 'byung ba ste/ ngag dang tshig dang yi ge dag pa med par ni don bstan par mi nus so/ /gang gi phyir zhe na / sdug bsngal bsgral ba'i ༅phyir ro/ /gang las she na/ sdug bsngal 'gro la snying rje'i phyir te/ de'i bdag nyid sdug bsngal ba'i 'gro ba la snying rje ba gang yin pa'i snying rje de'i phyir ro/ /de'i bdag nyid ces bya ba ni snying rje'i bdag nyid do/ /ci zhig gi rgyan ④du byed ce na/ theg mchog bstan pa'i rnam pa chos kyi ste/ chos kyi rnam grangs gang la theg pa ④mchog bstan pa'i rnam pa yod pa'i chos de'i'o/ /gang gi ched du brgyan par byed ce na/ des 'gro ba'i sems can la'o/ /la zhes bya ba 'di ni ched yin te/ theg pa ④chen pos 'gro ba'i sems can gyi ched du zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go/ /rgyan rnam ④pa du zhig gis brgyan par byed ce na/ rnam pa lnga ste/ 'byor pa'i don tshul bla med gyur pa rnam pa lnga'i bdag nyid ston par byed do/ /'byor pa zhes bya ba ni rigs pa'o/ /bla med gyur pa zhes bya ba ni theg pa bla na med par gtogs pa'o/ /da ni don gyi tshul lnga'i bdag nyid de tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pas ston par byed de/ gser las brdungs byas 'dra zhing pad+ma rgyas pa bzhin/ /bkres pas nyen pa g.yos legs kha zas za ba 'dra/ /'phrin yig legs pa thos 'dra rin chen sgrom phye 3ltar/ /chos de 'dir bshad pa yang dga' ba'i mchog bskyed do/ /tshigs su bcad pa 'dis ni dpe lngas chos de'i ⑫don rnam par ⑫lnga'i dbang du byas nas ston te/ bsgrub par bya ba dang / bye brag tu shes par bya ba dang / bsam par bya ba dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang /yongs su grub pa rtogs pa'i don so so rang gis rig par bya ba byang chub kyi 70—1132
